units.sanskrit: अस्त्य् उत्तरस्यां दिशि देवतात्मा हिमालयो नाम नगाधिराजः । पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी विगाह्य स्थितः पृथिव्या इव मानदण्डः ॥
units.english: There is, in the northern quarter, the deitysould lord of mountains immovable ones, by name Himalaya the mansion of snow, who stands like the measuring rod of the earth, spanning the distance between; having eutered the Eastern and the Western occeans

units.sanskrit: यं सर्वशैलाः परिकल्प्य वत्सं मेरौ स्थिते दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे । भास्वन्ति रत्नानि महौषधीश् च पृथूपदिष्टां दुदुहुर् धरित्रीम् ॥
units.english: Whom, all the mountains, having fixed upon as the calf, while mount Meru, clever in milking, stood as the milker, milked from the earth in the shape of a cow, as directed by Prithu, brilliant jewels and great medicinal herbs

units.sanskrit: अनन्तरत्नप्रभवस्य यस्य हिमं न सौभाग्यविलोपि जातम् । एको हि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जतीन्दोः किरणेष्व् इवाङ्कः ॥
units.english: Snow could not be a destroyer of beauty in the case of him who is the source of countless jewels; for one blemish is lost in a host of virtues, like the spot on the moon in her rays

units.sanskrit: यश् चाप्सरोविभ्रममण्डनानां संपादयित्रीं शिखरैर् बिभर्ति । बलाहकच्छेदविभक्तरागाम् अकालसंध्याम् इव धातुमत्ताम् ॥
units.english: Who bears on his peaks, a richness of metals, appearing like an untimely twilight, which, with its colours reflected into the pieces of clouds, leads to the amorous decking of the Apsarases heavenly nymphs

units.sanskrit: आमेखलं संचरतां घनानां च्छायाम् अधःसानुगतां निषेव्य । उद्वेजिता वृष्टिभिर् आश्रयन्ते शृङ्गाणि यस्यातपवन्ति सिद्धाः ॥ पदं तुषारस्रुतिधौतरक्तं यस्मिन्न् अदृष्ट्वापि हतद्विपानाम् । विदन्ति मार्गं नखरन्ध्रमुक्तैर् मुक्ताफलैः केसरिणां किराताः ॥ न्यस्ताक्षरा धातुरसेन यत्र भूर्जत्वचः कुञ्जरबिन्दुशोणाः । व्रजन्ति विद्याधरसुन्दरीणाम् अनङ्गलेखक्रिययोपयोगम् ॥
units.english: To whose sunny peaks the Siddhas repair for comfort when troubled by showers, after having enjoyed the shadow fallen on the peaks below the clouds floating round the mountains zone Where the Kirâtas mountaineers track the spoor of the lions that have killed elephants by the pearls dropping from the cavities of their claws, though they do not see their footmarks, the blood stains being washed away by the streamlets of melted snow Where the barks of the birch trees, having characters written on them with mineral fluid, and so resembling the red spots on the bodies of full grown elephants, become useful to the Vidyàdhara damsels for amatory correspondence

units.sanskrit: कपोलकण्डूः करिभिर् विनेतुं विघट्टितानां सरलद्रुमाणाम् । यत्र स्रुतक्षीरतया प्रसूतः सानूनि गन्धः सुरभीकरोति ॥ वनेचराणां वनितासखानां दरीगृहोत्सङ्गनिषक्तभासः । भवन्ति यत्रौषधयो रजन्याम् अतैलपूराः सुरतप्रदीपाः ॥
units.english: Where the odour, born of the milky juice flowing from the cedar Sarala trees, rubbed against by elephants to ease the itching sensation of their temples, makes the peaks fragrant Where the phosphorescent herbs with their lustre shed into the interior of the caves, serve, at night, as lights requiring no feeding of oil, at the time of the amorous sports of the forest dwellers accompanied by fair females

units.sanskrit: उद्वेजयत्य् अङ्गुलिपार्ष्णिभागान् मार्गे शिलीभूतहिमे ऽपि यत्र । न दुर्वहश्रोणिपयोधरार्ता भिन्दन्ति मन्दां गतिम् अश्वमुख्यः ॥
units.english: Where the Asvamukhi women do not leave off their lazy gait, bowed down as they are by the weight of the hips and full breasts difficult to bear, on the path on which the snow has formed into blocks, and which therefore bites the sides of the toes and the heels

units.sanskrit: दिवाकराद् रक्षति यो गुहासु लीनं दिवा भीतम् इवान्धकारम् । क्षुद्रे ऽपि नूनं शरणं प्रपन्ने ममत्वम् उच्चैःशिरसां सतीव ॥
units.english: Who protects from the sun the maker of light in his caves darkness, hiding there for shelter, being as it were afraid of light like the nightbird; indeed, with the exalted, a feeling of kinship that he is their own extends to the lowliest suppliant seeking their protection as to the most excellent

units.sanskrit: लाङ्गूलविक्षेपविसर्पिशोभैर् इतस् ततश् चन्द्रमरीचिगौरैः । यस्यार्थयुक्तं गिरिराजशब्दं कुर्वन्ति वालव्यजनैश् चमर्यः ॥ यत्रांशुकाक्षेपविलज्जितानां यदृच्छया किंपुरुषाङ्गनानाम् । दरीगृहद्वारविलम्बिबिम्बास् तिरस्करिण्यो जलदा भवन्ति ॥ भागीरथीनिर्झरसीकराणां वोढा मुहुः कम्पितदेवदारुः । यद् वायुर् अन्विष्टमृगैः किरातैर् आसेव्यते भिन्नशिखण्डिबर्हः ॥
units.english: Where the yaks prove his title, the Lord of the mountains, to be significant by waving over him the chauries in the shape of their tails as white as the rays of the moon, and having their beauty extended all round by the movements of the tails Where the clouds, with their forms accidentally hanging over the entrances to the caverns serving as houses, become the screens for the women of the Kinnaras, shy at their garments being snatched away From which the wind, which bears along with it the spray of the current of the Ganges and which ever and anon shakes the Devadârus gods, trees is enjoyed by the hunters who have done stalking the deer, agitating as it does the peacocks feathers attached by them to their waists

units.sanskrit: सप्तर्षिहस्तावचितावशेषाण्य् अधो विवस्वान् परिवर्तमानः । पद्मानि यस्याग्रसरोरुहाणि प्रबोधयत्य् ऊर्ध्वमुखैर् मयूखैः ॥
units.english: Whose lotuses, growing in the lakes on the highest summits and left after being collected by the hands of the seven sages, the sun, moving on a lower level, blossoms by rays shooting upwards

units.sanskrit: यज्ञाङ्गयोनित्वम् अवेक्ष्य यस्य सारं धरित्रीधरणक्षमं च । प्रजापतिः कल्पितयज्ञभागं शैलाधिपत्यं स्वयम् अन्वतिष्ठत् ॥
units.english: On observing him as the source ot sacrificial requisites, and his strength as capable of holding up the earth, the Lord of creation himself conferred on him the sovereignty of the mountains with a share in the sacrificial offerings attached to it

units.sanskrit: स मानसीं मेरुसखः पितॄणां कन्यां कुलस्य स्थितये स्थितिज्ञः । मेनां मुनीनाम् अपि माननीयाम् आत्मानुरूपां विधिनोपयेमे ॥ कालक्रमेणाथ तयोः प्रवृत्ते स्वरूपयोग्ये सुरतप्रसङ्गे । मनोरमं यौवनम् उद्वहन्त्या गर्भो ऽभवद् भूधरराजपत्न्याः ॥
units.english: To maintain the continuity of his line, he, a kinsman of Meru, knowing rectitude, married, according to proper rites, Mená, the mindborn daughter of the Pitrs, equal to himself and respected of the sages In course of time, as they began to enjoy connubial life worthy of their respective charms, the consort of the Mountainlord, possessed of charming youth, conceived a child

units.sanskrit: असूत सा नागवधूपभोग्यं मैनाकम् अम्भोनिधिबद्धसख्यम् । क्रुद्धे ऽपि पक्षच्छिदि वृत्रशत्राव् अवेदनाज्ञं कुलिशक्षतानाम् ॥
units.english: She gave birth to Maináka, who wedded a Nága damsel, who contracted friendship with the ocean to hide himself in and who never experienced the pain of the wounds made by the thunderbolt even when the foe of Vrtra, the cleaver of pinions, was enraged

units.sanskrit: अथावमानेन पितुः प्रयुक्ता दक्षस्य कन्या भवपूर्वपत्नी । सती सती योगविसृष्टदेहा तां जन्मने शैलवधूं प्रपेदे ॥ सा भूधराणाम् अधिपेन तस्यां समाधिमत्याम् उदपादि भव्या । सम्यक्प्रयोगाद् अपरिक्षतायां नीताव् इवोत्साहगुणेन संपत् ॥
units.english: Then the chaste Satt, the daughter of Daksha and the former wife of Bhava Siva, who, driven by the insult offered by her father to her lord had abandoned her body by means of yoga, resorted to the Mountains consort for rebirth That blessed one Uma was begotten on her Menâ, who was always selfrestrained or, devoted to the performance of holy rites, by the Mountainlord, as prosperity is produced by the quality of energy from policy not falling in its operation on account of its being well directed

units.sanskrit: प्रसन्नदिक् पांसुविविक्तवातं शङ्खस्वनानन्तरपुष्पवृष्टि । शरीरिणां स्थावरजङ्गमानां सुखाय तज्जन्मदिनं बभूव ॥
units.english: Her birthday conduced to the happiness of embodied beings, both movable and immovable; a day when the quarters brightened, when the wind blew but without dust, and wherein there was a shower of flowers following close upon the music of conches

units.sanskrit: तया दुहित्रा सुतरां सवित्री स्फुरत्प्रभामण्डलया चकासे । विदूरभूमिर् नवमेघशब्दाद् उद्भिन्नया रत्नशलाकयेव ॥
units.english: The mother the progenitor shone very brightly by her daughter, having a halo of refulgent lustre ; as shines the land adjoining the Turquoise hills by the rays of gems shooting up at responsive to the roar of the new clouds

units.sanskrit: दिने दिने सा परिवर्धमाना लब्धोदया चान्द्रमसीव लेखा । पुपोष लावण्यमयान् विशेषाञ् ज्योत्स्नान्तराणीव कलान्तराणि ॥
units.english: As days rolled by, she, who had got her birth, growing, developed extraordinary graces as does the newly risen crescent of the moon waxing day by day other digits hidden in her lustre

units.sanskrit: तां पार्वतीत्य् आभिजनेन नाम्ना बन्धुप्रियां बन्धुजनो जुहाव । उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चाद् उमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम ॥
units.english: Her, the darling of her relatives, they called by the patronymic name of Párvatf; the maiden of a pleasing face came to be called Umà only afterwards, when forbidden by her mother to do penance with the words Uma O, do not

units.sanskrit: महीभृतः पुत्रवतो ऽपि दृष्टिस् तस्मिन्न् अपत्ये न जगाम तृप्तिम् । अनन्तपुष्पस्य मधोर् हि चूते द्विरेफमाला सविशेषसङ्गा ॥
units.english: The eyes of the Mountainlord, though having a son, were never satiated with resting on this his child; the row of bees, indeed, is more fondly attached to the mango tree blossoms, though the vernal season blooms with countless flowers

units.sanskrit: प्रभामहत्या शिखयेव दीपस् त्रिमार्गयेव त्रिदिवस्य मार्गः । संस्कारवत्येव गिरा मनीषी तया स पूतश् च विभूषितश् च ॥
units.english: By her he received additional sanctity and was also glorified, even as the lamp is by its exceedingly brilliant flame or the heavenly path by the Ganges the river of three courses or the wise by refined speech

units.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनीसैकतवेदिकाभिः सा कन्दुकैः कृत्रिमपुत्रकैश् च । रेमे मुहुर् मध्यगता सखीनां क्रीडारसं निर्विशतीव बाल्ये ॥ तां हंसमालाः शरदीव गङ्गां महौषधिं नक्तम् इवात्मभासः । स्थिरोपदेशाम् उपदेशकाले प्रपेदिरे प्राक्तनजन्मविद्याः ॥
units.english: In childhood surrounded by her companions, she, entering, as it were, into the spirit of sport often played with balls and dolls made of cloth &c and with altars built on the sands of the Ganges To her, whose impressions of the previous life were permanent, the lores, acquired in the past life, came at the time of instructing her, as do the flocks of swans to the Ganges, in autumn, or their own lustre to the medical herbs at night

units.sanskrit: असंभृतं मण्डनम् अङ्गयष्टेर् अनासवाख्यं करणं मदस्य । कामस्य पुष्पव्यतिरिक्तम् अस्त्रं बाल्यात् परं साथ वयः प्रपेदे ॥
units.english: Now she reached an age, beyond childhood, which is in itself an embellishment, not artificial, to the slim body, a cause of exhilaration not known as wine, a missile of Káma but other than the flowery one

units.sanskrit: उन्मीलितं तूलिकयेव चित्रं सूर्यांशुभिर् भिन्नम् इवारविन्दम् । बभूव तस्याश् चतुरस्रशोभि वपुर् विभक्तं नवयौवनेन ॥
units.english: Her body, charming in its perfect symmetry, was unfolded developed by fresh youth like a painting gradually growing under the brush of a painter, or like a lotus blooming under the influence of the rays of the sun

units.sanskrit: अभ्युन्नताङ्गुष्ठनखप्रभाभिर् निक्षेपणाद् रागम् इवोद्गिरन्तौ । आजह्रतुस् तच्चरणौ पृथिव्यां स्थलारविन्दश्रियम् अव्यवस्थाम् ॥ सा राजहंसैर् इव संनताङ्गी गतेषु लीलाञ्चितविक्रमेषु । व्यनीयत प्रत्युपदेशलुब्धैर् आदित्सुभिर् नूपुरसिञ्जितानि ॥
units.english: Her feet, while treading, gave to the earth the ever shifting beauty of landlotuses in the shape of the radiance of her raised great toe and nails emitting, as it were, red colour She, with a body stooping on account of the weight of her breasts, was instructed, as it were, in the matter of her gait, wherein the tread appeared graceful through playful gestures, by the royal swans, themselves desirous of receiving instruction in return as they wanted to learn the music of her anklets

units.sanskrit: वृत्तानुपूर्वे च न चातिदीर्घे जङ्घे शुभे सृष्टवतस् तदीये । शेषाङ्गनिर्माणविधौ विधातुर् लावण्य उत्पाद्य इवास यत्नः ॥ नागेन्द्रहस्तास् त्वचि कर्कशत्वाद् एकान्तशैत्यात् कदलीविशेषाः । लब्ध्वापि लोके परिणाहि रूपं जातास् तदूर्वोर् उपमानबाह्याः ॥ एतावता नन्व् अनुमेयशोभं काञ्चीगुणस्थानम् अनिन्दितायाः । आरोपितं यद् गिरिशेन पश्चाद् अनन्यनारीकमनीयम् अङ्कम् ॥
units.english: The Creator, after he had fashioned her beautiful thighs, not very long, rounded and symmetrical, had to make an effort, as it were, for the production of excellent beauty when forming her other limbs The trunks of lordly elephants through toughness of skin and the plantainstalks through their extreme coldness were unfit as standards of comparison for her thighs, though having a plump, rounded shape The beauty of the resting place of the zone of her, who was faultless, could, indeed, be inferred from this that it was placed, in after times ie after her austerities were over, by Girisha, Siva on his lap, which it was not possible even to be coveted by another female

units.sanskrit: तस्याः प्रविष्टा नतनाभिरन्ध्रं रराज तन्वी नवलोमराजिः । नीवीम् अतिक्रम्य सितेतरस्य तन्मेखलामध्यमणेर् इवार्चिः ॥ मध्येन सा वेदिविलग्नमध्या वलित्रयं चारु बभार बाला । आरोहणार्थं नवयौवनेन कामस्य सोपानम् इव प्रयुक्तम् ॥ अन्योन्यम् उत्पीडयद् उत्पलाक्ष्याः स्तनद्वयं पाण्डु तथा प्रवृद्धम् । मध्ये यथा श्याममुखस्य तस्य मृणालसूत्रान्तरम् अप्य् अलभ्यम् ॥
units.english: The delicate line of down which entered her deep navel after passing the knot of her garment at the waist, appeared like the shooting ray of the central gem of her zone which was other than white a sapphire She, with a slender waist resembling the middle of an altar, had three charming folds of skin on her waist as if they were a flight of stairs raised there by blooming youth for the God of love to ascend Of her, the lilyeyed one, the two breasts, yellowish white, having black nipples and pressing against each other, were so rounded that as much space as could be occupied even by a lotus fibre was impossible to be found between them

units.sanskrit: शिरीषपुष्पाधिकसौकुमार्यौ बाहू तदीयाव् इति मे वितर्कः । पराजितेनापि कृतौ हरस्य यौ कण्ठपाशौ मकरध्वजेन ॥
units.english: fancy her arms were more delicate than even the Sirisha flower, since they were thrown as chains round the neck of Hara by the fishbannered God, although vanquished

units.sanskrit: कण्ठस्य तस्याः स्तनबन्धुरस्य मुक्ताकलापस्य च निस्तलस्य । अन्योन्यशोभाजननाद् बभूव साधारणो भूषणभूष्यभावः ॥
units.english: In the case of her neck gracefully elevated over her breasts and her encircling pearlnecklace, the condition of being the adorned and the adorner was indifferently exchangeable owing to each bringing beauty to the other

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रं गता पद्मगुणान् न भुङ्क्ते पद्माश्रिता चान्द्रमसीम् अभिख्याम् । उमामुखं तु प्रतिपद्य लोला द्विसंश्रयां प्रीतिम् अवाप लक्ष्मीः ॥ पुष्पं प्रवालोपहितं यदि स्यान् मुक्ताफलं वा स्फुटविद्रुमस्थम् । ततो ऽनुकुर्याद् विशदस्य तस्यास् ताम्रौष्ठपर्यस्तरुचः स्मितस्य ॥
units.english: The unsteady Goddess of beauty, could not enjoy possess the charms of the lotus when with the moon, and of the lunar graces when with the lotus; but when she betook herself to the face of Umá, she enjoyed the pleasure coming from the charms peculiar to both If a white flower were laid upon a young tender leaf or a pearl were to rest on the richest spotless coral, then only could either vie with the sweet smile that played about whose lustre was shed over her rosy lip

units.sanskrit: स्वरेण तस्याम् अमृतस्रुतेव प्रजल्पितायाम् अभिजातवाचि । अप्य् अन्यपुष्टा प्रतिकूलशब्दा श्रोतुर् वितन्त्रीर् इव ताड्यमाना ॥
units.english: While she, who had a musical sound, spoke in a voice that distilled nectar as it were, even the koil bred by others, was to the ears of the listeners full of jarring notes, like a harp, out of tune, when played upon

units.sanskrit: प्रवातनीलोत्पलनिर्विशेषम् अधीरविप्रेक्षितम् आयताक्ष्या । तया गृहीतं नु मृगाङ्गनाभ्यस् ततो गृहीतं नु मृगाङ्गनाभिः ॥ तस्याः शलाकाञ्जननिर्मितेव कान्तिर् भ्रुवोर् आनतलेखयोर् या । तां वीक्ष्य लीलाचतुराम् अनङ्गः स्वचापसौन्दर्यमदं मुमोच ॥
units.english: The timid unsteady glances which were not dissimilar to the blue lotus tremulous in a strong wind, did the female fawns borrow from her, or she with elongated eyes from them ? On seeing the beauty, charming in its sportiveness, of her long arching brows, pencilled as it were with black paint, lhe bodiless God gave up all pride in the beauty of his curved bow

units.sanskrit: लज्जा तिरश्चां यदि चेतसि स्याद् असंशयं पर्वतराजपुत्र्याः । तं केशपाशं प्रसमीक्ष्य कुर्युर् वालप्रियत्वं शिथिलं चमर्यः ॥
units.english: If there can be a sense of shame in the minds of the lower animals, then the female Chamaras will, undoubtedly, grow cold in their fondness for their hair on seeing the magnificent tresses of the daughter of the Mountain lord

units.sanskrit: सर्वोपमाद्रव्यसमुच्चयेन यथाप्रदेशं विनिवेशितेन । सा निर्मिता विश्वसृजा प्रयत्नाद् एकस्थसौन्दर्यदिदृक्षयेव ॥
units.english: In short she was created by the Creator of the universe with great effort, as if with a desire to see all beauty combined in one form, by gathering together all the standards of comparison and placing them, each in its place

units.sanskrit: तां नारदः कामचरः कदा चित् कन्यां किल प्रेक्ष्य पितुः समीपे । समादिदेशैकवधूं भवित्रीं प्रेम्णा शरीरार्धहरां हरस्य ॥
units.english: Once, it is said, Nàrada, who roams at will, on seeing that girl near her father, declared that she would be Haras one bride who would share half of his body through love

units.sanskrit: गुरुः प्रगल्भे ऽपि वयस्य् अतो ऽस्यास् तस्थौ निवृत्तान्यवराभिलाषः । ऋते कृशानोर् न हि मन्त्रपूतम् अर्हन्ति तेजांस्य् अपराणि हव्यम् ॥
units.english: For this reason her father remained indifferent, setting aside all thought of another bridegroom for her, although she had reached the age of adolescence for an oblation, sanctified by mantras, lustrous objects other than fire do not deserve

units.sanskrit: अयाचितारं न हि देवदेवम् अद्रिः सुतां ग्राहयितुं शशाक । अभ्यर्थनाभङ्गभयेन साधुर् माध्यस्थ्यम् इष्टे ऽप्य् अवलम्बते ऽर्थे ॥
units.english: The Mountain could not offer his child to the God of gods unsolicited a wise man resorts to neutrality even in the matter of his desired object through fear of his request being refused

units.sanskrit: यदैव पूर्वे जनने शरीरं सा दक्षरोषात् सुदती ससर्ज । तदाप्रभृत्य् एव विमुक्तसङ्गः पतिः पशूनाम् अपरिग्रहो ऽभूत् ॥
units.english: When that lady, of pearly teeth, abandoned her body through resentment against Daksha in her former birth, just from that time the Lord of beings Siva, giving up all attachment to worldly pleasures lived without a wife

units.sanskrit: स कृत्तिवासास् तपसे यतात्मा गङ्गाप्रवाहोक्षितदेवदारु । प्रस्थं हिमाद्रेर् मृगनाभिगन्धि किं चित् क्वणत्किंनरम् अध्युवास ॥
units.english: He, with a skin for his garment, and with his mind controlled, dwelt, for the purpose of practising austerities, on some peak of the Snowmansion, where the sacred fir trees were laved by the current of the Ganges, which was odoriferous with the fragrance of musk, and where there was the music of heavenly minstrels Kinnaras

units.sanskrit: गणा नमेरुप्रसवावतंसा भूर्जत्वचः स्पर्शवतीर् दधानाः । मनःशिलाविच्छुरिता निषेदुः शैलेयनद्धेषु शिलातलेषु ॥ तुषारसंघातशिलाः खुराग्रैः समुल्लिखन् दर्पकलः ककुद्मान् । दृष्टः कथं चिद् गवयैर् विविग्नैर् असोढसिंहध्वनिर् उन्ननाद ॥
units.english: And his attendant troops, with the flowers of the Nameru trees for their earornaments, clad in the barks of the birch trees soft to touch and annointed with mineral red arsenic dyes, sat on the rocks coated with fragrant resin His bull having a prominent hump uttering a pleasing bellow of pride, digging with his hoofs the rocks of collected snow, and looked at with great difficulty by the terrified gayals, bellowed aloud there, intolerant of the roar of the lions

units.sanskrit: तत्राग्निम् आधाय समित्समिद्धं स्वम् एव मूर्त्यन्तरम् अष्टमूर्तिः । स्वयं विधाता तपसः फलानाम् केनापि कामेन तपश् चचार ॥
units.english: He, of eight forms, himself the giver of the fruit of penance, having set up a fire there, kindled with sacrificial wood and another manifestation of himself, practised austerities with some unknown object

units.sanskrit: अनर्घ्यम् अर्घ्येण तम् अद्रिनाथः स्वर्गौकसाम् अर्चितम् अर्चयित्वा । आराधनायास्य सखीसमेतां समादिदेश प्रयतां तनूजाम् ॥
units.english: The mountainlord having worshipped him of inestimable worth and adored by the gods the denizens of heaven, with the customary offerings, directed his daughter of restrained soul, together with her two female friends, to wait upon or propitiate him

units.sanskrit: प्रत्यर्थिभूताम् अपि तां समाधेः शुश्रूषमाणां गिरिशो ऽनुमेने । विकारहेतौ सति विक्रियन्ते येषां न चेतांसि त एव धीराः ॥
units.english: Siva the Mountaindweller allowed her to serve him according to her desire although an obstruction to contemplation; for they alone are steady whose minds are not affected in the presence of the cause of perturbation

units.sanskrit: अवचितबलिपुष्पा वेदिसंमार्गदक्षा नियमविधिजलानां बर्हिषां चोपनेत्री । गिरिशम् उपचचार प्रत्यहं सा सुकेशी नियमितपरिखेदा तच्छिरश्चन्द्रपादैः ॥
units.english: Culling flowers for offerings, assiduous in cleaning the altar and bringing water for the performance of holy rites and the Kusa grassthus did she, having lovely tresses, attend upon Siva every day, her fatigue being allayed by the rays of the lunar digit on his head

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् विप्रकृताः काले तारकेण दिवौकसः । तुरासाहं पुरोधाय धाम स्वायंभुवं ययुः ॥
units.english: At that time the denizens of heaven, harassed by Taraka, went to the abode of the selfexistent God, Bramhá, having placed Indra the speedyvanquisher at their head

units.sanskrit: तेषाम् आविर् अभूद् ब्रह्मा परिम्लानमुखश्रियाम् । सरसां सुप्तपद्मानां प्रातर् दीधितिमान् इव ॥
units.english: Brahmà revealed himself to them, the lustre of whose faces had faded away, as does the sun the possessor of bright rays to the lakes with sleeping closed lotuses in the morning

units.sanskrit: अथ सर्वस्य धातारं ते सर्वे सर्वतोमुखम् । वागीशं वाग्भिर् अर्थ्याभिः प्रणिपत्योपतस्थिरे ॥
units.english: Then, having bowed to him, who has a face on every side, who is the creator of all, and who is the lord of speech, they propitiated him with appropriate full of sense speeches

units.sanskrit: नमस् त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं प्राक् सृष्टेः केवलात्मने । गुणत्रयविभागाय पश्चाद् भेदम् उपेयुषे ॥
units.english: Salutation to thee of three forms, the one soul before the creation of the world, who afterwards dividedst thyself into the three Gunas Satva, Rajas and Tamas and manifestedst a variety of forms

units.sanskrit: यद् अमोघम् अपाम् अन्तर् उप्तं बीजम् अज त्वया । अतश् चराचरं विश्वं प्रभवस् तस्य गीयसे ॥
units.english: O uuborn one, the universe, composed of things that move and that do not move, has sprung from the ever prolific seed which was cast by thee in the waters; hence art thou glorified as its source

units.sanskrit: तिसृभिस् त्वम् अवस्थाभिर् महिमानम् उदीरयन् । प्रलयस्थितिसर्गाणाम् एकः कारणतां गतः ॥
units.english: Manifesting thy might by the three forms three states characterised by the three qualities, thou alone hast come to be the cause of the creation, the protection and the retraction of the universe

units.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसाव् आत्मभागौ ते भिन्नमूर्तेः सिसृक्षया । प्रसूतिभाजः सर्गस्य ताव् एव पितरौ स्मृतौ ॥ स्वकालपरिमाणेन व्यस्तरात्रिंदिवस्य ते । यौ तु स्वप्नावबोधौ तौ भूतानां प्रलयोदयौ ॥
units.english: Male and female are the separate manifestations of thy own self, thus split up through the desire of creating; and these are declared as the parents of the creation that sprang into existence The waking and slumbering of thee, who hast separated thy day and night by the measure of thy own time, are represent the period of the creation and destruction of all things

units.sanskrit: जगद्योनिर् अयोनिस् त्वं जगदन्तो निरन्तकः । जगदादिर् अनादिस् त्वं जगदीशो निरीश्वरः ॥
units.english: Thyself without a source, thou art the source of the universe; thyself endless, thou art the end of the universe; without beginning, thou art the beginning of the universe; and thyself lordless, thou art the lord of the universe!!

units.sanskrit: आत्मानम् आत्मना वेत्सि सृजस्य् आत्मानम् आत्मना । आत्मना कृतिना च त्वम् आत्मन्य् एव प्रलीयसे ॥
units.english: Thou knowest thyself in thyself, thou createst thyself by thyself and thou art absorbed in thyself by thy own mighty self

units.sanskrit: द्रवः संघातकठिनः स्थूलः सूक्ष्मो लघुर् गुरुः । व्यक्तो व्यक्तेतरश् चासि प्राकाम्यं ते विभूतिषु ॥
units.english: Thou art fluid and hard on account of the close contact of the particles adhesion; gross and subtile; light and yet heavy; perceptible and yet the opposite of that; thy will is absolute in the manifestation of the energies or miraculous powers

units.sanskrit: उद्घातः प्रणवो यासां न्यायैस् त्रिभिर् उदीरणम् । कर्म यज्ञः फलं स्वर्गस् तासां त्वं प्रभवो गिराम् ॥
units.english: Thou art the source of those speeches Vedas, the introduction of which is by the syllable Omn, the utterance of which is in threefold intonation, the rite to be performed by which is sacrifice, and the fruit of which is heaven

units.sanskrit: त्वाम् आमनन्ति प्रकृतिं पुरुषार्थप्रवर्तिनीम् । तद्दर्शिनम् उदासीनं त्वाम् एव पुरुषं विदुः ॥
units.english: They declare thee as the Prakriti operating for the benefit of the soul Purusha; and they know thee alone to be the Purusha, the indifferent passive witness of the operations of the Prakriti

units.sanskrit: त्वं पितॄणाम् अपि पिता देवानाम् अपि देवता । परतो ऽपि परश् चासि विधाता वेधसाम् अपि ॥
units.english: Thou art the father of the gods, higher than the high and the progenitors of mankind manes, god of the progenitor of the

units.sanskrit: त्वम् एव हव्यं होता च भोज्यं भोक्ता च शाश्वतः । वेद्यं च वेदिता चासि ध्याता ध्येयं च यत् परम् ॥
units.english: Thou, the eternal one, art the sacrificial offering and again its offerer the sacrificer, the enjoyed and the enjoyer, the knowable and also the knower, the meditator and again the supreme object of meditation

units.sanskrit: इति तेभ्यः स्तुतीः श्रुत्वा यथार्था हृदयंगमाः । प्रसादाभिमुखो वेधाः प्रत्युवाच दिवौकसः ॥
units.english: Having heard from them these these praises, thus uttered, truthful and going pleasing to the heart, the Creator, inclined to show favour, answered the gods thus

units.sanskrit: पुराणस्य कवेस् तस्य चतुर्मुखसमीरिता । प्रवृत्तिर् आसीच् छब्दानां चरितार्था चतुष्टयी ॥
units.english: Of that primeval bard, the fourfold ie having a fourfold excellence flow of words speech being uttered from the four mouths, was successful or had its object gained

units.sanskrit: स्वागतं स्वान् अधीकारान् प्रभावैर् अवलम्ब्य वः । युगपद् युगबाहुभ्यः प्राप्तेभ्यः प्राज्यविक्रमाः ॥ किम् इदं द्युतिम् आत्मीयां न बिभ्रति यथा पुरा । हिमक्लिष्टप्रकाशानि ज्योतींषीव मुखानि वः ॥
units.english: Welcome to you, O gods of mighty valour, who, having held your respective high posts by your might, have come here in a body and who have polelike long arms ie reaching upto the knee Why is it that your faces do not show their wonted glow like stars with their gleam dimmed by a mist?

units.sanskrit: प्रशमाद् अर्चिषाम् एतद् अनुद्गीर्णसुरायुधम् । वृत्रस्य हन्तुः कुलिशं कुण्ठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते ॥ किं चायम् अरिदुर्वारः पाणौ पाशः प्रचेतसः । मन्त्रेण हतवीर्यस्य फणिनो दैन्यम् आश्रितः ॥
units.english: This thunderbolt of the destroyer of Vritra, not displaying its variegated splendour rainbow on account of the loss of its radiance, appears to have its edges blunted The noose in the hand of Varuna, irresistible to the enemy, is reduced to the helplessness of a serpent, whose prowess is repressed by a spell

units.sanskrit: कुबेरस्य मनःशल्यं शंसतीव पराभवम् । अपविद्धगदो बाहुर् भग्नशाख इव द्रुमः ॥
units.english: The arm of Kubera, from which the mace is cast off, and which, therefore, appearing like a tree with its branches broken, hints, as it were, at a defeat, that has been like a dart in the heart rankling in his mind

units.sanskrit: यमो ऽपि विलिखन् भूमिं दण्डेनास्तमितत्विषा । कुरुते ऽस्मिन्न् अमोघे ऽपि निर्वाणालातलाघवम् ॥
units.english: Even Yama, scratching the ground with his rod having its lustre entirely gone, brings to it, invincible once, the insignificance of a quenched firebrand for marking the earth

units.sanskrit: अमी च कथम् आदित्याः प्रतापक्षतिशीतलाः । चित्रन्यस्ता इव गताः प्रकामालोकनीयताम् ॥
units.english: How have these Adityas, cool on account of the loss of their burning lustre, come to the condition of being gazed on at will, as if painted in pictures?

units.sanskrit: पर्याकुलत्वान् मरुतां वेगभङ्गो ऽनुमीयते । अम्भसाम् ओघसंरोधः प्रतीपगमनाद् इव ॥
units.english: The halting of the speed of the Maruts windgods can be guessed from their faltering motion, as is the stoppage of their current from the refluence of waters

units.sanskrit: आवर्जितजटामौलिविलम्बिशशिकोटयः । रुद्राणाम् अपि मूर्धानः क्षतहुंकारशंसिनः ॥
units.english: The heads of the Rudras, with their crescents hanging from the knots of matted hair, bent low through shame of defeat tell of the quelling of their deep gutteral sounds their weapons

units.sanskrit: लब्धप्रतिष्ठाः प्रथमं यूयं किं बलवत्तरैः । अपवादैर् इवोत्सर्गाः कृतव्यावृत्तयः परैः ॥
units.english: Have you, who had already gained position established your preeminence, been thrown down from it by your more powerful enemies, as general rules are overthrown set aside by special ones exceptions?

units.sanskrit: तद् ब्रूत वत्साः किम् इतः प्रार्थयध्वे समागताः । मयि सृष्टिर् हि लोकानां रक्षा युष्मास्व् अवस्थिता ॥
units.english: Say then, my children, what crave you, coming here together? With me rests the creation of the world, with you its protection

units.sanskrit: ततो मन्दानिलोद्धूतकमलाकरशोभिना । गुरुं नेत्रसहस्रेण चोदयाम् आस वासवः ॥
units.english: Then Vàsava urged the preceptor of the gods with a motion of his thousand eyes, that appeared beautiful like a bed of lotuses shaken by a gentle wind

units.sanskrit: स द्विनेत्रो हरेश् चक्षुः सहस्रनयनाधिकम् । वाचस्पतिर् उवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिर् जलजासनम् ॥
units.english: He, the twofold eye of Hari, greater more serviceable to him than his one thousand eyeshe, Vâchaspati the lord of speech spoke to him, the lotusthroned one Brahmá, with hands folded in supplication

units.sanskrit: एवं यद् आत्थ भगवन्न् आमृष्टं नः परैः पदम् । प्रत्येकं विनियुक्तात्मा कथं न ज्ञास्यसि प्रभो ॥
units.english: O Lord, what you said is so our high position is snatched away from us by our foes O mighty One, how should you not know it when your soul pervades each and every creature!

units.sanskrit: भवल्लब्धवरोदीर्णस् तारकाख्यो महासुरः । उपप्लवाय लोकानां धूमकेतुर् इवोत्थितः ॥
units.english: A mighty demon uamed Taraka, grown insolent by a boon obtained from you, has risen to torment the world, like a comet

units.sanskrit: पुरे तावन्तम् एवास्य तनोति रविर् आतपम् । दीर्घिकाकमलोन्मेषो यावन्मात्रेण साध्यते ॥ सर्वाभिः सर्वदा चन्द्रस् तं कलाभिर् निषेवते । नादत्ते केवलां लेखां हरचूडामणीकृताम् ॥
units.english: To his town the Sun sends his rays in such numbers only as will suffice to awaken cause to bloom the lotuses in his pleasurelakes He is afraid of shining in all his glory On him the Moon waits with all his digits at all times in both the halfs; only he keeps back the digit that forms the crestgem of Siva

units.sanskrit: व्यावृत्तगतिर् उद्याने कुसुमस्तेयसाध्वसात् । न वाति वायुस् तत्पार्श्वे तालवृन्तानिलाधिकम् ॥ पर्यायसेवाम् उत्सृज्य पुष्पसंभारतत्पराः । उद्यानपालसामान्यम् ऋतवस् तम् उपासते ॥ तस्योपायनयोग्यानि रत्नानि सरितां पतिः । कथम् अप्य् अम्भसाम् अन्तर् आ निष्पत्तेः प्रतीक्षते ॥
units.english: The Wind, with his motion in his garden stopped through fear of punishment for stealing bearing away flowers, does not blow near him with greater force than is produced by a fan And the Seasons, ever diligent in providing a stock of flowers, wait upon him, as if they were nothing more than his gardeners, giving up for the time a succession of service

units.sanskrit: ज्वलन्मणिशिखाश् चैनं वासुकिप्रमुखा निशि । स्थिरप्रदीपताम् एत्य भुजंगाः पर्युपासते ॥
units.english: The serpents, with Vàsuki at their head, with their blazing jewellustres, wait upon him at night, serving as fixed lamps

units.sanskrit: तत्कृतानुग्रहापेक्षी तं मुहुर् दूतहारितैः । अनुकूलयतीन्द्रो ऽपि कल्पद्रुमविभूषणैः ॥
units.english: Even Indra, desirous of securing favour done by him, tries again and again to win him over with the precious flowers of the desiregranting trees Kalpadrumas sent by massengers

units.sanskrit: इत्थम् आराध्यमानो ऽपि क्लिश्नाति भुवनत्रयम् । शाम्येत् प्रत्यपकारेण नोपकारेण दुर्जनः ॥
units.english: Though served in this way, he harrasses the three worlds A wicked person can be put down only by a retaliation of injury and not by an act of kindness

units.sanskrit: तेनामरवधूहस्तैः सदयालूनपल्लवाः । अभिज्ञाश् छेदपातानां क्रियन्ते नन्दनद्रुमाः ॥ वीज्यते स हि संसुप्तः श्वाससाधारणानिलैः । चामरैः सुरबन्दीनां बाष्पशीकरवर्षिभिः ॥
units.english: By him are the trees of the Nandana grove, the leaves of which were tenderly plucked by the wives of the immortals, made to experience cuttings and fallings When asleep, he is fanned by the captive heavenly damsels with chauries showering the spray of tears, and raising wind light like breathing

units.sanskrit: उत्पाट्य मेरुशृङ्गाणि क्षुण्णानि हरितां खुरैः । आक्रीडपर्वतास् तेन कल्पिताः स्वेषु वेश्मसु ॥ मन्दाकिन्याः पयःशेषं दिग्वारणमदाविलम् । हेमाम्भोरुहसस्यानां तद्वाप्यो धाम सांप्रतम् ॥
units.english: He has built pleasuremountains in his residences having rooted up peaks of Meru, once struck by the hoofs of the Suns coursers The water of the heavenly Ganges, made oily by the rut of the elephants of the quarters, is alone left now ie without its golden lotuses, while his pleasurelakes have become the abode of the harvest of golden lotuses

units.sanskrit: भुवनालोकनप्रीतिः स्वर्गिभिर् नानुभूयते । खिलीभूते विमानानां तदापातभयात् पथि ॥
units.english: The love of seeing different worlds is no more entertained by the gods, as the path of the aerical cars has become desolate through fear of being attacked by him

units.sanskrit: यज्वभिः संभृतं हव्यं विततेष्व् अध्वरेषु सः । जातवेदोमुखान् मायी मिषताम् आच्छिनत्ति नः ॥
units.english: He, versed in magic arts, snatches away from the mouth of fire, the oblation offered by the sacrificers in due form in sacrifices when instituted, while we look on helplessly

units.sanskrit: उच्चैर् उच्चैःश्रवास् तेन हयरत्नम् अहारि च । देहबद्धम् इवेन्द्रस्य चिरकालार्जितं यशः ॥
units.english: He has borne away the wellknown Uchchais ravas, the jewel of horses, who was, as it were, the long acquired glory of Indra in a bodily form

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् उपायाः सर्वे नः क्रूरे प्रतिहतक्रियाः । वीर्यवत्य् औषधानीव विकारे सांनिपातिके ॥
units.english: All our efforts against the wicked wretch are turned to naught, as herbs of powerful healing virtue, against a joint distemper of the three humours malignly disturbed

units.sanskrit: जयाशा यत्र चास्माकं प्रतिघातोत्थितार्चिषा । हरिचक्रेण तेनास्य कण्ठे निष्क इवार्पितः ॥
units.english: The discus of Harí, whereon rested our hope of success, offered itself, as it were, like a gold ornament round his deck, with a stream of lustre only flashing forth from it as it clashed against his bosom

units.sanskrit: तदीयास् तोयदेष्व् अद्य पुष्करावर्तकादिषु । अभ्यस्यन्ति तटाघातं निर्जितैरावता गजाः ॥
units.english: Now his elephants, who have vanquished Airà vata, are practising butting against the clouds, such as Pushkaràvartaka and others

units.sanskrit: तद् इच्छामो विभो सृष्टं सेनान्यं तस्य शान्तये । कर्मबन्धच्छिदं धर्मं भवस्येव मुमुक्षवः ॥
units.english: O Almighty God, we, therefore desire to create a leader to destroy him, as those desirous of salvation wish to raise religious virtue, which cuts off the fetters of Karman

units.sanskrit: गोप्तारं सुरसैन्यानां यं पुरस्कृत्य गोत्रभित् । प्रत्यानेष्यति शत्रुभ्यो बन्दीम् इव जयश्रियम् ॥
units.english: Whom, the defender of the heavenly host, having placed in the foremost place, the Breakerofmountains Iudra will lead back the Glory of victory, like one taken captive

units.sanskrit: वचस्य् अवसिते तस्मिन् ससर्ज गिरम् आत्मभूः । गर्जितानन्तरां वृष्टिं सौभाग्येन जिगाय या ॥
units.english: When this address was concluded, the Selfexistent One uttered a speech, which far surpassed, in sweetness its refreshing effect, a shower falling after thunder

units.sanskrit: संपत्स्यते वः कामो यं कालः कश्चित् प्रतीक्ष्यताम् । न त्व् अस्य सिद्धौ यास्यामि सर्गव्यापारम् आत्मना ॥
units.english: This your desire will be gratified; wait some time but will not, myself, undertake the work of creation for its fulfilment ie producing a leader

units.sanskrit: इतः स दैत्यः प्राप्तश्रीर् नेत एवार्हति क्षयम् । विषवृक्षो ऽपि संवर्ध्य स्वयं छेत्तुम् असांप्रतम् ॥
units.english: The demon who acquired his glory from here, ought not to have destruction from here; it is improper to cut down even a poisonous tree when once nurtured by oneself

units.sanskrit: वृतं तेनेदम् एव प्राङ् मया चास्मै प्रतिश्रुतम् । वरेण शमितं लोकान् अलं दग्धुं हि तत्तपः ॥
units.english: Formerly this viz freedom from death at the hands of the gods he sought as a boon and the same granted him; and thus by a boon made his penance, capable of burning the worlds, nugatory

units.sanskrit: संयुगे सांयुगीनं तम् उद्यतं प्रसहेत कः । अंशाद् ऋते निषिक्तस्य नीललोहितरेतसः ॥
units.english: Who but a portion of the energy of the Blacknecked one Siva dropped on favourable ground can withstand him who is warlike when ready to attack in a battle?

units.sanskrit: स हि देवः परं ज्योतिस् तमःपारे व्यवस्थितम् । परिच्छिन्नप्रभावर्द्धिर् न मया न च विष्णुना ॥
units.english: That God Siva is the supreme soul highest lustre reigning beyond the region of darkness the quality of Tamashe, the extent of whose prowess cannot be accurately gauged either by me or by Vishnu

units.sanskrit: उमारूपेण ते यूयं संयमस्तिमितं मनः । शंभोर् यतध्वम् आक्रष्टुम् अयस्कान्तेन लोहवत् ॥
units.english: So you, who are desirous of achieving your object should try to draw away tempt the mind of Siva, steadied by selfrestraint or firmly fixed on contemplation towards matrimony by means of the beauty of Umà, like iron by a magnet

units.sanskrit: उभे एव क्षमे वोढुम् उभयोर् वीर्यम् आहितम् । सा वा शंभोस् तदीया वा मूर्तिर् जलमयी मम ॥
units.english: Only these two are capable of bearing the seed of us two when depositedUmà of Siva and his watery form of me

units.sanskrit: तस्यात्मा शितिकण्ठस्य सैनापत्यम् उपेत्य वः । मोक्ष्यते सुरबन्दीनां वेणीर् वीर्यविभूतिभिः ॥
units.english: Another form of the self son of that Siva, having taken up the leadership of your host, will loosen the braids of the captive heavenly damsels by the glory of his might

units.sanskrit: इति व्याहृत्य विबुधान् विश्वयोनिस् तिरोदधे । मनस्य् आहितकर्तव्यास् ते ऽपि प्रतिययुर् दिवम् ॥
units.english: Having addressed the gods thus the Creator of the universe vanished from sight; and the gods, too, went back to the celestial world with what was to be done firmly settled in their minds

units.sanskrit: तत्र निश्चित्य कन्दर्पम् अगमत् पाकशासनः । मनसा कार्यसंसिद्धित्वराद्विगुणरंहसा ॥
units.english: Having fixed upon Kandarpa as the proper agent to be employed in that business, the chastiser of Pâka Indra approached him by the mind, the speed of which was doubled by his eagerness for the accomplishment of the object

units.sanskrit: अथ स ललितयोषिद्भ्रूलताचारुशृङ्गं रतिवलयपदाङ्के चापम् आसज्य कण्ठे । सहचरमधुहस्तन्यस्तचूताङ्कुरास्त्रः शतमखम् उपतस्थे प्राञ्जलिः पुष्पधन्वा ॥ तस्मिन् मघोनस् त्रिदशान् विहाय सहस्रम् अक्ष्णां युगपत् पपात । प्रयोजनापेक्षितया प्रभूणां प्रायश् चलं गौरवम् आश्रितेषु ॥
units.english: Then the flowerbowed god, with his bow, the ends of which were as beautiful as the arching brows of graceful women, slung over his neck bearing the marks of the bracelets of Rati, and having his missile, the young sprouts of mango trees, deposited in the hands of his friend Madhu vernal season, approached the Performerof bundredsacrifices Indra with folded hands The thousand eyes of Indra simultaneously alighted on him, leaving the gods; generally the regard of lords for their dependents changes according to the purpose they desire to be accomplished

units.sanskrit: स वासवेनासनसंनिकृष्टम् इतो निषीदेति विसृष्टभूमिः । भर्तुः प्रसादं प्रतिनन्द्य मूर्ध्ना वक्तुं मिथः प्राक्रमतैवम् एनम् ॥
units.english: He was allowed a place near his own throne by Vasava with the words sit here; and he, having acknowledged the courtesy of his master by a reverential inclination of his head began to speak to him in private thus

units.sanskrit: आज्ञापय ज्ञातविशेष पुंसां लोकेषु यत् ते करणीयम् अस्ति । अनुग्रहं संस्मरणप्रवृत्तम् इच्छामि संवर्धितम् आज्ञया ते ॥
units.english: O you who discern the special qualifications of men, command what you desire to be done in the three worlds should like this your favour shown by your remembrance of me to be enhanced by the execution of a command

units.sanskrit: केनाभ्यसूया पदकाङ्क्षिणा ते नितान्तदीर्घैर् जनिता तपोभिः । यावद् भवत्य् आहितसायकस्य मत्कार्मुकस्यास्य निदेशवर्ती ॥ असंमतः कस् तव मुक्तिमार्गं पुनर्भवक्लेशभयात् प्रपन्नः । बद्धश् चिरं तिष्ठतु सुन्दरीणाम् आरेचितभ्रूचतुरैः कटाक्षैः ॥
units.english: By whom, desirous of getting your post, has your vengeance been roused by mighty exceedingly prolonged austerities? For in a trice shall he be within the range of this my bow on which an arrow has been fixed Who, undesired by you, is seeking the path of salvation through fear of rebirth? Let him long stand fettered down to wordly existence by the sidelong glances, bewitching with the play of the eyebrows, of beautiful women

units.sanskrit: अध्यापितस्योशनसापि नीतिं प्रयुक्तरागप्रणिधिर् द्विषस् ते । कस्यार्थधर्मौ वद पीडयामि सिन्धोस् तटाव् ओघ इव प्रवृद्धः ॥
units.english: Say, of what foe of yours shall , employing as messenger sensuality, obstruct the temporal and spiritual advancement, although he be instructed in morality by Ushanas himself, as the flooded current of a river obstructs its two banks?

units.sanskrit: काम् एकपत्नीव्रतदुःखशीलां लोलं मनश् चारुतया प्रविष्टाम् । नितम्बिनीम् इच्छसि मुक्तलज्जां कण्ट्ःए स्वयंग्राहनिषक्तबाहुम् ॥ कयासि कामिन् सुरतापराधात् पादानतः कोपनयावधूतः । यस्याः करिष्यामि दृढानुतापं प्रवालशय्याशरणं शरीरम् ॥
units.english: What lady having full buttocks painfully keeping the vow of chastity, who has made a niche in your unsteady lustful mind by her beauty, do you wish to be compelled to twine her arms round your neck, of her own accord, abandoning all sense of shame? O gallant, by what lady naturally passionate, have you been spurned for your infidelity in love although fallen at her feet? Her body shall subject to strong repentance and make it helplessly resort to a couch of tender sprouts

units.sanskrit: प्रसीद विश्राम्यतु वीर वज्रं शरैर् मदीयैः कतमः सुरारिः । बिभेतु मोघीकृतबाहुवीर्यः स्त्रीभ्यो ऽपि कोपस्फुरिताधराभ्यः ॥
units.english: O mighty one, be pleased; let your bolt rest; what foe of yours should quall, with the might of his arms rendered unavailing even before women, with lips curling through passion ?

units.sanskrit: तव प्रसादात् कुसुमायुधो ऽपि सहायम् एकं मधुम् एव लब्ध्वा । कुर्यां हरस्यापि पिनाकपाणेर् धैर्यच्युतिं के मम धन्विनो ऽन्ये ॥
units.english: Although flowerarmed, taking Madhu the presiding deity of the vernal season alone for my associate, shall break down through your favour the selfrestraint even of the Tridentholder Siva

units.sanskrit: अथोरुदेशाद् अवतार्य पादम् आक्रान्तिसंभावितपादपीठम् । संकल्पिथार्थे विवृतात्मशक्तिम् आखण्डलः कामम् इदं बभाषे ॥
units.english: What are other bowmen before me then? , Then Akhandala Indra having taken his leg off his thigh and honoured the footstool by placing it upon it, thus spoke to Kàma who had declared his power as equal to the achievement of the object he had in view

units.sanskrit: सर्वं सखे त्वय्य् उपपन्नम् एतद् उभे ममास्त्रे कुलिशं भवांश् च । वज्रं तपोवीर्यमहत्सु कुण्ट्ःअं त्वं सर्वतोगामि च साधकं च ॥
units.english: Friend, all is possible for you to do; have but the two weapons, yourself and my bolt; my bolt however is powerless against those mighty with the power of austerities, while you go unchallenged everywhere and accomplish every thing

units.sanskrit: अवैमि ते सारम् अतः खलु त्वां कार्ये गुरुण्य् आत्मसमं नियोक्ष्ये । व्यादिश्यते भूधरताम् अवेक्ष्य कृष्णेन देहोद्वहनाय शेषः ॥
units.english: know your strength, and hence employ you in acts of grave import as would do myself; Krishna has assigned to Sesha the duty of bearing his body, on observing his capability to uphold the world

units.sanskrit: आशंसता बाणगतिं वृषाङ्के कार्यं त्वया नः प्रतिपन्नकल्पम् । निबोध यज्ञांशभुजाम् इदानीम् उच्चैर्द्विषाम् ईप्सितम् एतद् एव ॥ अमी हि वीर्यप्रभवं भवस्य जयाय सेनान्यम् उशन्ति देवाः । स च त्वदेकेषुनिपातसाध्यो ब्रह्माङ्गभूर् ब्रह्मणि योजितात्मा ॥
units.english: In talking of the power of your arrow to hit the Bullemblemed God Siva, you have almost undertaken our work know that at present this is just the desired object of the gods those who have an allotted portion in a sacrifice who have powerful foes The divine beings desire to have a leader for their host, sprung from the energy of Bhava, that they can conquer their foes

units.sanskrit: तस्मै हिमाद्रेः प्रयतां तनूजां यतात्मने रोचयितुं यतस्व । योषित्सु तद्वीर्यनिषेकभूमिः सैव क्षमेत्य् आत्मभुवोपदिष्टम् ॥
units.english: Strive to make him, who is selfrestrained, love the devoted daughter of Himàlaya; of all women she alone is the proper ground for the depositing of his seedso has declared the Selfborn Brahmá

units.sanskrit: गुरोर् नियोगाच् च नगेन्द्रकन्या स्थाणुं तपस्यन्तम् अधित्यकायाम् । अन्वास्त इत्य् अप्सरसां मुखेभ्यः श्रुतं मया मत्प्रणिधिः स वर्गः ॥
units.english: And the daughter of the Mountainlord, at her fathers bidding, waits upon the Eternal one Siva practising penance on the high region of Himàlayaso have heard from the lips of the heavenly nymphs; for they form my band of spies

units.sanskrit: तद् गच्छ सिद्ध्यै कुरु देवकार्यम् अर्थो ऽयम् अर्थान्तरभाव्य एव । अपेक्षते प्रत्ययम् उत्तमं त्वां बीजाङ्कुरः प्राग् उदयाद् इवाम्भः ॥
units.english: So then go to accomplish this business; do the work of the gods This purpose can only be attained by the achievment of another object it, therefore, has need of you as its primary cause as the sprouting up of a seed requires water before it can make its appearance

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् सुराणां विजयाभ्युपाये तवैव नामास्त्रगतिः कृती त्वम् । अप्य् अप्रसिद्धं यशसे हि पुंसाम् अनन्यसाधारणम् एव कर्म ॥
units.english: On him, the means of the attainment of victory by the gods, your missile only, we grant, has power; you are blessed; the performance of a deed, not accomplished by any other person, although unknown to fame, is the glory of men

units.sanskrit: सुराः समभ्यर्थयितार एते कार्यं त्रयाणाम् अपि विष्टपानाम् । चापेन ते कर्म न चातिहिंस्रम् अहो बतासि स्पृहणीयवीर्यः ॥
units.english: These gods are your suppliants; the business you have to accomplish is for the benefit of the three worlds; and the deed done by your bow is not very cruel O wonder! Your prowess is to be envied !!

units.sanskrit: मधुश् च ते मन्मथ साहचर्याद् आसव् अनुक्तो ऽपि सहाय एव । समीरणो नोदयिता भवेति व्यादिश्यते केन हुताशनस्य ॥
units.english: O disturber of the peace of mind, Spring Madhu is your helper, though unasked, through your comradeship Who asks the wind to be the fanner of fire lit, the devourer of the sacrificial offerings?

units.sanskrit: तथेति शेषाम् इव भर्तुर् आज्ञाम् आदाय मूर्ध्ना मदनः प्रतस्थे । ऐरावतास्फालनकर्कशेन हस्तेन पस्पर्श तदङ्गम् इन्द्रः ॥
units.english: With the words so be it, the God of love received on his head his masters command, like a garland offered as a gift of favour, and started; and Indra touched his body as a mark of special grace with his hand grown rough by stroking the Airàvata for encouragement

units.sanskrit: स माधवेनाभिमतेन सख्या रत्या च साशङ्कम् अनुप्रयातः । अङ्गव्ययप्रार्थितकार्यसिद्धिः स्थाण्वाश्रमं हैमवतं जगाम ॥
units.english: He went to the Himalayan resort of Sthânu Siva followed by Màdhava, his dear friend, and by Rati with apprehension, determined to effect the work even at the cost of his body

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् वने संयमिनां मुनीनां तपःसमाधेः प्रतिकूलवर्ती । संकल्पयोनेर् अभिमानभूतम् आत्मानम् आधाय मधुर् जजृम्भे ॥
units.english: In that forest Madhu the vernal season manifest ed himself having assumed his proper form, which was an object of pride to the mindborn One Kâma, acting antagonistically to the performance of austerities of the sages practising selfrestraint

units.sanskrit: कुबेरगुप्तां दिशम् उष्णरश्मौ गन्तुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलङ्घ्य । दिग् दक्षिणा गन्धवहं मुखेन व्यलीकनिःश्वासम् इवोत्ससर्ज ॥
units.english: When the hotrayed one sun began to go towards the quarter guarded by Kubera the North out of the proper season, the Southern quarter sent forth wind from her mouth like a sigh of anguish, Sidemeaning A certain kindhearted damsel heaved out a sigh of pain from her mouth, when her lover, an adventurous gallant, started to go to another woman, kept by some deformed person, having broken the engagement with her

units.sanskrit: असूत सद्यः कुसुमान्य् अशोकः स्कन्धात् प्रभृत्य् एव सपल्लवानि । पादेन नापैक्षत सुन्दरीणां संपर्कम् आसिञ्जितनूपुरेण ॥
units.english: Then the Asoka tree put forth at once flowers together with foliage just from its stem and did not wait for a touch from the feet of the fair jingling with anklets

units.sanskrit: सद्यः प्रवालोद्गमचारुपत्रे नीते समाप्तिं नवचूतबाणे । निवेशयाम् आस मधुर् द्विरेफान् नामाक्षराणीव मनोभवस्य ॥
units.english: The Vernal Season having fitted up the arrow of Káma in the shape of the young mango blossom with fresh leaves as its feathers, inscribed on it, as it were, the name of the Mindborn in the shape of the bees

units.sanskrit: वर्णप्रकर्षे सति कर्णिकारं दुनोति निर्गन्धतया स्म चेतः । प्रायेण सामग्र्यविधौ गुणानां पराङ्मुखी विश्वसृजः प्रवृत्तिः ॥
units.english: The Karnikára flower, though of gorgeous tints, pains the mind by its odourlessness; generally the mind of the Creator of the world is averse to bestowing completeness of qualities on a thing

units.sanskrit: बालेन्दुवक्राण्य् अविकासभावाद् बभुः पलाशान्य् अतिलोहितानि । सद्यो वसन्तेन समागतानां नखक्षतानीव वनस्थलीनाम् ॥
units.english: The Palâsa buds, extremely red and curved like the young moon, not being blossomed, shone like red marks of nails on the persons of the Forestsites then nnited with the Vernal Season their lover

units.sanskrit: लग्नद्विरेफाञ्जनभक्तिचित्रम् मुखे मधुश्रीस् तिलकं प्रकाश्य । रागेण बालारुणकोमलेन चूतप्रवालोष्ठम् अलंचकार ॥
units.english: The Vernal Beauty having displayed on her fore head a Tilaka the tilaka flower artistically painted with black pigment in the shape of the bees that swarmed over it, ornamented her lip of the young mango leaf with a red tint red lac mellow like the light of the morning sun

units.sanskrit: मृगाः प्रियालद्रुममञ्जरीणां रजःकणैर् विघ्नितदृष्टिपाताः । मदोद्धताः प्रत्यनिलं विचेरुर् वनस्थलीर् मर्मरपत्रमोक्षाः ॥
units.english: The fawns with their eyes blinded by the pollendust of the blossom of the Piyàla trees and intoxicated with passion, ran wildly against the wind in the forest glades, full of the murmur of falling leaves

units.sanskrit: चूताङ्कुरास्वादकषायकण्ठः पुंस्कोकिलो यन् मधुरं चुकूज । मनस्विनीमानविघातदक्षं तद् एव जातं वचनं स्मरस्य ॥ हिमव्यपायाद् विशदाधराणाम् आपाण्डुरीभूतमुखच्छवीनाम् । स्वेदोद्गमः किंपुरुषाङ्गनानां चक्रे पदं पत्रविशेषकेषु ॥
units.english: What strain of music was warbled out by the male Cuckoo, whose neck was red or, whose voice was impassioned by his feasting on the mango sprouts, became the mandate of Smara competent to break down the pride of highminded dames Perspiration made its appearance on the ornamental paintings on the persons of the Kinnara ladies, the complexion of whose faces was slightly yellow and whose lips looked bright not being smeared with wax or, after Malli were free from pain, owing to the passing away of the wintry season

units.sanskrit: तपस्विनः स्थाणुवनौकसस् ताम् आकालिकीं वीक्ष्य मधुप्रवृत्तिम् । प्रयत्नसंस्तम्भितविक्रियाणां कथं चिद् ईशा मनसां बभूवुः ॥
units.english: The ascetics, living in the forest of Siva the immovable one, seeing the untimely manifestation of spring could, with difficulty, be masters of their minds whose perturbation was curbed with great effort

units.sanskrit: तं देशम् आरोपितपुष्पचापे रतिद्वितीये मदने प्रपन्ने । काष्ठागतस्नेहरसानुविद्धं द्वन्द्वानि भावं क्रियया विवव्रुः ॥
units.english: When Madana reached that region, with Rati as his conipanion, and his flowerbow strung, all living things forming themselves into pairs manifested by their actions amorous feeling pervaded by the sentiment of love gone to excess

units.sanskrit: मधु द्विरेफः कुसुमैकपात्रे पपौ प्रियां स्वाम् अनुवर्तमानः । शृङ्गेण च स्पर्शनिमीलिताक्षीं मृगीम् अकण्डूयत कृष्णसारः ॥
units.english: The male bee, attentive to according to Malli, following his dear mate, drank honey from the same flowerbowl; and the black antelope scratched with his horn his female who had closed her eyes through the pleasant sensation caused by that touch

units.sanskrit: ददौ रसात् पङ्कजरेणुगन्धि गजाय गण्डूषजलं करेणुः । अर्धोपभुक्तेन बिसेन जायां संभावयाम् आस रथाङ्गनामा ॥
units.english: The female elephant, through great love, gave to the male the water held in her mouth, fragrant with the pollendust of lotuses The Chakrawâka having the name of the member of a chariot flattered his hen by giving her a lotusstalk half eaten by himself

units.sanskrit: गीतान्तरेषु श्रमवारिलेशैः किंचित्समुच्छ्वासितपत्रलेखम् । पुष्पासवाघूर्णितनेत्रशोभि प्रियामुखं किंपुरुषश् चुचुम्बे ॥ पर्याप्तपुष्पस्तबकस्तनाभ्यः स्फुरत्प्रवालौष्ठमनोहराभ्यः । लतावधूभ्यस् तरवो ऽप्य् अवापुर् विनम्रशाखाभुजबन्धनानि ॥
units.english: The Kimpurusha, in the intervals of music, kissed his beloveds face with the eyes attractive by rolling through intoxication caused by the floral wine, and having its paintings a little disfigured loosened by the drops of perspiration brought on by exertion The trees even received close clasps from the arms, in the shape of tender twigs, of the creeperwives, captivating with throbbing lips in the shape of young reddish sprouts and with breasts of the full clusters of flowers

units.sanskrit: श्रुताप्सरोगीतिर् अपि क्षणे ऽस्मिन् हरः प्रसंख्यानपरो बभूव । आत्मेश्वराणां न हि जातु विघ्नाः समाधिभेदप्रभवो भवन्ति ॥
units.english: Hara, though hearing the music of the heavenly damsels at such a time, remained absorbed in meditation; for never can obstacles break the Samadhi disturb the contemplation of those who have complete control over themselves

units.sanskrit: लतागृहद्वारगतो ऽथ नन्दी वामप्रकोष्ठार्पितहेमवेत्रः । मुखार्पितैकाङ्गुलिसंज्ञयैव मा चापलायेति गणान् व्यनैषीत् ॥ निष्कम्पवृक्षं निभृतद्विरेफं मूकाण्डजं शान्तमृगप्रचारम् । तच्छासनात् काननम् एव सर्वं चित्रार्पितारम्भम् इवावतस्थे ॥
units.english: Then Nandi, standing at the entrance of the creeperbower, with a gold staff resting against his left forearm, checked the Ganas, ordering them not to be mischievous by a sign of his forefinger placed on the mouth And at his bidding the whole forest itself stood with its movements committed to a painting as it were, the trees having ceased waving about, the swarms of bees having remained still, the birds having withheld their music, and the beasts having stopped roaming

units.sanskrit: दृष्टिप्रपातं परिहृत्य तस्य कामः पुरःशुक्रम् इव प्रयाणे । प्रान्तेषु संसक्तनमेरुशाखं ध्यानास्पदं भूतपतेर् विवेश ॥ स देवदारुद्रुमवेदिकायां शार्दूलचर्मव्यवधानवत्याम् । आसीनम् आसन्नशरीरपातस् त्र्यम्बकं संयमिनं ददर्श ॥
units.english: Having avoided his glance, as one does the quarter wherein shines Venus, when starting on a journey, Kama entered Sivas abode of contemplation, screened with the thickly interwoven branches of the Nameru trees all round He, the fall destruction of whose body was at hand, saw the Threeeyed God, absorbed in ascetic contemplation, seated on an altar of the Devadáru tree, covered over with a tigers skin

units.sanskrit: पर्यङ्कबन्धस्थिरपूर्वकायम् ऋज्वायतं संनमितोभयांसम् । उत्तानपाणिद्वयसंनिवेशात् प्रफुल्लराजीवम् इवाङ्कमध्ये ॥ भुजंगमोन्नद्धजटाकलापं कर्णावसक्तद्विगुणाक्षसूत्रम् । कण्ठप्रभासङ्गविशेषनीलां कृष्णत्वचं ग्रन्थिमतीं दधानम् ॥
units.english: The forepart of whose body was steady owing to the posture called Vfrâsana, who was sitting straight and fully drawn, both of whose shoulders were a little bent, and in whose lap there lay as it were a full blown lotus, owing to his two hands being placed there with the palms turned upwards The mass of whose matted hair was gathered upwards and tied with a serpent, who had a double string of Rudrakshas hanging down from his ears, and who wore a black antelopes hide with knots, appearing still more darkish on account of the complexion of his neck;

units.sanskrit: किंचित्प्रकाशस्तिमितोग्रतारैर् भ्रूविक्रियायां विरतप्रसङ्गैः । नेत्रैर् अविस्पन्दितपक्ष्ममालैर् लक्ष्यीकृतघ्राणम् अधोमयूखैः ॥ अवृष्टिसंरम्भम् इवाम्बुवाहम् अपाम् इवाधारम् अनुत्तरङ्गम् । अन्तश्चराणां मरुतां निरोधान् निवातनिष्कम्पम् इव प्रदीपम् ॥
units.english: Who was looking steadfastly at the tip of his nose with his eyes, the fierce pupils of which were motioness and shining out a little, and which had desisted from the habit of kniting the brows, the thick lashes of which were not moving and the vision of which was turned downwards; Who, on account of the suspension of the vital airs the airs moving inside, appeared like a cloud not blustering up to burst into a shower, or like a reservoir of water unruffled with ripples or like a lamp burning steady in a place free from wind;

units.sanskrit: कपालनेत्रान्तरलब्धमार्गैर् ज्योतिःप्ररोहैर् उदितैः शिरस्तः । मृणालसूत्राधिकसौकुमार्यां बालस्य लक्ष्मीं ग्लपयन्तम् इन्दोः ॥
units.english: Who was putting into shade the grace softer than that of the lotus fibres, of the young moon, by the rays of light shooting forth from the head, having got a passage through the eye in the cranium;

units.sanskrit: मनो नवद्वारनिषिद्धवृत्ति हृदि व्यवस्थाप्य समाधिवश्यम् । यम् अक्षरं क्षेत्रविदो विदुस् तम् आत्मानम् आत्मन्य् अवलोकयन्तम् ॥
units.english: Who, having fixed in his heart the mind, with its operations through the nine gates of sense entirely sus pended and completely under the influence of concentration, was realising in himself his own self, whom the seers call the Eternal

units.sanskrit: स्मरस् तथाभूतम् अयुग्मनेत्रं पश्यन्न् अदूरान् मनसाप्य् अधृष्यम् । नालक्षयत् साध्वससन्नहस्तः स्रस्तं शरं चापम् अपि स्वहस्तात् ॥
units.english: Smara Cupid, while looking at him, the threeeyed one, not to be assailed even in thought, in that posture, his hand drooping through fear, did not notice the bow and arrow dropped down from his hand

units.sanskrit: निर्वाणभूयिष्ठम् अथास्य वीर्यं संधुक्षयन्तीव वपुर्गुणेन । अनुप्रयाता वनदेवताभ्याम् अदृश्यत स्थावरराजकन्या ॥
units.english: Just then was seen the daughter of the Lord of immovables Himalaya accompanied by the sylvan deities, reviving, as it were, his prowess, almost deadened, by the beauty of her person;

units.sanskrit: अशोकनिर्भर्त्सितपद्मरागम् आकृष्टहेमद्युतिकर्णिकारम् । मुक्ताकलापीकृतसिन्दुवारं वसन्तपुष्पाभरणं वहन्ती ॥ आवर्जिता किं चिद् इव स्तनाभ्यां वासो वसाना तरुणार्करागम् । पर्याप्तपुष्पस्तबकावनम्रा संचारिणी पल्लविनी लतेव ॥
units.english: Who wore a decoration of the spring flowers, the As oka flowers in which put into shade the rubies, the Karnika ras bore the lustre of gold and the Sindhuvaras shone like a necklace of pearls; Who stooped a little with the weight of her breasts, and wore a garment of the hue of the morning sun, thus looking like a walking creeper covered with folige and bending under the breastlike clusters of flowers;

units.sanskrit: स्रस्तां नितम्बाद् अवलम्बमाना पुनःपुनः केसरदामकाञ्चीम् । न्यासीकृतां स्थानविदा स्मरेण मौर्वीं द्वितीयाम् इव कार्मुकस्य ॥ सुगन्धिनिःश्वासविवृद्धतृष्णं बिम्बाधरासन्नचरं द्विरेफम् । प्रतिक्षणं संभ्रमलोलदृष्टिर् लीलारविन्देन निवारयन्ती ॥ तां वीक्ष्य सर्वावयवानवद्यां रतेर् अपि ह्रीपदम् आदधानाम् । जितेन्द्रिये शूलिनि पुष्पचापः स्वकार्यसिद्धिं पुनर् आशशंसे ॥
units.english: Who was drawing up with her hand again and again the zone, composed of Bakula flowers, slipping down her hips, which was, as it were, a second string for his bow deposited there by Smara who knew the appropriate place for it; And who, her eyes agitated through confusion, was keeping off, every moment, with a sportive lotus, a bee hovering round her Bimbalike nether lip, with its thirst desire excited by her fragrant breath On seeing her, faultless in all her limbs, and a standing shame even to Rati, the flowerarrowed god again hoped for the accomplishment of his object respecting the Tridentholder who had conquered his senses

units.sanskrit: भविष्यतः पत्युर् उमा च शंभोः समाससाद प्रतिहारभूमिम् । योगात् स चान्तः परमात्मसंज्ञं दृष्ट्वा परं ज्योतिर् उपारराम ॥
units.english: Uma approached the entrance of the abode of Sambhu, her future lord; and at the same time, he too, having realised in himself the eternal light called Parmatman desisted from contemplation broke the Sama dhi

units.sanskrit: ततो भुजंगाधिपतेः फणाग्रैर् अधः कथं चिद् धृतभूमिभागः । शनैः कृतप्राणविमुक्तिर् ईशः पर्यङ्कबन्धं निबिडं बिभेद ॥ तस्मै शशंस प्रणिपत्य नन्दी शुश्रूषया शैलसुताम् उपेताम् । प्रवेशयाम् आस च भर्तुर् एनां भ्रूक्षेपमात्रानुमतप्रवेशाम् ॥
units.english: Then the Lord, slowly releasing all the vital airs in the body, the portion of the earth under him being, with great difficulty, upborne with the tops of his hoods by the lord of serpents, loosened the firm Virasana To him, Nandi, having saluted, announced the coming of the daughter of the Mountainlord through the desire of waiting upon him, and ushered her into the presence of his lord, her admittance being permitted with a mere sign of the eyebrow

units.sanskrit: तस्याः सखीभ्यां प्रणिपातपूर्वं स्वहस्तलूनः शिशिरात्ययस्य । व्यकीर्यत त्र्यम्बकपादमूले पुष्पोच्चयः पल्लवभङ्गभिन्नः ॥ उमापि नीलालकमध्यशोभि विस्रंसयन्ती नवकर्णिकारम् । चकार कर्णच्युतपल्लवेन मूर्ध्ना प्रणामं वृषभध्वजाय ॥
units.english: By her two friends was scattered a collection of spring flowers, mixed with bits of leaves gathered with their own hands, at the feet of the Threeeyed God, with a bow Umà made a bow to the Bullemblemed God with her head, when the tender leaf on the ear dropped down and the fresh Karinkara flowers shining in the midst of her black tresses got loosened

units.sanskrit: अनन्यभाजं पतिम् आप्नुहीति सा तथ्यम् एवाभिहिता भवेन । न हीश्वरव्याहृतयः कदा चित् पुष्यन्ति लोके विपरीतम् अर्थम् ॥
units.english: She was indeed told the truth by Bhava when he said do yoge t a husband, who will not attend to another woman the words of the mighty do not foster a sense contrary to their meaning in this world

units.sanskrit: कामस् तु बाणावसरं प्रतीक्ष्य पतङ्गवद् वह्निमुखं विविक्षुः । उमासमक्षं हरबद्धलक्ष्यः शरासनज्यां मुहुर् आममर्श ॥
units.english: Kàma, having seized this as the proper opportunity for discharging his arrow, being as if desirous of entering the fire like a moth, touched again and again the string of his bow, having flxed his eye on Hara, while Uma stood hard by in the presence of Uma

units.sanskrit: अथोपनिन्ये गिरिशाय गौरी तपस्विने ताम्ररुचा करेण । विशोषितां भानुमतो मयूखैर् मन्दाकिनीपुष्करबीजमालाम् ॥
units.english: Then Gauri offered to Girisha, given to asceti cism, a rosary of the seeds of lotuses grown in the Mandakini and dried up by the rays of the sun, with a hand of a rosy colour

units.sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहीतुं प्रणयिप्रियत्वात् त्रिलोचनस् ताम् उपचक्रमे च । संमोहनं नाम च पुष्पधन्वा धनुष्य् अमोघं समधत्त बाणम् ॥
units.english: The threeeyed God through love for devotees made ready to take that rosary, and the very moment the flowerarrowed God placed on the bow his unfailing arrow called Sammohana the captivator

units.sanskrit: हरस् तु किंचित्परिलुप्तधैर्यश् चन्द्रोदयारम्भ इवाम्बुराशिः । उमामुखे बिम्बफलाधरोष्ठे व्यापारयाम् आस विलोचनानि ॥ विवृण्वती शैलसुतापि भावम् अङ्गैः स्फुरद्बालकदम्बकल्पैः । साचीकृता चारुतरेण तस्थौ मुखेन पर्यस्तविलोचनेन ॥
units.english: Hara, his firmness a little shaken, as is the sea agitated at the rising of the moon, cast his eyes on Umas face, the lower lip of which was like the Bimba fruit The daughter of the Mountain too, betraying her emotion by limbs that looked like the blooming Kadamba flowers on account of the hair standing on end, stood with a half averted face, lovelier still and with the eyes agitated through shyness

units.sanskrit: अथेन्द्रियक्षोभम् अयुग्मनेत्रः पुनर् वशित्वाद् बलवन् निगृह्य । हेतुं स्वचेतोविकृतेर् दिदृक्षुर् दिशाम् उपान्तेषु ससर्ज दृष्टिम् ॥ स दक्षिणापाङ्गनिविष्टमुष्टिं नतांसम् आकुञ्चितसव्यपादम् । ददर्श चक्रीकृतचारुचापं प्रहर्तुम् अभ्युद्यतम् आत्मयोनिम् ॥
units.english: Then Siva, having strongly restrained the perturbation of his senses by means of his perfect selfcontrol, and desiring to find out the cause of the disturbance of his heart, directed his eye towards the directions Then he saw the mindborn one, his clenched fist resting on the corner of his left eye, his shoulders bent forward and his left foot drawn in, ready to strike with his beautiful bow stretched to the figure of a circle

units.sanskrit: तपःपरामर्शविवृद्धमन्योर् भ्रूभङ्गदुष्प्रेक्ष्यमुखस्य तस्य । स्फुरन्न् उदर्चिः सहसा तृतीयाद् अक्ष्णः कृशानुः किल निष्पपात ॥
units.english: All at once a blazing fire with rising flames sprang from the third eye of him, whose ire was roused by the disturbance to his austerities, and whose face was terrible to look at owing to the knitting of the eyebrows

units.sanskrit: क्रोधं प्रभो संहर संहरेति यावद् गिरः खे मरुतां चरन्ति । तावत् स वह्निर् भवनेत्रजन्मा भस्मावशेषं मदनं चकार ॥
units.english: Ere the cries of the godsRestrain thy ire, restrain thy ire, O Lordcould rise in the sky, the fire, born of the eye of Bhava, left only the ashes of Madana

units.sanskrit: तीव्राभिषङ्गप्रभवेण वृत्तिम् मोहेन संस्तम्भयतेन्द्रियाणाम् । अज्ञातभर्तृव्यसना मुहूर्तं कृतोपकारेव रतिर् बभूव ॥
units.english: And Rati, who for a time stood unconscious of the death of her husband, had a favour conferred upon her as it were by the swoon, which, occasioned by the sharp discomfiture, stifled all operations of her senses

units.sanskrit: तम् आशु विघ्नं तपसस् तपस्वी वनस्पतिं वज्र इवावभज्य । स्त्रीसंनिकर्षं परिहर्तुम् इच्छन्न् अन्तर्दधे भूतपतिः सभूतः ॥ शैलात्मजापि पितुर् उच्छिरसो ऽभिलाषं व्यर्थं समर्थ्य ललितं वपुर् आत्मनश् च । सख्योः समक्षम् इति चाधिकजातलज्जा शून्या जगाम भवनाभिमुखी कथं चित् ॥
units.english: Having quickly destroyed him, the obstacle to his austerities, as the bolt of Indra does a tree, the Great ascetic, the Lord of beings, together with his followers, vanished from sight, in order to avoid the vicinity of women The daughter of the Mountain knowing the desire of her exalted father as well as her lovely body to be vain, overwhelmed with shame all the more, because it happened in the presence of her two friends, somehow or other went homeward, like one dazed

units.sanskrit: सपदि मुकुलिताक्षीं रुद्रसंरम्भभीत्या दुहितरम् अनुकम्प्याम् अद्रिर् आदाय दोर्भ्याम् । सुरगज इव बिभ्रत् पद्मिनीं दन्तलग्नां प्रतिपथगतिर् आसीद् वेगदीर्घीकृताङ्गः ॥
units.english: Just then the Mountain, having taken into his arms his daughter who deserved to be sympathised with and who had closed her eyes in fear of the anger of Bhava, went along the path, as does the elephant of the gods holding a lotus sticking to his tusk, with his body stretched to its full length on account of his great speed

units.sanskrit: अथ मोहपरायणा सती विवशा कामवधूर् विबोधिता । विधिना प्रतिपादयिष्यता नववैधव्यम् असह्यवेदनम् ॥
units.english: Then the wife of Káma, who was beside herself, being entirely in the power of the trance, was awakened by Destiny, wishing to make her experience new widowhood with its unbearable pangs

units.sanskrit: अवधानपरे चकार सा प्रलयान्तोन्मिषिते विलोचने । न विवेद तयोर् अतृप्तयोः प्रियम् अत्यन्तविलुप्तदर्शनम् ॥
units.english: She made her eyes, opened at the close of the swoon, gaze attentively, but she did not know that the sight of her dear lord was for ever lost to her neversatiated eyes

units.sanskrit: अयि जीवितनाथ जीवसीत्य् अभिधायोत्थितया तया पुरः । ददृशे पुरुषाकृति क्षितौ हरकोपानलभस्म केवलम् ॥
units.english: O Lord of my life, art thou alive, so saying she got up; but she saw on the ground, merely a heap of asbes, in a mans shape, due to the fire of the anger of Hara

units.sanskrit: अथ सा पुनर् एव विह्वला वसुधालिङ्गनधूसरस्तनी । विललाप विकीर्णमूर्धजा समदुःखाम् इव कुर्वती स्थलीम् ॥
units.english: Then she, again distracted with griet, her breasts dusty from the touch of the ground, and her hair dishevelled, wailed, as if making the region the living creatures share her grief equally miserable

units.sanskrit: उपमानम् अभूद् विलासिनां करणं यत् तव कान्तिमत्तया । तद् इदं गतम् ईदृशीं दशां न विदीर्ये कठिनाः खलु स्त्रियः ॥
units.english: Thy body, which served as a sample for all amor ous persons by its resplendency handsomeness, has been reduced to this condition, and yet do not burst through grief! Hardhearted, indeed, must be women!

units.sanskrit: क्व नु मां त्वदधीनजीवितां विनिकीर्य क्षणभिन्नसौहृदः । नलिनीं क्षतसेतुबन्धनो जलसंघात इवासि विद्रुतः ॥
units.english: Where hast thou fled, abruptly leaving me whose very life depends upon thee, forgetting thy love in a moment, as does a torrent of water throwing up a lotus after breaking down a dam ?

units.sanskrit: कृतवान् असि विप्रियं न मे प्रतिकूलं न च ते मया कृतम् । किम् अकारणम् एव दर्शनं विलपन्त्यै रतये न दीयते ॥ स्मरसि स्मर मेखलागुणैर् उत गोत्रस्खलितेषु बन्धनम् । च्युतकेशरदूषितेक्षणान्य् अवतंसोत्पलताडनानि वा ॥
units.english: Thou hast never done anything that would displease me, nor have ever acted contrary to thy wishes why is it, then, that, without cause, thou dost not present a sight of thee to thy Rati who is lamenting thy loss? Dost thou remember, O Smara, my binding thee with the strings of my waist band whenever was addressed with a wrong name by thee, or my beatings of thee with lotuses used as ear ornaments, hurting thy eyes with pollendust dropping from them?

units.sanskrit: हृदये वससीति मत्प्रियं यद् अवोचस् तद् अवैमि कैतवम् । उपचारपदं न चेद् इदं त्वम् अनङ्गः कथम् अक्षता रतिः ॥
units.english: know the speech which thou wouldst utter to please me thou dwellest in my heart to be false; if it was not an empty compliment, how is it that thou art without a body, and Rati uninjured?

units.sanskrit: परलोकनवप्रवासिनः प्रतिपत्स्ये पदवीम् अहं तव । विधिना जन एष वञ्चितस् त्वदधीनं खलु देहिनां सुखम् ॥
units.english: will follow the path of thee who hast started on a new journey to the other world; but this world is cheated of its pleasure by Vidhi the happiness of embodied belngs does, indeed, depend on thee

units.sanskrit: रजनीतिमिरावगुण्ठिते पुरमार्गे घनशब्दविक्लवाः । वसतिं प्रिय कामिनां प्रियास् त्वद् ऋते प्रापयितुं क ईश्वरः ॥
units.english: Who else but thee, O beloved, can enable the sweethearts terrified by the thunder of the clouds, to reach the houses of their lovers, when the roads of the cities are shrouded in nocturnal darkness?

units.sanskrit: नयनान्य् अरुणानि घूर्णयन् वचनानि स्खलयन् पदेपदे । असति त्वयि वारुणीमदः प्रमदानाम् अधुना विडम्बना ॥
units.english: The intoxication of the young damsels by wine is now a mockery when thou hast ceased to existthe intoxication that makes the red eyes roll from side to side and the words falter at every step

units.sanskrit: अवगम्य कथीकृतं वपुः प्रियबन्धोस् तव निष्फलोदयः । बहुले ऽपि गते निशाकरस् तनुतां दुःखम् अनङ्ग मोक्ष्यति ॥
units.english: O bodiless one, the Moon, knowing that the body of thee, his dear friend, has become a subjectmatter of tales only and that his appearance in the sky useless, will, with great relutance, give up his thinness, even when the dark half has passed away

units.sanskrit: हरितारुणचारुबन्धनः कलपुंस्कोकिलशब्दसूचितः । वद संप्रति कस्य बाणतां नवचूतप्रसवो गमिष्यति ॥
units.english: Say by whom will the fresh blossom of the mango tree, the beautiful stem of which is reddish green and the sprouting of which is proclaimed by the notes of the malecuckoo, be used as his arrow?

units.sanskrit: अलिपङ्क्तिर् अनेकशस् त्वया गुणकृत्ये धनुषो नियोजिता । विरुतैः करुणस्वनैर् इयं गुरुशोकाम् अनुरोदितीव माम् ॥ प्रतिपद्य मनोहरं वपुः पुनर् अप्य् आदिश तावद् उत्थितः । रतिदूतिपदेषु कोकिलां मधुरालापनिसर्गपण्डिताम् ॥
units.english: The swarm of bees, which was many a time used as a string for thy bow by thee, seems by its humnings, in piteous tones, as if to sympathise with me, whose distress is great Rise again, recovering thy graceful form, and once more appoint the koel, naturally clever in sweet persuasive talk, to the post of a messenger in love

units.sanskrit: शिरसा प्रणिपत्य याचितान्य् उपगूढानि सवेपथूनि च । सुरतानि च तानि ते रहः स्मर संस्मृत्य न शान्तिर् अस्ति मे ॥
units.english: There is no peace for me, O Smara, remembering as do, our secret sportings, so familiar to us, and embracings, accompanied by tremour, solicited by howing down the head

units.sanskrit: रचितं रतिपण्डित त्वया स्वयम् अङ्गेषु ममेदम् आर्तवम् । ध्रियते कुसुमप्रसाधनं तव तच् चारु वपुर् न दृश्यते ॥
units.english: O thou expert in lovematters, here bear on my person the vernal decoration of flowers arranged by thyself, but that beautiful body of thine is not to be seen

units.sanskrit: विबुधैर् असि यस्य दारुणैर् असमाप्ते परिकर्मणि स्मृतः । तम् इमं कुरु दक्षिणेतरं चरणं निर्मितरागम् एहि मे ॥ अहम् एत्य पतङ्गवर्त्मना पुनर् अङ्काश्रयिणी भवामि ते । चतुरैः सुरकामिनीजनैः प्रिय यावन् न विलोभ्यसे दिवि ॥
units.english: Come then, and finish the colouring of my left foot, other than the right one before finishing the decoration of which, thou wast called away by being remembered by the cruel gods As long as thou art not deceived into loving them in heaven, O dear, by the artful damsels of heaven, will come to sit once more on thy lap, following thee by the way of locusts burning myself on the funeral pyre

units.sanskrit: मदनेन विनाकृता रतिः क्षणमात्रं किल जीवितेति मे । वचनीयम् इदं व्यवस्थितं रमण त्वाम् अनुयामि यद्य् अपि ॥
units.english: O beloved, though follow thee, this reproach will stand that , Rati, bereaved of Madana, lived though for a moment only

units.sanskrit: क्रियतां कथम् अन्त्यमण्डनं परलोकान्तरितस्य ते मया । समम् एव गतो ऽस्य् अतर्कितां गतिम् अङ्गेन च जीवितेन च ॥
units.english: How can the last decorations be done by me for thee, who hast gone to another world? For thou hast been reduced to an unthoughtof condition by simultaneously losing both thy life and body

units.sanskrit: ऋजुतां नयतः स्मरामि ते शरम् उत्सङ्गनिषण्णधन्वनः । मधुना सह सस्मितं कथां नयनोपान्तविलोकितं च यत् ॥
units.english: remember thy merry talk accompanied with smiles with, and casting a sideglance looking from the cornor of the eyes at Madhu, as thou wast straightening the arrow, with the bow stationed on thy lap

units.sanskrit: क्व नु ते हृदयंगमः सखा कुसुमायोजितकार्मुको मधुः । न खलूग्ररुषा पिनाकिना गमितः सो ऽपि सुहृद्गतां गतिम् ॥ अथ तैः परिदेविताक्षरैर् हृदये दिग्धशरैर् इवार्दितः । रतिम् अभ्युपपत्तुम् आतुरां मधुर् आत्मानम् अदर्शयत् पुरः ॥
units.english: Where is thy friend, Madhu, the delight of thy heart, who shaped thy bow with flowers? Or alas, can if be that he, too, is sent along the path taken by his friend by the Tridentholder whose wrath is dreadful? Madhu, cut at heart by her cries of woe, as by venomed arrows, discovered himself in the front of the woestriken Rati to console her

units.sanskrit: तम् अवेक्ष्य रुरोद सा भृशं स्तनसंबाधम् उरो जघान च । स्वजनस्य हि दुःखम् अग्रतो विवृतद्वारम् इवोपजायते ॥ इति चैनम् उवाच दुःखिता सुहृदः पश्य वसन्त किं स्थितम् । यद् इदं कणशः प्रकीर्यते पवनैर् भस्म कपोतकर्बुरम् ॥
units.english: On seeing him she wept bitterly and beat her bosom so as to oppress her breasts; misery breaks out as if opening her floodgates in the presence of ones connections a Kinsman or a friend Smitten with grief she thus said to himLook, O Vasanta, what has remained of thy friend

units.sanskrit: अयि संप्रति देहि दर्शनं स्मर पर्युत्सुक एष माधवः । दयितास्व् अनवस्थितं नृणां न खलु प्रेम चलं सुहृज्जने ॥
units.english: Now reveal thyself to us, O Smara This Màdhava longs to behold thee; the love of meu may be fickle to women, but it can not be so towards a friend

units.sanskrit: अमुना ननु पार्श्ववर्तिना जगद् आज्ञां ससुरासुरं तव । बिसतन्तुगुणस्य कारितं धनुषः पेलवपुष्पपत्रिणः ॥
units.english: By this thy comrade one who is always by the side the whole world, including the gods and the demons, is forced to own the empire of thy bow, the string of which is the lotusfibre, and the arrows delicate flowers

units.sanskrit: गत एव न ते निवर्तते स सखा दीप इवानिलाहतः । अहम् अस्य दशेव पश्य माम् अविषह्यव्यसनप्रधूषिताम् ॥ विधिना कृतम् अर्धवैशसं ननु माम् कामवधे विमुञ्चता । अनघापि हि संश्रयद्रुमे गजभग्ने पतनाय वल्लरी ॥
units.english: Gone is that friend of thine; he comes not back, as a lamp put out by the blast of wind; am as it were the wick of this lamp; behold me enveloped in the smoke of unbearable misery Fate, sparing me while killing Káma, has only done half the butchery; when the firm supporting tree is broken by an elephant the creeper hanging by it tends is bound to come down

units.sanskrit: तद् इदं क्रियताम् अनन्तरं भवता बन्धुजनप्रयोजनम् । विधुरां ज्वलनातिसर्जनान् ननु मां प्रापय पत्युर् अन्तिकम् ॥
units.english: Therefore let this duty by a friend, which comes next, be done by thee; pray, send me, who am afflicted, to my husband, by consigning me to the funeral fire

units.sanskrit: शशिना सह याति कौमुदी सह मेघेन तडित् प्रलीयते । प्रमदाः पतिवर्त्मगा इति प्रतिपन्नं हि विचेतनैर् अपि ॥
units.english: The moonlight passes away with the moon, and the lightning vanishes with the clouds; that a wife has to go by the way the husband has gone is thus admitted even by lifeless things

units.sanskrit: अमुनैव कषायितस्तनी सुभगेन प्रियगात्रभस्मना । नवपल्लवसंस्तरे यथा रचयिष्यामि तनुं विभावसौ ॥
units.english: Besmearing my breasts with these ashes of the body of my beloved, shall lay my body on the fire as if on a bed of young leaves

units.sanskrit: कुसुमास्तरणे सहायतां बहुशः सौम्य गतस् त्वम् आवयोः । कुरु संप्रति तावद् आशु मे प्रणिपाताञ्जलियाचितश् चिताम् ॥ तद् अनु ज्वलनं मदर्पितं त्वरयेर् दक्षिणवातवीजनैः । विदितं खलु ते यथा स्मरः क्षणम् अप्य् उत्सहते न मां विना ॥
units.english: O gentle one, thou hast many a time helped making up our bed of flowers; do thou now pile up a pyre quickly, urged to do so with a bow with joined palms After that, coax the fire set to me by fannings in the shape of the south winds that it should burn quickly; it is indeed known to thee that Smara can not bear to live without me even for a moment

units.sanskrit: इति चापि विधाय दीयतां सलिलस्याञ्जलिर् एक एव नौ । अविभज्य परत्र तं मया सहितः पास्यति ते स बान्धवः ॥
units.english: Having done so, offer one handful of water for us two; that thy friend, together with me, will drink undivided in the other world

units.sanskrit: परलोकविधौ च माधव स्मरम् उद्दिश्य विलोलपल्लवाः । निवपेः सहकारमञ्जरीः प्रियचूतप्रसवो हि ते सखा ॥
units.english: On Mádhava, in the ceremony afterdeath for Smara offer the spray of mango blossom, the leaves of which are licmulous; for the mango blossom was dear to thy friend

units.sanskrit: इति देवविमुक्तये स्थितां रतिम् आकाशभवा सरस्वती । शफरीं ह्रदशोषविक्लवां प्रथमा वृष्टिर् इवान्वकम्पत ॥
units.english: A speech, breathed in the sky, comforted Rati, thus prepared to abandon her life; as does the first shower comfort a fish distressed by the drying up of a pond

units.sanskrit: कुसुमायुधपत्नि दुर्लभस् तव भर्ता न चिराद् भविष्यति । शृणु येन स कर्मणा गतः शलभत्वं हरलोचनार्चिषि ॥
units.english: O thou, wife of the flowerweaponed god, thy husband shall not be long unobtainable to thee listen how he came to the plight of a locust in the flame of the fire sprung from the eye of Hara

units.sanskrit: अभिलाषम् उदीरितेन्द्रियः स्वसुतायाम् अकरोत् प्रजापतिः । अथ तेन निगृह्य विक्रियाम् अभिशप्तः फलम् एतद् अन्वभूत् ॥
units.english: Prajapati the lord of creation felt a lustful desire for his own daughter, his senses being excited by Kâma; he, then, having curbed the excitement, cursed Káma, who has thus experienced the fruit of his own act

units.sanskrit: परिणेष्यति पार्वतीं यदा तपसा तत्प्रवणीकृतो हरः । उपलब्धसुखस् तदा स्मरं वपुषा स्वेन नियोजयिष्यति ॥
