units.english: When Hara, made to look upon her with favour by her austerities, will lead Pàrvati to the altar, then having got back his own bliss, he will unite Smara again with his form

units.sanskrit: इति चाह स धर्मयाचितः स्मरशापावधिदां सरस्वतीम् । अशनेर् अमृतस्य चोभयोर् वशिनश् चाम्बुधराश् च योनयः ॥
units.english: Thus did god Brahmâ, when begged by Dharma, deliver a speech setting forth a limit to Smaras curse the selfrestrained and the clouds are the sources of both, Ashani and Amrit lightning and water curses and favours ;

units.sanskrit: तद् इदं परिरक्ष शोभने भवितव्यप्रियसंगमं वपुः । रविपीतजला तपात्यये पुनर् ओघेन हि युज्यते नदी ॥
units.english: So, O sweet woman, preserve this body which will be reunited with thy husband a river, the water of which is drunk up by the sun, is again joined with a fresh current in the rainy season

units.sanskrit: इत्थं रतेः किम् अपि भूतम् अदृश्यरूपं मन्दीचकार मरणव्यवसायबुद्धिम् । तत्प्रत्ययाच् च कुसुमायुधबन्धुर् एनाम् आश्वासयत् सुचरितार्थपदैर् वचोभिः ॥ अथ मदनवधूर् उपप्लवान्तं व्यसनकृशा परिपालयां बभूव । शशिन इव दिवातनस्य लेखा किरणपरिक्षयधूसरा प्रदोषम् ॥
units.english: Thus did some being of unseen form discourage Ratis idea of seeking her death, and through a belief in that the friend of the flowerweaponed god voice spring lit, consoled her with words replete with good sense Then the wife of Madana lived, thinned by her misery, awaiting the end of the calamity just as the crescent of the moon appearing by day and looking pale through the loss of rays, awaits the coming of the eveningACT

units.sanskrit: तथा समक्षं दहता मनोभवं पिनाकिना भग्नमनोरथा सती । निनिन्द रूपं हृदयेन पार्वती प्रियेषु सौभाग्यफला हि चारुता ॥ इयेष सा कर्तुम् अवन्ध्यरूपतां समाधिम् आस्थाय तपोभिर् आत्मनः । अवाप्यते वा कथम् अन्यथा द्वयं तथाविधं प्रेम पतिश् च तादृशः ॥
units.english: Parvati, baffled in her hopes by the Tridentholde burning, in that manner, the mindborn deity in her presence, cursed her beauty in her heart for beauty has for its guerdon good fortune as regards the being liked by ones beloved She wished to make her beauty fruitful by austeritdes, having recourse to concentration; how else, could she secure the two things such love and a husband of that kind

units.sanskrit: निशम्य चैनां तपसे कृतोद्यमां सुतां गिरीशप्रतिसक्तमानसाम् । उवाच मेना परिरभ्य वक्षसा निवारयन्ती महतो मुनिव्रतात् ॥
units.english: Mená, hearing that her daughter, who had set her heart on Girisá, was resolved to practise penance, clasped her to her bosom, and spoke dissuading her from the difficult practice of asceticism

units.sanskrit: मनीषिताः सन्ति गृहे ऽपि देवतास् तपः क्व वत्से क्व च तावकं वपुः । पदं सहेत भ्रमरस्य पेलवं शिरीशपुष्पं न पुनः पतत्रिणः ॥
units.english: In the house are deities such as the heart would desire what a wide difference is there between austerities and thy body The delicate Sirisha flower can bear the tread of a bee but not that of a bird

units.sanskrit: इति ध्रुवेच्छाम् अनुशासती सुतां शशाक मेना न नियन्तुम् उद्यमात् । क ईप्सितार्थस्थिरनिश्चयं मनः पयश् च निम्नाभिमुखं प्रतीपयेत् ॥
units.english: Menâ, though thus exhorting her daughter, whose desire was inflexible, could not dissuade her from her resolve who can make a mind firm in its resolution to achieve a desired object or turn back water rushing towards a low ground

units.sanskrit: कदा चिद् आसन्नसखीमुखेन सा मनोरथज्ञं पितरं मनस्विनी । अयाचतारण्यनिवासम् आत्मनः फलोदयान्ताय तपःसमाधये ॥
units.english: On one occasion that steadyminded girl, begged of her father, who knew her desire, a residence permission to dwell in the forest to perform religious austerities till their fruition, through a friend who was her confidante

units.sanskrit: अथानुरूपाभिनिवेशतोषिणा कृताभ्यनुज्ञा गुरुणा गरीयसा । प्रजासु पश्चात् प्रथितं तदाख्यया जगाम गौरी शिखरं शिखण्डिमत् ॥ विमुच्य सा हारम् अहार्यनिश्चया विलोलयष्टिप्रविलुप्तचन्दनम् । बबन्ध बालारुणबभ्रु वल्कलं पयोधरोत्सेधविशीर्णसंहति ॥
units.english: Keing granted permission by her great father, delighted in a persistence worthy of her, she repaired to a peak, full of peacocks, which came to be known by he? nave ever afterwards among the people She, of nevertobe shaken disposition, having given her necklace, which rubbed away the sandal paste or her breast by its threads, wore a bark garment, tawny like the morning sun, the close union of which with the body was Į revenied by the elevated breasts

units.sanskrit: यथा प्रसिद्धैर् मधुरं शिरोरुहैर् जटाभिर् अप्य् एवम् अभूत् तदाननम् । न शट्पदश्रेणिभिर् एव पङ्कजं सशैवलासङ्गम् अपि प्रकाशते ॥
units.english: As her face looked pretty by her decorated tresses so it did by the matted hair also; a lotus does not look beautiful only by the swarms of bees but even by its union with moss

units.sanskrit: प्रतिक्षणं सा कृतरोमविक्रियां व्रताय मौञ्जीं त्रिगुणां बभार याम् । अकारि तत्पूर्वनिबद्धया तया सरागम् अस्या रसनागुणास्पदम् ॥
units.english: By that string of Munja grass having three threads, which she wore for her penance and which by its harsh touch caused her hair to stand erect every moment, was the place of the waistband made red, being fastened there for the first time on that occasion

units.sanskrit: विसृष्टरागाद् अधरान् निवर्तितः स्तनाङ्गरागारुणिताच् च कन्दुकात् । कुशाङ्कुरादानपरिक्षताङ्गुलिः कृतो ऽक्षसूत्रप्रणयी तया करः ॥
units.english: By her hand, turned away from no longer employed in painting the nether lip from which the red colour had disappeared, and from the ball becoming red by the anguent of the breasts, and with the fingers pricked by plucking the tender blades of Kusa grass, was made the friend of the rosary of Aksbas

units.sanskrit: महार्हशय्यापरिवर्तनच्युतैः स्वकेशपुष्पैर् अपि या स्म दूयते । अशेत सा बाहुलतोपधायिनी निषेदुषी स्थण्डिल एव केवले ॥
units.english: She, who would experience pain even by the flowers dropped down from her hair in her rollings on her costly bed, sat and lay down now on the bare earthplat form using her creeperlike arm as a pillow

units.sanskrit: पुनर् ग्रहीतुं नियमस्थया तया द्वये ऽपि निक्षेप इवार्पितम् द्वयम् । लतासु तन्वीषु विलासचेष्टितं विलोलदृष्टं हरिणाङ्गनासु च ॥
units.english: By her who was under the vow, had been left as a deposit to be taken back, the two things with the two zi, her sportive gestures with the slender creepers, and her unsteady glances with the female deer

units.sanskrit: अतन्द्रिता सा स्वयम् एव वृक्षकान् घटस्तनप्रस्रवणैर् व्यवर्धयत् । गुहो ऽपि येषां प्रथमाप्तजन्मनां न पुत्रवात्सल्यम् अपाकरिष्यति ॥
units.english: Never slack in her care she personally reated up the saplings with outpourings from breastlikejarssaplings, her motherly affection for which, being firstborn, even Guha would not be able to set aside

units.sanskrit: अरण्यबीजाञ्जलिदानलालितास् तथा च तस्यां हरिणा विशश्वसुः । यथा तदीयैर् नयनैः कुतूहलात् पुरः सखीनाम् अमिमीत लोचने ॥ कृताभिशेकां हुतजातवेदसं त्वगुत्तरासङ्गवतीम् अधीतिनीम् । दिग्दृक्षवस् ताम् ऋषयो ऽभ्युपागमन् न धर्मवृद्धेषु वयः समीक्ष्यते ॥
units.english: And the fawns, fondled by giving them hanifuls of forestgrain, trusted her so far that she could measure the length of her own eyes before her friends or, of the eyes of her friends before her, by their eyes out of curiosity Sages came there, desirous of seeing her, who used to take a sacred bath, sacrificed to the fie, wore a bark as her upper garment and recited sacred texts age is no consideration in the case of those who are old in spiritual attainments

units.sanskrit: विरोधिसत्त्वोज्झितपूर्वमत्सरं द्रुमैर् अभीष्टप्रसवार्चितातिथि । नवोटजाभ्यन्तरसंभृतानलं तपोवनं तच् च बभूव पावनम् ॥
units.english: The sacred grove too became holy, where she previous antipathy between warring beasts was abandoned, where the guests travellers were well gratified with the gifts of desired fruit by the trees, and where the sacred fires were kindled in newly built buts of leaves

units.sanskrit: यदा फलं पूर्वतपःसमाधिना न तावता लभ्यम् अमंस्त काङ्क्षितम् । तदानपेक्ष्य स्वशरीरमार्दवं तपो महत् सा चरितुं प्रचक्रमे ॥
units.english: When she thought the desired fruit not to be attainable by that kind of penance which she had been already practising, then, disregardful of the delicacy of her body, she began a mightier penance

units.sanskrit: क्लमं ययौ कन्दुकलीलयापि या तया मुनीनां चरितं व्यगाह्यत । ध्रुवं वपुः काञ्चनपद्मनिर्मितं मृदु प्रकृत्या च ससारम् एव च ॥
units.english: She, who was fatigued even by playing with the ball, entered upon the course of life of anchorites verily her body was composed of gold lotuses, as it was delicate by nature and yet touch full of substance

units.sanskrit: शुचौ चतुर्णां ज्वलतां हविर्भुजां शुचिस्मिता मध्यगता सुमध्यमा । विजित्य नेत्रप्रतिघातिनीं प्रभाम् अनन्यदृष्टिः सवितारम् ऐक्षत ॥ तथाभितप्तं सवितुर् गभस्तिभिर् मुखं तदीयं कमलश्रियं दधौ । अपाङ्गयोः केवलम् अस्य दीर्घयोः शनैःशनैः श्यामिकया कृतं पदम् ॥
units.english: In summer, she of sweet smiles and delicate waist, sitting in the midst of four blazing fires, gazed at the sun the source of life with her sight not directed to any thing else, having got the better of being accustomed to bear his lustre that dazzles the eye, Then her face scorched by the rays of the sun in that manner, bore the beauty of a day lotus; but gradually round the long corners of her eyes only dark colour made its appearance

units.sanskrit: अयाचितोपस्थितम् अम्बु केवलं रसात्मकस्योडुपतेश् च रश्मयः । बभूव तस्याः किल पारणाविधिर् न वृक्षवृत्तिव्यतिरिक्तसाधनः ॥ निकामतप्ता विविधेन वह्निना नभश्चरेणेन्धनसंभृतेन च । तपात्यये वारिभिर् उक्षिता नवैर् भुवा सहोष्माणम् अमुञ्चद् ऊर्ध्वगम् ॥
units.english: Only the water that came to her without any effort on her part, and the rays of the moon Lord of the constellations, full of nectar, broke her fast, not unlike the means of subsistence of the trees She, extremely heated by various firesthat wandering in the sky and those lighted by means of fuel, being drenched with the fresh showers at the end of summer, gave out, along with the earth reeking heat th ascended upwards

units.sanskrit: स्थिताः क्षणं पक्ष्मसु ताडिताधराः पयोधरोत्सेधनिपातचूर्णिताः । वलीषु तस्याः स्खलिताः प्रपेदिरे चिरेण नाभिं प्रथमोदबिन्दवः ॥
units.english: The drops of first water showers rested for a moment on her eyelashes, then sriking against the netherlip, broke as they fell on the elevation of ber breasts; and thence stumbling through the threefolds of her skin, reached, after a long delay, her navel

units.sanskrit: शिलाशयां ताम् अनिकेतवासिनीं निरन्तरास्व् अन्तरवातवृष्टिषु । व्यलोकयन्न् उन्मिषितैस् तडिन्मयैर् महातपःसाक्ष्य इव स्थिताः क्षपाः ॥
units.english: The nights, the witnesses of the rigid penance of her who slept on a bare stone slab, and who lived in open space not under a sheltered roof and in the midst of unceasing showers accompanied by winds, watched her, as it were, with their glances in the shape of lightning flashes

units.sanskrit: निनाय सात्यन्तहिमोत्किरानिलाः सहस्यरात्रीर् उदवासतत्परा । परस्पराक्रन्दिनि चक्रवाकयोः पुरो वियुक्ते मिथुने कृपावती ॥ मुखेन सा पद्मसुगन्धिना निशि प्रवेपमानाधरपत्रशोभिना । तुषारवृष्टिक्षतपद्मसंपदां सरोजसंधानम् इवाकरोद् अपाम् ॥
units.english: Determinately standing in water she passed the nights of Pansha cold season with winter winds scattering about a thick mass of snowy sleet, pitying the pair of the Chakravaka birds which stood before her, separated and crying to each other At night, she replaced the beauty of lotuses, of the waters of the stream, the wealth of lotuses of which was destroyed by the showers of snow, by her face, as fragrant as the lotus itself and shining with the quivering leaf of the nether lip

units.sanskrit: स्वयंविशीर्णद्रुमपर्णवृत्तिता परा हि काष्ठा तपसस् तया पुनः । तद् अप्य् अपाकीर्णम् अतः प्रियंवदां वदन्त्य् अपर्णेति च तां पुराविदः ॥
units.english: The sternest severity of austerities lies in subsisting on leaves fallen from the trees of their own accord; but that also she spurned; hence was that gentletalker named Aparna by those conversant with history

units.sanskrit: मृणालिकापेलवम् एवमादिभिर् व्रतैः स्वम् अङ्गं ग्लपयन्त्य् अहर्निशम् । तपः शरीरैः कठिनैर् उपार्जितं तपस्विनां दूरम् अधश् चकार सा ॥
units.english: By this and other kinds of penance, she, wasting her frame delicate as a lotus fibre, day and night, left far behind the tapas practised by anchorites with hardened frames

units.sanskrit: अथाजिनाषाढधरः प्रगल्भवाग् ज्वलन्न् इव ब्रह्ममयेन तेजसा । विवेश कश्चिज् जटिलस् तपोवनं शरीरबद्धः प्रथमाश्रमो यथा ॥
units.english: Then a certain ascetic one with matted hair wearing an antelopes skin, and holding a staff of Palàsha, of ripe speech and burning, as it were, refulgent with Brahmanic lustre, entered the penance forest, like the first stage of life Brahmacharya embodied

units.sanskrit: तम् आतिथेयी बहुमानपूर्वया सपर्यया प्रत्युदियाय पार्वती । भवन्ति साम्ये ऽपि निविष्टचेतसां वपुर्विशेषेष्व् अतिगौरवाः क्रियाः ॥
units.english: To meet him went forth, offering worship with great reverence, Pàrvati, kindly disposed towards all guests; even when there is equality, the acts of the firmminded towards special personages are such as are full of extreme reverence

units.sanskrit: विधिप्रयुक्तां परिगृह्य सत्क्रियां परिश्रमं नाम विनीय च क्षणम् । उमां स पश्यन्न् ऋजुनैव चक्षुषा प्रचक्रमे वक्तुम् अनुज्झितक्रमः ॥
units.english: Having accepted the worship hospitality performed according to proper rites, and apparently eased his fatigue for a moment he, looking at Umà with quite pure eyes, began to speak to her, not forgetting proper manners

units.sanskrit: अपि क्रियार्थं सुलभं समित्कुशं जलान्य् अपि स्नानविधिक्षमाणि ते । अपि स्वशक्त्या तपसि प्रवर्तसे शरीरम् आद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनम् ॥
units.english: Are sacrificial wood and Kusa grass easily obtainable for holy rites? Is the water suitable for thy bathing? Dast thou practise austerities proportionate to thy strength ? For the body is the ultimate means of performing religious duties

units.sanskrit: अपि त्वदावर्जितवारिसंभृतं प्रवालम् आसाम् अनुबन्धि वीरुधाम् । चिरोज्झितालक्तकपाटलेन ते तुलां यद् आरोहति दन्तवाससा ॥ अपि प्रसन्नं हरिणेषु ते मनः करस्थदर्भप्रणयापहारिषु । य उत्पलाक्षि प्रचलैर् विलोचनैस् तवाक्षिसादृश्यम् इव प्रयुञ्जते ॥
units.english: Are the young leaves of these creepers made to sprout by the water sprinkled by thee, thriving?the leaves which vie with thy nether lip, red though long bereft of the scarlet of Alaktaka red lac Is thy mind pleasingly disposed towards the fawns, who take the Kusa grass from thy hands through their love for thee and who, O lotuseyed one, present a close resemblance to thy eyes with their unsteady glances ?

units.sanskrit: यद् उच्यते पार्वति पापवृत्तये न रूपम् इत्य् अव्यभिचारि तद् वचः । तथा हि ते शीलम् उदारदर्शने तपस्विनाम् अप्य् उपदेशतां गतम् ॥
units.english: O Mountainborn lady, the observation that beauty never leads to a sinful course of life is not false not a deviation from a general rule as, O thou of noble form, thy conduct has become worthy of imitation even for the ascetics

units.sanskrit: विकीर्णसप्तर्षिबलिप्रहासिभिस् तथा न गाङ्गैः सलिलैर् दिवश् च्युतैः । यथा त्वदीयैश् चरितैर् अनाविलैर् महीधरः पावित एष सान्वयः ॥
units.english: This Upholder of the earth Mountain together with his family, has not been so sanctified by the waters of the Ganges, dropping from the firmament and resplendent with the offerings of flowers scattered by the seven heavenly Sages, as he has been by thy pure acts free from the taint of sin

units.sanskrit: अनेन धर्मः सविशेषम् अद्य मे त्रिवर्गसारः प्रतिभाति भाविनि । त्वया मनोनिर्विषयार्थकामया यद् एक एव प्रतिगृह्य सेव्यते ॥
units.english: O thou of pure intentions, on account of this conduct, pursuit of religion strikes me preeminently as the best of the group of the three Dharma, Artha and Kama, as this only has been selected and followed by thee, with a mind from which all thought of Artha wealth and Kama desire has been sent out

units.sanskrit: प्रयुक्तसत्कारविशेषम् आत्मना न मां परं संप्रतिपत्तुम् अर्हसि । यतः सतां संनतगात्रि संगतं मनीषिभिः साप्तपदीनम् उच्यते ॥
units.english: It does not behove thee to regard me as a stranger, to whom special hospitality was accorded by thee; for, O thou of stooping body, the friendship of good people is declared to be formed after seven words have been exchanged between them or seven steps gone over together

units.sanskrit: अतो ऽत्र किंचिद् भवतीं बहुक्षमां द्विजातिभावाद् उपपन्नचापलः । अयं जनः प्रष्टुमनास् तपोधने न चेद् रहस्यं प्रतिवक्तुम् अर्हसि ॥
units.english: Hence, O thou to whom penance is a reasure, , whom curiosity, natural to the twiceborn a Bráhmana, s roused, am desirous of asking something to thee, a lady of great forbearance

units.sanskrit: कुले प्रसूतिः प्रथमस्य वेधसस् त्रिलोकसौन्दर्यम् इवोदितं वपुः । अमृग्यम् ऐश्वर्यसुखं नवं वयस् तपःफलं स्यात् किम् अतः परं वद ॥
units.english: Thy birth is in the family of the first progenitor of mankind; thy shape is as if the manifestation of the collected beauty of the three worlds, the happiness of afflunce is not for thee to seck; and thine is fresh youth; say what blessings, other than these, can be the reward of Penance

units.sanskrit: भवत्य् अनिष्टाद् अपि नाम दुःसहान् मनस्विनीनां प्रतिपत्तिर् ईदृशी । विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चेतसा न दृश्यते तच् च कृशोदरि त्वयि ॥
units.english: Such a course of action is possibly followed by high minded ladies when overtaken by an unbearable evil; but such a one, O thou of slender waist, can not be discovered in thy case by the mind directed through the channel of thought

units.sanskrit: अलभ्यशोकाभिभवेयम् आकृतिर् विमानना सुभ्रु कुतः पितुर् गृहे । पराभिमर्शो न तवास्ति कः करं प्रसारयेत् पन्नगरत्नसूचये ॥ किम् इत्य् अपास्याभरणानि यौवने धृतं त्वया वार्द्धकशोभि वल्कलम् । वद प्रदोषे स्फुटचन्द्रतारके विभावरी यद्य् अरुणाय कल्पते ॥
units.english: O thou of beautiful brows, this thy form is incapable of the humillation of grief; and whence can there be disrespectful treatment under the parental roof? Nor car there be any insult from strangers; for who can stretch his hand to snatch away the jet of the lustre of the serpents gem? Why is it that thou hast put ou a bark garment suitable to old age only, in youth, abandoning ornaments Say if the night at its beginning, with the moon and the stars prominently displayed, can hint at the approach of dawn

units.sanskrit: दिवं यदि प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः पितुः प्रदेशास् तव देवभूमयः । अथोपयन्तारम् अलं समाधिना न रत्नम् अन्विष्यति मृग्यते हि तत् ॥
units.english: If thou art seeking heaven, bootless is thy effort the regions on the slopes of thy father are the land of gods; if thou dost desire a suitable husband, cease from thy austerities a jewel is sought after and has not to seek

units.sanskrit: निवेदितं निश्वसितेन सोष्मणा मनस् तु मे संशयम् एव गाहते । न दृश्यते प्रार्थयितव्य एव ते भविष्यति प्रार्थितदुर्लभः कथम् ॥
units.english: Thy hot sighs have betrayed the secret; and yet my mind is still more plunged in doubts; see not that a husband is at all to be sought after by thee; how then can there be one who is unobtainable when sought after

units.sanskrit: अहो स्थिरः को ऽपि तवेप्सितो युवा चिराय कर्णोत्पलशून्यतां गते । उपेक्षते यः श्लथलम्बिनीर् जटाः कपोलदेशे कलमाग्रपिङ्गलाः ॥
units.english: The youth thou yearnest after is, indeed, hardhearted, since he still holds off, seeing the matted hairtawny like the tips of the blades of paddy, hanging loosely on thy broad cheeks from which the earlotus has been long missing

units.sanskrit: मुनिव्रतैस् त्वाम् अतिमात्रकर्शितां दिवाकराप्लुष्टविभूषणास्पदाम् । शशाङ्कलेखाम् इव पश्यतो दिवा सचेतसः कस्य मनो न दूयते ॥
units.english: Of what person, having a heart, the mind is not afflicted, on seeing thee, extremely emaciated by the observance of saintly vows, with the places of ornaments burni mercilessly by the sun and therefore looking like the crescent of the moon by day?

units.sanskrit: अवैमि सौभाग्यमदेन वञ्चितं तव प्रियं यश् चतुरावलोकिनः । करोति लक्ष्यं चिरम् अस्य चक्षुषो न वक्त्रम् आत्मीयम् अरालपक्ष्मणः ॥
units.english: take thy lover to be cheated by the pride of his beauty who dues not, for a long time, make his face the mark for present himself to the view of thy eyes of lovely looks and arching eyeslashes

units.sanskrit: कियच् चिरं श्राम्यसि गौरि विद्यते ममापि पूर्वाश्रमसंचितं तपः । तदर्धभागेन लभस्व काङ्क्षितं वरं तम् इच्छामि च साधु वेदितुम् ॥
units.english: O Gauri, how long wilt thou torture thyself too have religious merit accumulated in my peviourst stage of life; do thou get thy desired husband by the grant of half of it; him, however desire to know well fully

units.sanskrit: इति प्रविश्याभिहिता द्विजन्मना मनोगतं सा न शशाक शंसितुम् । अथो वयस्यां परिपार्श्ववर्तिनीं विवर्तितानञ्जननेत्रम् ऐक्षत ॥
units.english: She, thus addressed by the Brahmana, who had divined the inmost secret of her heart, could not speak out the desire of her heart through bashfulness So she only looked at her friend standing by her side with eyes not besmeared with collyrium

units.sanskrit: सखी तदीया तम् उवाच वर्णिनं निबोध साधो तव चेत् कुतूहलम् । यदर्थम् अम्भोजम् इवोष्णवारणं कृतं तपःसाधनम् एतया वपुः ॥
units.english: Her friend said to the asceticO sage, know thou then, if such is thy curiosity, him for whom this lady has made her body a means for practising religious austeritles, as one should a lotus for warding off the sun

units.sanskrit: इयं महेन्द्रप्रभृतीन् अधिश्रियश् चतुर्दिगीशान् अवमत्य मानिनी । अरूपहार्यं मदनस्य निग्रहात् पिनाकपाणिं पतिम् आप्तुम् इच्छति ॥
units.english: This lady, disdaining all the lords of the four quarters, Mahendra and others, of exalted dignity, seeks a husband in the Tridentholder, who is not to be conquered by charms, as is evinced by his destruction of the mindborn

units.sanskrit: असह्यहुंकारनिवर्तितः पुरा पुरारिम् अप्राप्तमुखः शिलीमुखः । इमां हृदि व्यायतपातम् अक्षणोद् विशीर्णमूर्तेर् अपि पुष्पधन्वनः ॥
units.english: The arrow of the Flowerbewed god, whose point failed to reach the enemy of the Puras, being first hurled back with the Hunkàra sound, difficult to be borne, struck her in the heart with a cruel blow, although his body had been destroyed

units.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृत्य् उन्मदना पितुर् गृहे ललाटिकाचन्दनधूसरालका । न जातु बाला लभते स्म निर्वृतिं तुषारसंघातशिलातलेष्व् अपि ॥
units.english: From that time forth, powerfully affected by love, and with her curling tresses whitened by the sandal paste on her forehead, the maiden never felt ease even when reclining on the surfaces, of snowslabs while in her fathers house

units.sanskrit: उपात्तवर्णे चरिते पिनाकिनः सबाष्पकण्ठस्खलितैः पदैर् इयम् । अनेकशः किन्नरराजकन्यका वनान्तसंगीतसखीर् अरोदयत् ॥
units.english: Many a time did she make the daughters of the Kinnara kings, her companions in the songs sung in the woods, burst into tears, by her words of grief scarcely articulate in the throat choking with tears, while the exploits of the Pinákaholder were being sung

units.sanskrit: त्रिभागशेषासु निशासु च क्षणम् निमील्य नेत्रे सहसा व्यबुध्यत । क्व नीलकण्ठ व्रजसीत्य् अलक्ष्यवाग् असत्यकण्ठार्पितबाहुबन्धना ॥
units.english: At night, when the third part was still remaining, she could scarcely close her eyes for a moment, when all of a sudden she would start up with incoherent cries ofO Thou of azure neck, where dost thou go? and would throw her arms tight round an imaginary neck

units.sanskrit: यदा बुधैः सर्वगतस् त्वम् उच्यसे न वेत्सि भावस्थम् इमं जनं कथम् । इति स्वहस्ताल्लिखितश् च मुग्धया रहस्य् उपालभ्यत चन्द्रशेखरः ॥
units.english: And He of the cresentcrest, drawn with her own hands by this silly girl, was upbraided in private with the words Thou hast been considered allpervading by the wise; how, then, dost thou not know this person, slave to thy love?

units.sanskrit: यदा च तस्याधिगमे जगत्पतेर् अपश्यद् अन्यं न विधिं विचिन्वती । तदा सहास्माभिर् अनुज्ञया गुरोर् इयं प्रपन्ना तपसे तपोवनम् ॥
units.english: When at last she could find no other way to win the Lord of the universe though deliberately searching, she came with us to this sacred forest for practising austerities permitted by her father

units.sanskrit: द्रुमेषु सख्या कृतजन्मसु स्वयं फलं तपःसाक्षिषु दृष्टम् एष्व् अपि । न च प्ररोहाभिमुखो ऽपि दृश्यते मनोरथो ऽस्याः शशिमौलिसंश्रयः ॥
units.english: This our friend has seen fruit appearing on these trees planted given birth to by herself and the witnesses of her austerities and yet the craving of her heart, which has for its basis the mooncrested God, does not seem even to be near sprouting time about to bear fruit

units.sanskrit: न वेद्मि स प्रार्थितदुर्लभः कदा सखीभिर् अस्रोत्तरम् ईक्षिताम् इमाम् । तपःकृशाम् अभ्युपपत्स्यते सखीं वृषेव सीतां तदवग्रहक्षताम् ॥ अगूढसद्भावम् इतीङ्गितज्ञया निवेदितो नैष्ठिकसुन्दरस् तया । अयीदम् एवं परिहास इत्य् उमाम् अपृच्छद् अव्यञ्जितहर्षलक्षणः ॥
units.english: do not know when he, difficult to be secured hough sought after, will favour this our friend, worn by penance and looked at by us, her friends, with tears, as Indra favours with showers the earth, distressed by his holding off the rain Thus informed by her, who knew the secrets of Pârvatfs heart, so as to make her noble intention clear, that handsome Brahmacharin, without showing signs of delight, asked Umà whether it was so or a joke

units.sanskrit: अथाग्रहस्ते मुकुलीकृताङ्गुलौ समर्पयन्ती स्फटिकाक्षमालिकाम् । कथं चिद् अद्रेस् तनया मिताक्षरं चिरव्यवस्थापितवाग् अभाषत ॥
units.english: Then the daughter of the mountain, putting the rosary of crystal beads on or into her forehand, with the fingers drawn together so as to resemble a bud, spoke, with great difficulty, in measured words, having adjusted her speech in her mind for a long time

units.sanskrit: यथा श्रुतं वेदविदां वर त्वया जनो ऽयम् उच्चैःपदलङ्घनोत्सुकः । तपः किलेदं तदवाप्तिसाधनं मनोरथानाम् अगतिर् न विद्यते ॥
units.english: O thou, worshipped of those who know the Vedas, thou hast heard the truth as it is; this humble person is ambitious of attaining the highest post

units.sanskrit: अथाह वर्णी विदितो महेश्वरस् तदर्थिनी त्वं पुनर् एव वर्तसे । अमङ्गलाभ्यासरतिं विचिन्त्य तं तवानुवृत्तिं न च कर्तुम् उत्सहे ॥
units.english: Then said the asceticMahes wara is well known and yet thou hast a yearning after him; knowing him possess a love for inauspitious things, cannot see my way to approve of thy desire

units.sanskrit: अवस्तुनिर्बन्धपरे कथं नु ते करो ऽयम् आमुक्तविवाहकौतुकः । करेण शंभोर् वलयीकृताहिना सहिष्यते तत्प्रथमावलम्बनम् ॥ त्वम् एव तावत् परिचिन्तय स्वयं कदा चिद् एते यदि योगम् अर्हतः । वधूदुकूलं कलहंसलक्षणं गजाजिनं शोणितबिन्दुवर्षि च ॥
units.english: O thou who hast fixed thy mind on a worthless object, how can this thy hand with the nuptial string still tied round it, bear the first clasp of Sambhus hand decked with circling snakes? Do thou thyself consider adequately whether these two things can ever bear being together the bridal silks gleaming with the figures of swans and the elephanthide dripping with blood?

units.sanskrit: चतुष्कपुष्पप्रकराविकीर्णयोः परो ऽपि को नाम तवानुमन्यते । अलक्तकाङ्कानि पदानि पादयोर् विकीर्णकेशासु परेतभूमिषु ॥
units.english: Who, even an enemy, consent to see the footprints, leaving marks of red vermeil of thy feet treading upon flowers in the saloon, traced upon the ground of the dead spread over with hair?

units.sanskrit: अयुक्तरूपं किम् अतः परं वद त्रिनेत्रवक्षः सुलभं तवापि यत् । स्तनद्वये ऽस्मिन् हरिचन्दनास्पदे पदं चिताभस्मरजः करिष्यति ॥ इयं च ते ऽन्या पुरतो विडम्बना यद् ऊढया वारणराजहार्यया । विलोक्य वृद्धोक्षम् अधिष्ठितं त्वया महाजनः स्मेरमुखो भविष्यति ॥
units.english: Say Is there any thing more ungainly than this that the ashes of the funeral pyres easy to be obtained from the bosom of the threeeyed God will make their home on thy bosom, a fitting place for sandal wood paste? Then again this another humiliation will await theegreat men will have smiling countenances, on seeing thee, fit to be borne by a lordly elephant, striding the bull, after marriage

units.sanskrit: द्वयं गतं संप्रति शोचनीयतां समागमप्रार्थनया कपालिनः । कला च सा कान्तिमती कलावतस् त्वम् अस्य लोकस्य च नेत्रकौमुदी ॥
units.english: By their earnest desire for union with the Trldentholder, two things have now become objects of commisera ion the digit of the moon and thyself, the moonlight of the eyes of the world

units.sanskrit: वपुर् विरूपाक्षम् अलक्ष्यजन्मता दिगम्बरत्वेन निवेदितं वसु । वरेषु यद् बालमृगाक्षि मृग्यते तद् अस्ति किं व्यस्तम् अपि त्रिलोचने ॥ निवर्तयास्माद् असदीप्सितान् मनः क्व तद्विधस् त्वं क्व च पुण्यलक्षणा । अपेक्ष्यते साधुजनेन वैदिकी श्मशानशूलस्य न यूपसत्क्रिया ॥
units.english: O thou having eyes like those of a young gazelle, is whatever expected in a husband found in the threeeyed One, even taken singly? Turn thy heart from this evil desire; what a disance is there between one of that kind, and thee with auspicious marks? A gibbet of the burial ground is not expected to be treated with the Vedic rites proper for a sacrificial post, by the good

units.sanskrit: इति द्विजातौ प्रतिकूलवादिनि प्रवेपमानाधरलक्ष्यकोपया । विकुञ्चितभ्रूलतम् आहिते तया विलोचने तिर्यग् उपान्तलोहिते ॥
units.english: By her, whose anger could be guessed from her quivering nether lip, were cast askance upon the twiceborn, talking adversely, her eyes, red at the corners, with a frown gathered on the creeper likebrows

units.sanskrit: उवाच चैनं परमार्थतो हरं न वेत्सि नूनं यत एवम् आत्थ माम् । अलोकसामान्यम् अचिन्त्यहेतुकं द्विषन्ति मन्दाश् चरितं महात्मनाम् ॥
units.english: And him she thus addressed Indeed thou dost not know Hara aright, since thou talkest thus to me The dullwitted find fault with the course of life of the magnanimous, which is not in common with that of other people, and the motive of which is difficult to divine

units.sanskrit: विपत्प्रतीकारपरेण मङ्गलं निषेव्यते भूतिसमुत्सुकेन वा । जगच्छरण्यस्य निराशिषः सतः किम् एभिर् आशोपहतात्मवृत्तिभिः ॥
units.english: Auspicious things are resorted to by one, who is anxious to ward off calamities or to attain prosperity What has he, who is the protector of the world and has nothing to wish for, to do with these, which corrupt the functions of the mind by generating desires ?

units.sanskrit: अकिञ्चनः सन् प्रभवः स संपदां त्रिलोकनाथः पितृसद्मगोचरः । स भीमरूपः शिव इत्य् उदीर्यते न सन्ति याथार्थ्यविदः पिनाकिनः ॥ विभूषणोद्भासि पिनद्धभोगि वा गजाजिनालम्बि दुकूलधारि वा । कपालि वा स्याद् अथ वेन्दुशेखरं न विश्वमूर्तेर् अवधार्यते वपुः ॥
units.english: Himself poor, he is the spring of wealth; living found in the cremation ground the above of the dead he is the lord of the three worlds ; of terrible form he is called Siva of gentle aspect None are there who know the Tridentholder for what he is, The shape of one whose form is the universe can not be determined it may be resplendent with ornaments or entwined with serpents, dressed in the elephanthide or again in silken garments, or it may have a vessel of skull or the moon on the crest

units.sanskrit: तदङ्गसंसर्गम् अवाप्य कल्पते ध्रुवं चिताभस्मरजो विशुद्धये । तथा हि नृत्याभिनयक्रियाच्युतं विलिप्यते मौलिभिर् अम्बरौकसां ॥
units.english: Certainly the particles of the ashes of the funeral pyre even become sanctifying by having obtained a touch of his body; and hence are held on the head by the dwellers of heaven when dropped in the act of exhibiting the gestures of dancing

units.sanskrit: असंपदस् तस्य वृषेण गच्छतः प्रभिन्नदिग्वारणवाहनो वृषा । करोति पादाव् उपगम्य मौलिना विनिद्रमन्दाररजोरुणाङ्गुली ॥
units.english: Indra, having for his vehicle the rutting elephant of the eastern quarter, touches, with his crest, the feet of that poor God, who goes about on the bull and makes their toes red with the pollendust of the fullblown flowers of the heavenly trees

units.sanskrit: विवक्षता दोषम् अपि च्युतात्मना त्वयैकम् ईशं प्रति साधु भाषितम् । यम् आमनन्त्य् आत्मभुवो ऽपि कारणं कथं स लक्ष्यप्रभवो भविष्यति ॥
units.english: Thou, of depraved soul, although wishing to speak the faults of the Lord, hast said one good thing about him How can he, who is considered the parent of even the selfexistent Brahmá, have his origin known ?

units.sanskrit: अलं विवादेन यथा श्रुतस् त्वया तथाविधस् तावद् अशेषम् अस्तु सः । ममात्र भावैकरसं मनः स्थितं न कामवृत्तिर् वचनीयम् ईक्षते ॥
units.english: Though of disputing let him be, without any reservation, what you have heard him to be, My heart, however, is set on him, pervaded by the one sentimet of love ; one, who wants to act as one likes, does not regard care for criticism illtalk

units.sanskrit: निवार्यताम् आलि किम् अप्य् अयं बटुः पुनर् विवक्षुः स्फुरितोत्तराधरः । न केवलं यो महतो ऽपभाषते शृणोति तस्माद् अपि यः स पापभाक् ॥
units.english: O friend, stop this boy who seems desirous of saying something as his upper lip quivers Not only he, who talks ill of the mighty, but also he who listens to him is a sinner

units.sanskrit: इतो गमिश्याम्य् अथवेति वादिनी चचाल बाला स्तनभिन्नवल्कला । स्वरूपम् आस्थाय च तां कृतस्मितः समाललम्बे वृषराजकेतनः ॥
units.english: Or rather will hence; so saying the maiden, with the bark garment slipping from her bosom, started and the bullemblemed God, with a smile, held her having discovered his self

units.sanskrit: तं वीक्ष्य वेपथुमती सरसाङ्गयष्टिर् निक्षेपणाय पदम् उद्धृतम् उद्वहन्ती । मार्गाचलव्यतिकराकुलितेव सिन्धुः शैलाधिराजतनया न ययौ न तस्थौ ॥
units.english: On seeing him, all atrembling and her body covered with perspiration, the daughter of the Mountainlord, having one foot raised to tread, was uncertain whether to go or to stay, like a river, hampered by the impediment of a mountain in the path

units.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृत्य् अवनताङ्गि तवास्मि दासः क्रीतस् तपोभिर् इति वादिनि चन्द्रमौलौ । अह्नाय सा नियमजं क्लमम् उत्ससर्ज क्लेशः फलेन हि पुनर् नवतां विधत्ते ॥
units.english: O thou of stooping limbs, henceforth am thy slave bought by thy austeritiesas the Mooncrested God said these words, she forgot all her exhaustion caused by the austertles at once fatigue gives fresh vigour again by the fruition the achievement of the desired object

units.sanskrit: अथ विश्वात्मने गौरी संदिदेश मिथः सखीम् । दाता मे भूभृतां नाथः प्रमाणीक्रियताम् इति ॥
units.english: Thereafter Gauri instructed her companion when alone with her to say to Siva the soul of the universethe lord of mountains Himálaya is my giver in marriage let him be recognised as an authority ie he should be applied to for my hand

units.sanskrit: तया व्याहृतसंदेशा सा बभौ निभृता प्रिये । चूतयष्टिर् इवाभ्याष्ये मधौ परभृतामुखी ॥
units.english: She, who had communicated her message through her friend, and who remained relying on or, firmly devoted to her beloved, shone, when near him, like a young mango tree speaking through the cuckoos, and steadily awaiting the spring when near at hand

units.sanskrit: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय विसृज्य कथम् अप्य् उमाम् । ऋषीञ् ज्योतिर्मयान् सप्त सस्मार स्मरशासनः ॥
units.english: Having promised, it will be so and sent away Umá with great difficulty, he, the chastiser of Smara, thought of mentally called the seven luminous sages

units.sanskrit: ते प्रभामण्डलैर् व्योम द्योतयन्तस् तपोधनाः । सारुन्धतीकाः सपदि प्रादुर् आसन् पुरः प्रभोः ॥
units.english: Illumining the sky with the circles of their lustre, the great sages those whose penance was their treasure immediately appeared before the Lord, accompanied by Arundhati

units.sanskrit: आप्लुतास् तीरमन्दारकुसुमोत्किरवीचिषु । आकाशगङ्गास्रोतस्सु दिङ्नागमदगन्धिषु ॥ मुक्तायज्ञोपवीतानि बिभ्रतो हैमवल्कलाः । रत्नाक्षसूत्राः प्रव्रज्यां कल्पवृक्षा इवाश्रिताः ॥
units.english: Bathed in the streams of the celestial Ganges, the waves of which bear along the flowers of the wishgranting trees grown on the banks and which are scented with the temporal juice of the quarterelephants; Wearing sacred threads of pearls, dressed in gold barkgarments and having jewelrosaries and thus looking like the heavenly trees that had betaken to the ascetic mode of life retirement from the world;

units.sanskrit: अधःप्रवर्त्तिताश्वेन समावर्जितकेतुना । सहस्ररश्मिना शश्वत् सप्रमाणम् उदीक्षिताः ॥
units.english: Who were looked up to with a bow by the thousandrayed sun himself having placed his horses below and bent his flag;

units.sanskrit: आसक्तबाहुलतया सार्धम् उद्धृतया भुवा । महावराहदंष्ट्रायां विश्रान्ताः प्रलयापदि ॥
units.english: Who had rested, at the time of the calamity of universal destruction, on the tusk of the great Boar along with the earth, that was lifted up from water, with their creeperlike arms attached to it the tusk or the earth;

units.sanskrit: सर्गशेषप्रणयनाद् विश्वयोनेर् अनन्तरम् । पुरातनाः पुराविद्भिर् धातार इति कीर्तिताः ॥
units.english: Who, on account of their finishing the work of the remaining part of the creation, after Brahman, are mentioned described by those conversant with history as the primeval creators;

units.sanskrit: प्राक्तनानां विशुद्धानां परिपाकम् उपेयुषाम् । तपसाम् उपभुञ्जानाः फलान्य् अपि तपस्विनः ॥
units.english: And who, although enjoying the fruits of their exceedingly pure penance, practised in previous lives and now come to fruition, remained continued to be ascetics still

units.sanskrit: तेषां मध्यगता साध्वी पत्युः पादार्पितेक्षणा । साक्षाद् इव तपःसिद्धिर् बभासे बह्व् अरुन्धती ॥
units.english: The chaste Arundhati who was in their midst with her eyes directed to the feet of her husband, shone exceedingly as though she were the success of their asceticism incarnate

units.sanskrit: ताम् अगौरवभेदेन मुनींश् चापश्यद् ईश्वरः । स्त्री पुमान् इत्य् अनास्थैषा वृत्तं हि महितं सताम् ॥ तद्दर्शनाद् अभूच् छम्भोर् भूयान् दारार्थम् आदरः । क्रियाणां खलु धर्म्याणां सत्पत्न्यो मूलसाधनम् ॥
units.english: The Lord looked upon or, received her and the sages without any distinction of honour; no regard is shown to ones being a male or female; for the character of the good alone is esteemed At her sight Sambhus desire for a wife became stronger good wives, indeed, are the prime cause of religious performances

units.sanskrit: धर्मेणापि पदं शर्वे कारिते पार्वतीं प्रति । पूर्वापराधभीतस्य कामस्योच्छ्वासितं मनः ॥
units.english: Religious duty having made Siva take a step with regard to form a regard for Parvati, the mind of Kâma, full of fear at previous guilt, breathed with relief or hope

units.sanskrit: अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे मानयित्वा जगद्गुरुम् । इदम् ऊचुर् अनूचानाः प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः ॥
units.english: Then all those sages, who were adepts in the Vedas with their accessory branches, having duly honoured the Lord of the universe thus spoke to Him, with the hair of their bodies standing on end from joy

units.sanskrit: यद् ब्रह्म सम्यग् आम्नातं यद् अग्नौ विधिना हुतम् । यच् च तप्तं तपस् तस्य विपक्वं फलम् अद्य नः ॥ यद् अध्यक्षेण जगतां वयम् आरोपितास् त्वया । मनोरथस्याविषयं मनोविषयम् आत्मनः ॥
units.english: The Veda that was duly studied by us; the sacrifices that were offered into the fire in the prescribed form and the penance that was practisedthe fruit of all that has been ripened for us today in as much as by thee, Lord over all the worlds, we have been made to be the object of thy mind which is beyond the reach of our wish

units.sanskrit: यस्य चेतसि वर्तेथाः स तावत् कृतिनां वरः । किं पुनर् ब्रह्मयोनेर् यस् तव चेतसि वर्तते ॥
units.english: He, in whose mind thou abidest, is, indeed, the greatest of all blessed persons what then to say of him who dwells in the mind of thee, the cause of Brahma or the Vedas?

units.sanskrit: सत्यम् अर्काच् च सोमाच् च परम् अध्यास्महे पदम् । अद्य तूच्चैस्तरं तस्मात् स्मरणानुग्रहात् तव ॥ त्वत्संभावितम् आत्मानं बहु मन्यामहे वयम् । प्रायः प्रत्ययम् आधत्ते स्वगुणेषूत्तमादरः ॥
units.english: Truly we occupy a station higher than that of the sun and the moon; but today far higher than theirs, owing to the favour of thy remembrance of us We think highly of ourselves thus honoured by thee generally the regard of superiors creates confidence in ones own merits

units.sanskrit: या नः प्रीतिर् विरूपाक्ष त्वदनुध्यानसंभवा । सा किम् आवेद्यते तुभ्यम् अन्तरात्मासि देहिनाम् ॥
units.english: Where is the necessity, O Thou with diverse eyes, to express to Thee the delight caused to us by thy having remembered us! Thou art the indwelling soul of all embodied creatures

units.sanskrit: साक्षाद् दृष्टो ऽसि न पुनर् विद्मस् त्वां वयम् अञ्जसा । प्रसीद कथयात्मानं न धियां पथि वर्तसे ॥
units.english: Thou art seen visibly, and yet we know thee not in thy real nature; be pleased and explain thyself for Thou liest not within the range of mental faculties

units.sanskrit: किं येन सृजसि व्यक्तम् उत येन बिभर्षि तत् । अथ विश्वस्य संहर्ता भागः कतम एष ते ॥
units.english: Which of the three is this form of thine ?whether that by which Thou manifestest the universe or that by which Thou preservest it or that which resolves the universe back into its original state

units.sanskrit: अथवा सुमहत्य् एषा प्रार्थना देव तिष्ठतु । चिन्तितोपस्थितांस् तावच् छाधि नः करवाम किम् ॥
units.english: Or rather, O God, let this our highsoaring request staud aside in the first place command us who have presented ourselves at thy mental call What shall we do?

units.sanskrit: अथ मौलिगतस्येन्दोर् विशदैर् दशनांशुभिः । उपचिन्वन् प्रभां तन्वीं प्रत्याह परमेश्वरः ॥
units.english: Then the great God spoke to them, heightening the scanty lustre of the moon on his head with the bright rays of his teeth

units.sanskrit: विदितं वो यथा स्वार्था न मे काश्चित् प्रवृत्तयः । ननु मूर्तिभिर् अष्टाभिर् इत्थंभूतो ऽस्मि सूचितः ॥
units.english: It is known to you that none of my proceedings efforts, activities are for my own self and verily am shown to be of such nature by my eight forms

units.sanskrit: सो ऽहं तृष्णातुरैर् वृष्टिं विद्युत्वान् इव चातकैः । अरिविप्रकृतैर् देवैः प्रसूतिं प्रति याचितः ॥
units.english: That or, who am, such have been solicited for progeny to beget a son by the gods tormented by their enemies as the lightningbearing cloud is for a shower by the Chátaka birds oppressed by thirst

units.sanskrit: अत आहर्तुम् इच्छामि पार्वतीम् आत्मजन्मने । उत्पत्तये हविर्भोक्तुर् यजमान इवारणिम् ॥
units.english: For this reason wish to take for wife Pârvatf for begetting a son, as a sacrificer secures arani parti scular pieces of wood for the generation of the holy fire

units.sanskrit: ताम् अस्मदर्थे युष्माभिर् याचितव्यो हिमालयः । विक्रियायै न कल्पन्ते संबन्धाः सदनुष्ठिताः ॥
units.english: Himalaya should be requested by you to bestow her in marriage on me the connections relationship brought about by the good do not lead to bad results

units.sanskrit: उन्नतेन स्थितिमता धुरम् उद्वहता भुवः । तेन योजितसंबन्धं वित्त माम् अप्य् अवञ्चितम् ॥
units.english: Know me also to be not deluded, being joined in relationship with him who is exalted lofty, who keeps within proper bounds has stability, and who bears the burden of the earth

units.sanskrit: एवं वाच्यः स कन्यार्थम् इति वो नोपदिश्यते । भवत्प्रणीतम् आचारम् आमनन्ति हि साधवः ॥
units.english: That he should be addressed in such and such a way for his daughter need not be told to you; for the learned inculcate the rules of conduct prescribed by yourselves

units.sanskrit: आर्याप्य् अरुन्धती तत्र व्यापारं कर्तुं अर्हति । प्रायेणैवंविधे कार्ये पुरन्ध्रीणां प्रगल्भता ॥
units.english: The revered Arundhati too will do well to take part therein generally in a matter of this nature matrons have great competency

units.sanskrit: तत् प्रयातौषधिप्रस्थं सिद्धये हिमवत्पुरम् । महाकोशीप्रपाते ऽस्मिन् संगमः पुनर् एव नः ॥
units.english: Set out then for Oshadhiprastha, the city capital of Himalaya, for the accomplishment of the business; we shall meet again just at this cataract of the Mahâkosf

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् संयमिनाम् आद्ये जाते परिणयोन्मुखे । जहुः परिग्रहव्रीडां प्राजापत्यास् तपस्विनः ॥
units.english: When he, the foremost of ascetics, became inclined to marriage, the ascetics, born of Brahman, gave up their shame for having wives

units.sanskrit: ततः परमम् इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रतस्थे मुनिमण्डलम् । भगवान् अपि संप्राप्तः प्रथमोद्दिष्टम् आस्पदम् ॥
units.english: Then having said very well the group of sages departed And the Lord also went to the place first settled

units.sanskrit: ते चाकाशम् असिश्यामम् उत्पत्य परमर्षयः । आसेदुर् ओषधिप्रस्थं मनसा समरंहसः ॥
units.english: The great sages too, having jumped into the sky, dark like a sword, and equalling the mind in velocity, reached Oshadhiprastha,

units.sanskrit: अलकाम् अतिवाह्येव वसतिं वसुसंपदाम् । स्वर्गाभिष्यन्दवमनं कृत्वेवोपनिवेशितम् ॥
units.english: The city which was built as it were, by transplanting, Alaká itself, the repository of wealth and abundance or, abundant wealth and peopled, as it were, by causing an exodus of the redundance of heaven

units.sanskrit: गङ्गास्रोतःपरिक्षिप्तवप्रान्तर्ज्वलितौषधि । बृहन्मणिशिलासालं गुप्ताव् अपि मनोहरम् ॥
units.english: Which was encircled by the streams of the Ganges, which had herbs blazing within its ramparts, the wall of which was built of large jewelstones and which was charming even in notwithstanding Its fortifications

units.sanskrit: जितसिंहभया नागा यत्राश्वा बिलयोनयः । यक्षाः किंपुरुषाः पौरा योषितो वनदेवताः ॥ शिखरासक्तमेघानां व्यजन्ते यत्र वेश्मनाम् । अनुगर्जितसंदिग्धाः करणैर् मुरजस्वनाः ॥ यत्र कल्पद्रुमैर् एव विलोलविटपांशुकैः । गृहयन्त्रपताकाश्रीर् अपौरादरनिर्मिता ॥
units.english: Wherein the elephants had overcome their fear of lions, where the horses were of the Bilabreed, and of which the Yakshas and the Kimpurushas were the male citizens and the sylvan goddesses the females In which the sounds of tabors in the houses, the tops of which have clouds clinging to them, being confounded with the echoes of the thunderclaps, are distinguished by the strokes accompanying them

units.sanskrit: यत्र स्फटिकहर्म्येषु नक्तम् आपानभूमिषु । ज्योतिषां प्रतिबिम्बानि प्राप्नुवन्त्य् उपहारताम् ॥
units.english: Where in the parts of the crystal mansions set apart for drinking, the reflections of stars get at night to the position of serve as presents or offerings of flowers

units.sanskrit: यत्रौषधिप्रकाशेन नक्तं दर्शितसंचराः । अनभिज्ञास् तमिस्राणां दुर्दिनेष्व् अभिसारिकाः ॥ यौवनान्तं वयो यस्मिन्न् आतङ्कः कुसुमायुधः । रतिखेदसमुत्पन्ना निद्रा संज्ञाविपर्ययः ॥ भ्रूभेदिभिः सकम्पोष्ठैर् ललिताङ्गुलितर्जनैः । यत्र कोपैः कृताः स्त्रीणाम् आप्रसादार्थिनः प्रियाः ॥
units.english: Where at night, amorous females going out to meet their lovers are ignorant of do not experience nocturnal darkness even on cloudy days, their paths being shown by the light of the glittering herbs Wherein life extended to youth only; or youth was the last stage of life; where no other destroyer was known than the flowerarrowedgod and where sleep brought on by sexual exhaustion was the only suspension of sensation In which lovers are made supplicants, till favour is shown reconciliation by the jealous anger of beloveds, in which there are contractions of the eyebrows, quiverings of lips and threateuings with graceful fingers

units.sanskrit: संतानकतरुच्छायासुप्तविद्याधराध्वगम् । यस्य चोपवनं बाह्यं सुगन्धिर् गन्धमादनः ॥
units.english: Whose outer garden is the fragrant Gandhamadana, in which the Vidyàdhara travellers sleep in the shades of the Santanaka heavenly trees

units.sanskrit: अथ ते मुनयो दिव्याः प्रेक्ष्य हैमवतं पुरम् । स्वर्गाभिसंधिसुकृतं वञ्चनाम् इव मेनिरे ॥ ते सद्मनि गिरेर् वेगाद् उन्मुखद्वाःस्थवीक्षिताः । अवतेरुर् जटाभारैर् लिखितानलनिश्चलैः ॥
units.english: Now the divine sages on seeing the capital of Him, thought their performance of holy rites with the object of attaining heaven to be a deception Looked at by the doorkeepers with faces raised up, they, with the masses of their matted hair steady like painted flames of fire, descended with speed into the palace of the mountain

units.sanskrit: गगनाद् अवतीर्णा सा यथावृद्धपुरस्सरा । तोयान्तर् भास्करालीव रेजे मुनिपरम्परा ॥
units.english: The row of sages alighted from the sky, with the seniors preceding in due order, shone like a series of the reflections of the sun in water

units.sanskrit: तान् अर्घ्यान् अर्घ्यम् आदाय दूरात् प्रत्युद्ययौ गिरिः । नमयन् सारगुरुभिः पादन्यासैर् वसुन्धराम् ॥
units.english: Bending the earth by the plantings of his feet heavy with inward substance, the mountain, taking the materials of worship, advanced from a distance to receive them, worthy of adoration

units.sanskrit: धातुताम्राधरः प्रांशुर् देवदारुबृहद्भुजः । प्रकृत्यैव शिलोरस्कः सुव्यक्तो हिमवान् इति ॥
units.english: With lips mineralred having red minerals for his ruddy lips, tall, with arms huge like fir trees having the large fir trees for his arms, and with a chest strong like a rock having rocks for his chest he was clearly known to be Himavat

units.sanskrit: विधिप्रयुक्तसत्कारैः स्वयं मार्गस्य दर्शकः । स तैर् आक्रमयाम् आस शुद्धान्तं शुद्धकर्मभिः ॥
units.english: Himself leading the way, he made them, to whom reception was accorded in the due form and who were of holy practices, enter the barem

units.sanskrit: तत्र वेत्रासनासीनान् कृतासनपरिग्रहः । इत्य् उवाचेश्वरान् वाचं प्राञ्जलिः पृथिवीधरः ॥
units.english: Having taken his seat the lord of mountains, with joined palms, addressed this speech to the divine powerful sages who were already seated in cane seats

units.sanskrit: अपमेघोदयं वर्षम् अदृष्टकुसुमं फलम् । अतर्कितोपपन्नं वो दर्शनं प्रतिभाति मे ॥
units.english: Your sight obtained unexpectedly appears to me like a shower without the previous rise of clouds or like a fruit without the appearance of a flower beforehand

units.sanskrit: मूढं बुद्धम् इवात्मानं हैमीभूतम् इवायसम् । भूमेर् दिवम् इवारूढं मन्ये भवदनुग्रहात् ॥
units.english: By this your favour consider myself like one enlightened being ignorant, or as if transformed into gold being made of iron, or as if raised to heaven from earth

units.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति भूतानाम् अधिगम्यो ऽस्मि शुद्धये । यद् अध्यासितम् अर्हद्भिस् तद् धि तीर्थं प्रचक्षते ॥
units.english: From this day am to be approached for purification by creatures; for that which is resorted to by the adorable is called a holy purifying place

units.sanskrit: अवैमि पूतम् आत्मानं द्वयेनैव द्विजोत्तमाः । मूर्ध्नि गङ्गाप्रपातेन धौतपादाम्भसा च वः ॥ जङ्गमं प्रैष्यभावे वः स्थावरं चरणाङ्कितम् । विभक्तानुग्रहं मन्ये द्विरूपम् अपि मे वपुः ॥
units.english: O you, the most eminent of the twice born Brahmanas, consider myself sanctified by the two only, the fall of the Ganges on my head and by the water from your washed feet consider even my twofold body, as separately favoured the movable by being in the position of your servant, the immovable by being marked by your feet

units.sanskrit: भवत्संभावनोत्थाय परितोषाय मूर्च्छते । अपि व्याप्तदिगन्तानि नाङ्गानि प्रभवन्ति मे ॥
units.english: My limbs though spreading to covering all space within the extremities of quarters are il sufficient to contain the growing joy, caused by the honour done by you

units.sanskrit: न केवलं दरीसंस्थं भास्वतां दर्शनेन वः । अन्तर्गतम् अपास्तं मे रजसो ऽपि परं तमः ॥
units.english: By the sight of you, resplendent illustrious ones, not only the darkness in my caves is removed but even my internal darkness ignorance, lying beyond Rajas the quality of passion is dispelled

units.sanskrit: कर्तव्यं वो न पश्यामि स्याच् चेत् किं नोपपद्यते । शङ्के मत्पावनायैव प्रस्थानं भवताम् इह ॥
units.english: do not see that there is any thing to be done for you; and if there be any, what is there that cannot be expected to be accomplished by you? think your arrival here is simply for my purification

units.sanskrit: तथापि तावत् कस्मिंश् चिद् आज्ञां मे दातुम् अर्हथ । विनियोगप्रसादा हि किङ्कराः प्रभविष्णुषु ॥
units.english: Still be pleased to give me a command in some matter to do something for you for, in respect of their masters servants consider an order as a favour

units.sanskrit: एते वयम् अमी दाराः कन्येयं कुलजीवितम् । ब्रूत येनात्र वः कार्यम् अनास्था बाह्यवस्तुषु ॥
units.english: My own self, my wife here; and this my daughter, the life of your family say which of us you want to be at your service about external things speak not with any regard, no need to say that they will be at your service

units.sanskrit: इत्य् ऊचिवांस् तम् एवार्थं दरीमुखविसर्पिणा । द्विर् इव प्रतिशब्देन व्याजहार हिमालयः ॥
units.english: Himalaya, who spoke thus, said the same thing twice as it were, by its echo resounding from the mouths of the caverns

units.sanskrit: अथाङ्गिरसम् अग्रण्यम् उदाहरणवस्तुषु । ऋषयश् चोदयाम् आसुः प्रत्युवाच स भूधरम् ॥
units.english: Thereupon the sages urged Angiras, best skilled the foremost speaker in matters to be spoken, to speak he replied thus to the mountain

units.sanskrit: उपपन्नम् इदं सर्वम् अतः परम् अपि त्वयि । मनसः शिखराणां च सदृशी ते समुन्नतिः ॥
units.english: All this that you have said is befitting to you and even more; the loftiness of your mind and of your peaks is alike

units.sanskrit: स्थाने त्वां स्थावरात्मानं विष्णुम् आहुस् तथा हि ते । चराचराणां भूतानां कुक्षिर् आधारतां गतः ॥
units.english: Rightly are you called Visbnu in your immovable form for your middle or interior has become the support of all beingsmovable and immovable

units.sanskrit: गाम् अधास्यत् कथं नागो मृणालमृदुभिः फणैः । आ रसातलमूलात् त्वम् अवालम्बिष्यथा न चेत् ॥
units.english: How could the Serpent have borne the earth on hoods as delicate as lotusstalks, had you not sustained it from the bottom of the nether world!

units.sanskrit: अच्छिन्नामलसंतानाः समुद्रोर्म्यनिवारिताः । पुनन्ति लोकान् पुण्यत्वात् कीर्तयः सरितश् च ते ॥
units.english: Your glories and your rivers, with their currents unbroken and untainted and unobstructed by the waves of the seas, purify the worlds owing to their sanctity

units.sanskrit: यथैव श्लाघ्यते गङ्गा पादेन परमेष्ठिनः । प्रभवेण द्वितीयेन तथैवोच्छिरसा त्वया ॥
units.english: Just as Gangà is lauded by her birth from the foot of the supreme Lord, so she is by you of lofty peaks, her second source

units.sanskrit: तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् अधस्ताच् च व्यापको महिमा हरेः । त्रिविक्रमोद्यतस्यासीत् स च स्वाभाविकस् तव ॥
units.english: The greatness of Harî pervaded all space, crosswise upwards and downwards, when attempting to take the three steps with you it is natural

units.sanskrit: यज्ञभागभुजां मध्ये पदम् आतस्थुषा त्वया । उच्चैर् हिरण्मयं शृङ्गं सुमेरोर् वितथीकृतम् ॥
units.english: By you having got a place among those enjoying a share of the sacrificial food, the lofty golden peak of Meru is rendered futile made of less consequence

units.sanskrit: काठिन्यं स्थावरे काये भवता सर्वम् अर्पितम् । इदं तु भक्तिनम्रं ते सताम् आराधनं वपुः ॥
units.english: All hardness has been transferred by you to your immovable form But this your animate form, given to the propitiation of the good, is humble bent low with devotion

units.sanskrit: तद् आगमनकार्यं नः शृणु कार्यं तवैव तत् । श्रेयसाम् उपदेशात् तु वयम् अत्रांशभागिनः ॥
units.english: Hear then the business which has brought us here it is, however, your own business But we are participators in this by our advising in auspicious matters in as much as we have to advise you in what is to your benefit

units.sanskrit: अणिमादिगुणोपेतम् अस्पृष्टपुरुषान्तरम् । शब्दम् ईश्वर इत्य् उच्चैः सार्धचन्द्रं बिभर्ति यः ॥
units.english: He, who bears, along with the crescent moon, the sublime title of Lord, endowed with the attributes animan the power to become atomic and others and not applying to any other person;

units.sanskrit: कल्पितान्योन्यसामर्थ्यैः पृथिव्यादिभिर् आत्मनि । येनेदं ध्रियते विश्वं धुर्यैर् यानम् इवाध्वनि ॥
units.english: By whom is sustained this universe by means of his forms, earth and others, adding to one anothers power, as a carriage is held by horses on the road;

units.sanskrit: योगिनो यं विचिन्वन्ति क्षेत्राभ्यन्तरवर्तिनम् । अनावृत्तिभयं यस्य पदम् आहुर् मनीषिणः ॥
units.english: Whom residing in the interior of the body the heart ascetics seek, and whose abode, the wise declare, is free from the fear of the recurrence of birth;

units.sanskrit: स ते दुहितरं साक्षात् साक्षी विश्वस्य कर्मणः । वृणुते वरदः शंभुर् अस्मत्संक्रामितैः पदैः ॥
units.english: That Sambhu himself, the witness of the doings of the world and the giver of desired objects, asks for your daughter through by words addressed through us

units.sanskrit: तम् अर्थम् इव भारत्या सुतया योक्तुम् अर्हसि । अशोच्या हि पितुः कन्या सद्भर्त्रे प्रतिपादिता ॥
units.english: You will then do well to unite him with your daughter like sense with words for a daughter given to a good husband is not to be regretted by is no matter of regret for the father

units.sanskrit: यावद् एतानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । मातरं कल्पयन्त्य् एनाम् ईशो हि जगतः पिता ॥
units.english: Let all these creatures, immovable and movableas many as they are consider her their mother; for Siva Is the father of the universe

units.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शितिकण्ठाय विबुधास् तदनन्तरम् । चरणौ रञ्जयन्त्य् अस्याश् चूडामणिमरीचिभिः ॥
units.english: Let the gods, after having bowed down to the darknecked God, tinge her feet with the rays of their crestjewels

units.sanskrit: उमा वधूर् भवान् दाता याचितार इमे वयम् । वरः शंभुर् अलं ह्य् एष त्वत्कुलोद्भूतये विधिः ॥
units.english: Uma is the bride; you, her giver in marriage and here are we solicitors for her; and Sambhu is the bridegroom this combination of circumstances is enough for the exaltation of your family

units.sanskrit: अस्तोतुः स्तूयमानस्य वन्द्यस्यानन्यवन्दिनः । सुतासंबन्धविधिना भव विश्वगुरोर् गुरुः ॥
units.english: By forming the alliance through your daughter, be the father of the father of the universe, who does not praise any one, but is praised by all, who adores none but is adored by all

units.sanskrit: एवं वादिनि देवर्षौ पार्श्वे पितुर् अधोमुखी । लीलाकमलपत्राणि गणयाम् आस पार्वती ॥
units.english: While the sage was speaking thus, Párvatt, who was by her fathers side, counted the petals of her sportive lotus with a downcast look

units.sanskrit: शैलः संपूर्णकामो ऽपि मेनामुखम् उदैक्षत । प्रायेण गृहिणीनेत्राः कन्यार्थे हि कुटुम्बिनः ॥
units.english: The mountain, though his desire was entirely fulfilled, looked up to the face of Mená generally in matters relating to daughters householders are guided by their wives have wives for their guiding eyes

units.sanskrit: मेने मेनापि तत् सर्वं पत्युः कार्यम् अभीप्सितम् । भवन्त्य् अव्यभिचारिण्यो भर्तुर् इष्टे पतिव्रताः ॥
units.english: Mena, too, approved of all that, the much desired object of her husband Wives devoted to their husbands never disagree with their lords in their desired objects

units.sanskrit: इदम् अत्रोत्तरं न्याय्यम् इति बुद्ध्या विमृश्य सः । आददे वचसाम् अन्ते मङ्गलालङ्कृतां सुताम् ॥
units.english: He, having thought in his mind after reflectionthis would be the proper reply to thistook hold of his daughter, auspiciously adorned, at the conclusion of the sages speech

units.sanskrit: एहि विश्वात्मने वत्से भिक्षासि परिकल्पिता । अर्थिनो मुनयः प्राप्तं गृहमेधिफलं मया ॥
units.english: Come on, dear daughter thou art made alms to Siva the soul of the universe The sages are the petitioners have obtained the fruit of a householders or, married life

units.sanskrit: एतावद् उक्त्वा तनयाम् ऋषीन् आह महीधरः । इयं नमति वः सर्वांस् त्रिलोचनवधूर् इति ॥
units.english: Having said so much to his daughter, the mountain said to the sageshere bows to you all the bride of the threeeyed God

units.sanskrit: ईप्सितार्थक्रियोदारं ते ऽभिनन्द्य गिरेर् वचः । आशीर्भिर् एधयाम् आसुः पुरःपाकाभिर् अम्बिकाम् ॥
units.english: Having commended the speech of the mountain, noble on account of his acting up to their wishes, they the sages magnified Amblkâ with benedictions that were soon to fructify

units.sanskrit: तां प्रणामादरस्रस्तजाम्बूनदवतंसकाम् । अङ्कम् आरोपयाम् आस लज्जमानाम् अरुन्धती ॥
units.english: Arundhati placed on her lap that blushing girl whose two gold earrings slipped off in her hurry earnest desire to make a bow

units.sanskrit: तन्मातरं चाश्रुमुखीं दुहितृस्नेहविक्लवाम् । वरस्यानन्यपूर्वस्य विशोकाम् अकरोद् गुणैः ॥
units.english: And by mentioning the virtues of the bridegroom who had no other wife beforehand, she consoled her mother whose face was suffused with tears, and who was distracted on account of her affection for her daughter

units.sanskrit: वैवाहिकीं तिथिं पृष्टास् तत्क्षणं हरबन्धुना । ते त्र्यहाद् ऊर्ध्वम् आख्याय चेलुश् चीरपरिग्रहाः ॥ ते हिमालयम् आमन्त्र्य पुनः प्रेक्ष्य च शूलिनम् । सिद्धं चास्मै निवेद्यार्थं तद्विसृष्टाः खम् उद्ययुः ॥
units.english: Asked the very moment, as for the auspicious day for marriage, by Sivas future kinsman, the barkclothed sages, saying that that would be after three days thence, departed Having taken leave of Himalaya and returned to Siva they told him that their mission was succesful and being dismissed by him flew up into the sky

units.sanskrit: पशुपतिर् अपि तान्य् अहानि कृच्छ्राद् अगमयद् अद्रिसुतासमागमोत्कः । कम् अपरम् अवशं न विप्रकुर्युर् विभुम् अपि तं यद् अमी स्पृशन्ति भावाः ॥
units.english: The Lord of creatures, too, eager for the union with the mountains daughter, passed those days with difficulty Whom else under the power of senses will not these feelings mental conditions distract when they affect even the Almighty?

units.sanskrit: अथौषधीनाम् अधिपस्य वृद्धौ तिथौ च जामित्रगुणान्वितायाम् । समेतबन्धुर् हिमवान् सुताया विवाहदीक्षाविधिम् अन्वतिष्ठत् ॥
units.english: Then after the settling of the weddingday in the waxing fortnight of the lord of herbs, on the day endowed with the virtue auspiciousness of the Jamitra seventh position from the zodiacal sign fixed as auspicious for the marriage, Himavat, with his relatives gathered, performed the ceremonies preliminary to the wedding of his daughter

units.sanskrit: वैवाहिकैः कौतुकसंविधानैर् गृहे गृहे व्यग्रपुरंध्रिवर्गम् । आसीत् पुरं सानुमतो ऽनुरागाद् अन्तःपुरं चैककुलोपमेयम् ॥ संतानकाकीर्णमहापथं तच् चीनांशुकैः कल्पितकेतुमालम् । भासा ज्वलत् काञ्चनतोरणानां स्थानान्तरस्वर्ग इवाबभासे ॥
units.english: On account of the ladies being busily engaged, out of love, in every house, in getting up the auspicious things fit for the marriage ceremony, the city and the inner apartment of the mountain were comparable to appeared to form one house The city, the high roads of which were strewed with heavenly flowers, the row of flags in which was made of Chinasilk and which was ablaze with the brilliance of its golden outergates, appeared as if it was heaven trausplanted

units.sanskrit: एकैव सत्याम् अपि पुत्रपङ्क्तौ चिरस्य दृष्टेव मृतोत्थितेव । आसन्नपाणिग्रहणेति पित्रोर् उमा विशेषोच्छ्वसितं बभूव ॥
units.english: Although they had a number of chidren, Uma alone, like one seen after a long time or like one revived after death, specially became the life of an object of special love to her parents as she was about to be given away in marriage

units.sanskrit: अङ्काद् ययाव् अङ्कम् उदीरिताशीः सा मण्डनान् मण्डनम् अन्वभुङ्क्त । संबन्धिभिन्नो ऽपि गिरेः कुलस्य स्नेहस् तदेकायतनं जगाम ॥
units.english: With a benediction pronounced upon her every time she passed from lap to lap and enjoyed ornamentation after ornamentation though shared by different relatives the love of the mountains family was centred in her was focussed on that one object

units.sanskrit: मैत्रे मुहूर्ते शशलाञ्छनेन योगं गतासूत्तरफल्गुनीषु । तस्याः शरीरे प्रतिकर्म चक्रुर् बन्धुस्त्रियो याः पतिपुत्रवत्यः ॥
units.english: At the Muhurta period of minutes auspi ciously presided over by the sun and when the moon was in conjunction with Uttaraphalgunf its twelfth mansion, the kinswomen with their husbands and male children living put decorations on her body

units.sanskrit: सा गौरसिद्धार्थनिवेशवद्भिर् दूर्वाप्रवालैः प्रतिभिन्नरागम् । निर्नाभिकौशेयम् उपात्तबाणम् अभ्यङ्गनेपथ्यम् अलञ्चकार ॥ बभौ च संपर्कम् उपेत्य बाला नवेन दीक्षाविधिसायकेन । करेण भानोर् बहुलावसाने संधुक्ष्यमाणेव शशाङ्कलेखा ॥
units.english: She adorned the dress she put on for being smeared with oil previous to bathing, the beauty of which was heightened by the tender sprouts of durva mixed with white mustard seeds, in which a silk cloth was worn reaching beyond the navel or, in which the silken cloth worn round the navel was removed and in which an arrow was held in the hand

units.sanskrit: तां लोध्रकल्केन हृताङ्गतैलाम् आश्यानकालेयकृताङ्गरागाम् । वासो वसानाम् अभिषेकयोग्यं नार्यश् चतुष्काभिमुखं व्यनैषुः ॥
units.english: The women conducted her, the oil applied to whose body was removed by the powder of Lodhra, whose person was besmeared with the slightly diy Káleya anguent or saffron pigment and who had worn a cloth flt for bathing to the fourpillared saloon

units.sanskrit: विन्यस्तवैदूर्यशिलातले ऽस्मिन्न् अविद्धमुक्ताफलभक्तिचित्रे । आवर्जिताष्टापदकुम्भतोयाः सतूर्यम् एनां स्नपयां बभूवुः ॥ सा मङ्गलस्नानविशुद्धगात्री गृहीतपत्युद्गमनीयवस्त्रा । निर्वृत्तपर्जन्यजलाभिषेका प्रफुल्लकाशा वसुधेव रेजे ॥
units.english: In it having a pavement of sapphire stones placed in it and variegated by being inlaid with ornamental rows of pearls, they bathed her, while the furyas sounded, with water poured out of gold pots She whose body looked brighter by the auspicious bath and who had put on a dress pair of bleached gar ments fit for approaching the bridegroom, shone like the earth, that had received a washing from rain water and that had the Kâsá flowers fullblown

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् प्रदेशाच् च वितानवन्तं युक्तं मणिस्तम्भचतुष्टयेन । पतिव्रताभिः परिगृह्य निन्ये कॢप्तासनं कौतुकवेदिमध्यम् ॥
units.english: From that place she, being chasped, was conducted by Indies devoted to their husbands to the middle of the auspicious altar which had a canopy and four pillars at its four corners and which was provided with a seat

units.sanskrit: तां प्राङ्मुखीं तत्र निवेश्य तन्वीं क्षणं व्यलम्बन्त पुरो निषण्णाः । भूतार्थशोभाह्रियमाणनेत्राः प्रसाधने सन्निहिते ऽपि नार्यः ॥
units.english: Having seated the girl of a slender frame, facing the east on it, the ladies sitting before her with their eyes attracted by real unartificial beauty delayed for some time, though the articles of decoration were at hand

units.sanskrit: धूपोष्मणा त्याजितम् आर्द्रभावं केशान्तम् अन्तःकुसुमं तदीयम् । पर्याक्षिपत् काचिद् उदारबन्धं दूर्वावता पाण्डुमधूकदाम्ना ॥ विन्यस्तशुक्लागुरु चक्रुर् अस्या गोरोचनापत्रविभङ्गम् अङ्गम् । सा चक्रवाकाङ्कितसैकतायास् त्रिस्रोतसः कान्तिम् अतीत्य तस्थौ ॥ लग्नद्विरेफं परिभूय पद्मं समेघलेखं शशिनश् च बिम्बम् । तदाननश्रीर् अलकैः प्रसिद्धैश् चिच्छेद सादृश्यकथाप्रसङ्गम् ॥
units.english: One of the ladies tied the beautiful mass of her hair, the moisture of which was removed by the smoke of incense and which had flowers inside it with a garland of yellow Madhuka flowers Bassia Latifolia intermixed with durva grass so as to form a charming knot They the ladies applied white aloe paste to her body, and decorated it with ornamental paintings drawn with gorochana yellow pigment she thus stood surpas sing the beauty of the threecoursed river Ganges, the sandy banks of which are marked with the Chakravàka birds

units.sanskrit: कर्णार्पितो लोध्रकषायरूक्षे गोरोचनाक्षेपनितान्तगौरे । तस्याः कपोले परभागलाभाद् बबन्ध चक्षूंषि यवप्ररोहः ॥ रेखाबिभक्तश् च विभक्तगात्र्याः किंचिन्मधूच्छिष्टविमृष्टरागः । काम् अप्य् अभिख्यां स्फुरितैर् अपुष्यद् आसन्नलावण्यफलो ऽध्ररोष्ठः ॥
units.english: The barley sprout placed on her ear, by its having attained excellence as it hung over her cheek roughi with the besmearing of lodhra powder and excessively yellow with the paint of gerochana yellow pigment arrested eyes held rivetted upon it the eyes of the onJookers The lower lip of her, with symmetrical limbs, parted by a line, in the middle the redness of which was heightened by a thin layer of wax, and which had the fruition of its loveliness near, gave rise to an indescribable beauty by its throbbings

units.sanskrit: पत्युः शिरश्चन्द्रकलाम् अनेन स्पृशेति सख्या परिहासपूर्वम् । सा रञ्जयित्वा चरणौ कृताशीर् माल्येन तां निर्वचनं जघान ॥ तस्याः सुजातोत्पलपत्रकान्ते प्रसाधिकाभिर् नयने निरीक्ष्य । न चक्षुषोः कान्तिविशेषबुद्ध्या कालाञ्जनं मङ्गलम् इत्य् उपात्तम् ॥
units.english: When blessed by her friend after dying her feet with lac dye, jocosely sayingtouch strike the digit of the moon on thy husbands head with thisshe struck her with a wreath of flowers without uttering a word The ladies decorating her, seeing that her eyes were as gracefui as the petals of a lovely well grown lotus, took up collyrium for putting it into them not because they thought it would add to their beauty, but because it was auspicious to do so

units.sanskrit: सा संभवद्भिः कुसुमैर् लतेव ज्योतिर्भिर् उद्यद्भिर् इव त्रियामा । सरिद् विहङ्गैर् इव लीयमानैर् आमुच्यमानाभरणा चकासे ॥
units.english: As the ornaments were being put on her person she shone like a creeper with flowers springing up, like the night with stars rising therein, and like a river with birds chakravàkas resorting thereto

units.sanskrit: आत्मानम् आलोक्य च शोभमानम् आदर्शबिम्बे स्तिमितायताक्षी । हरोपयाने त्वरिता बभूव स्त्रीणां प्रियालोकफलो हि वेषः ॥
units.english: Observing her form looking magnificent by the dress in a mirror she, with her long eyes steady, became eager to approach Siva surely the dressing of women has for its fruit object the sight of or its being seen by their husbands

units.sanskrit: अथाङ्गुलिभ्यां हरितालम् आर्द्रं माङ्गल्यम् आदाय मनःशिलां च । कर्णावसक्तामलदन्तपत्रं माता तदीयं मुखम् उन्नमय्य ॥ उमास्तनोद्भेदम् अनुप्रवृद्धो मनोरथो यः प्रथमो बभूव । तम् एव मेना दुहितुः कथंचिद् विवाहदीक्षातिलकं चकार ॥
units.english: Then her mother Mená, taking with her two fingers the auspicious wet yellow orpiment and the red arsenic and having raised her face, on the two ears of which hung two bright earrings, made with great difficulty the tilaka mark on the forehead of, her daughter giving shape thereby just to the desire which rose in her mind for the first time, and which attained growth was intensified after the development of Umás bosom

units.sanskrit: बबन्ध चास्राकुलदृष्टिर् अस्याः स्थानान्तरे कल्पितसन्निवेशम् । धात्र्यङ्गुलीभिः प्रतिसार्यमाणम् ऊर्णमयं कौतुकहस्तसूत्रम् ॥ क्षीरोदवेलेव सफेनपुञ्जा पर्याप्तचन्द्रेव शरत्त्रियामा । नवं नवक्षौमनिवासिनी सा भूयो बभौ दर्पणम् आदधाना ॥
units.english: With her eyes filled with the tears of joy she also fastened the marriagestring of wool round her hand, which was misplaced but which was being pushed back to the right place by the nurse with her fingers She, clad in a fresh silk white garment and olding a new mirror appeared to great advantage, like the shore of the milky ocean with a mass of foam on it Ot like the autumnal moonlet night with the moon

units.sanskrit: ताम् अर्चिताभ्यः कुलदेवताभ्यः कुलप्रतिष्ट्ःआं प्रणमय्य माता । अकारयत् कारयितव्यदक्षा क्रमेण पादग्रहणं सतीनाम् ॥
units.english: The mother, expert in what was to be done what one should be made to do, on such an occasion having made her, the mainstay or glory of the family, bow down to the worshipped tutelary deities, caused her to seize fall at the feet of chaste ladies in due order

units.sanskrit: अखण्डितं प्रेम लभस्व पत्युर् इत्य् उच्यते ताभिर् उमा स्म नम्रा । तया तु तस्यार्धशरीरभाजा पश्चात्कृताः स्निग्धजनाशिषो ऽ पि ॥
units.english: Do thou obtain the ever continuous uninterrupted or undivided love of thy husbandthus was Umá, bowing before them, spoken to blessed by them; but by her, sharing half of his body, the blessings of her loving relatives were outstripped

units.sanskrit: इच्छाविभूत्योर् अनुरूपम् अद्रिस् तस्याः कृती कृत्यम् अशेषयित्वा । सभ्यः सभायां सुहृदास्थितायां तस्थौ वृषाङ्कागमनप्रतीक्षः ॥ तावद् वरस्यापि कुबेरशैले तत्पूर्वपाणिग्रहणानुरूपम् । प्रसाधनं मातृभिर् आदृताभिर् न्यस्तं पुरस्तात् पुरशासनस्य ॥
units.english: The Mountain, well versed in things to be done and polite, having finished the ceremonies connected with her in a manner befitting or proportionate to his desire and wealth, sat in the reception hall attended by his friends awaiting the arrival of Siva the bullemblemed God In the meantime, before Bhava, the destroyer of the cities, too, were placed, on Kuberas mountain Kailasa, the decorations suited to his marriage, the first of its kind, by the divine mothers diligenfly engaged or, full of respect

units.sanskrit: तद्गौरवान् मङ्गलमण्डनश्रीः सा पस्पृशे केवलम् ईश्वरेण । स्व एव वेषः परिणेतुर् इष्टं भावान्तरं तस्य विभोः प्रपेदे ॥ बभूव भस्मैव सिताङ्गरागः कपालम् एवामलशेखरश्रीः । उपान्तभागेषु च रोचनाङ्को गजाजिनस्यैव दुकूलभावः ॥ शङ्खान्तरद्योति विलोचनं यद् अन्तर्निविष्टामलपिङ्गतारम् । सान्निध्यपक्षे हरितालमय्यास् तद् एव जातं तिलकक्रियायाः ॥
units.english: Thus the ashes themselves became the white unguent for body, and the skull attained the beauty of the bright crest ornament, while the elephants hide itself was transformed into a silk garment with marks of swans &c on its borders made with rochana yellow pigment formed from cows bile The eye itself which shone in the middle of the frontal bone, and which had the clear tawny pupil in its interior, proved on the side of the presence of or after Malli became for the accomplishment of ie served as the tilaka mark of Haritala yellow orpiment

units.sanskrit: यथाप्रदेशं भुजगेश्वराणां करिश्यताम् आभरणान्तरत्वम् । शरीरमात्रं विकृतिं प्रपेदे तथैव तस्थुः फणरत्नशोभाः ॥
units.english: The bodies only of the lords of serpents transforming themselves into different ornaments in their proper places underwent a change the brilliant gems in their hoods remained just as they were

units.sanskrit: दिवापि निष्ठ्यूतमरीचिभासा बाल्याद् अनाविष्कृतलाञ्छनेन । चन्द्रेण नित्यं प्रतिभिन्नमौलेश् चूडामणेः किं ग्रहणं हरस्य ॥
units.english: What was the use of putting on the crestjewel to Hara, whose crest is always united with the moon, which sheds even during the day the brilliance of its rays and which does not manifest the spot on account of its being merely a digit

units.sanskrit: इत्य् अद्भुतैकप्रभवः प्रभावात् प्रसिद्धनेपथ्यविधेर् विधाता । आत्मानम् आसन्नगणोपनीते खड्गे निषक्तप्रतिमं ददर्श ॥
units.english: He, the only chief source of wonderful things who had thus created all the wellknown articles of dress by his divine power, saw his image reflected in a sword brought by a gana servant who was near

units.sanskrit: स गोपतिं नन्दिभुजावलम्बी शार्दूलचर्मान्तरितोरुपृष्ठम् । तद्भक्तिसंक्षिप्तबृहत्प्रमाणम् आरुह्य कैलासम् इव प्रतस्थे ॥
units.english: He, reclining on Nandis arm, mounted the lordly bull looking at the mountain Kailasa, whose broad back was covered with a tigers skin, and who out of devotion to him had contracted his huge bulk, and set out

units.sanskrit: तं मातरो देवम् अनुव्रजन्त्यः स्ववाहनक्षोभचलावतंसाः । मुखैः प्रभामण्डलरेणुगौरैः पद्माकरं चक्रुर् इवान्तरीक्षम् ॥ तासां च पश्चात् कनकप्रभाणां काली कपालाभरणा चकासे । बलाकिनी नीलपयोदराजी दूरं पुरःक्षिप्तशतह्रदेव ॥
units.english: The mothers following the God and having their earrings agitated by the motion of their vehicles, made the sky a bed of daylotuses, as it were, with their faces yellowishwhite or reddish whiteMalli with the pollen in the shape of their encircling effulgence Behind them, having the brilliance of gold shone the goddess Kàlf, wearing ornaments of white skulls like an array of blue clouds with cranes assembled and throwing flashes of lightning far in the front

units.sanskrit: ततो गणैः शूलभृतः पुरोगैर् उदीरितो मङ्गलतूर्यघोषः । विमानशृङ्गाण्य् अवगाहमानः शशंस सेवावसरं सुरेभ्यः ॥ उपाददे तस्य सहस्ररश्मिस् त्वष्ट्रा नवं निर्मितम् आतपत्रम् । स तद्दुकूलाद् अविदूरमौलिर् बभौ पतद्गङ्ग इवोत्तमाङ्गे ॥
units.english: Then the auspicious sound of music sent forth ly the ganas marching in front of Siva the tridentholder pervading the domes of their celestial vehieles, told the gods that it was right time for them to wait upon the god The sun held the new umbrella made by Tvashtr the heavenly architect; and the god, with his head at no great distance from its silk fringe, appeared to have the Ganges, as it were, falling on his head

units.sanskrit: मूर्ते च गङ्गायमुने तदानीं सचामरे देवम् असेविषाताम् । समुद्रगारूपविपर्यये ऽपि सहंसपाते इव लक्ष्यमाणे ॥
units.english: Ganga and Yamuna also, assuming visible forms and holding Chaurics, served the god, at that time appearing to have as it were a flight of swans, although their riverforms were changed

units.sanskrit: तम् अन्वगच्छत् प्रथमो विधाता श्रीवत्सलक्ष्मा पुरुषश् च साक्षात् । जयेति वाचा महिमानम् अस्य संवर्धयन्त्या हविषेव वह्निम् ॥
units.english: The primeval Creator and the god bearing the mark Srivatsa Vishnu came incarnate to him, magnifying his glory with the words Be victorious, like fire with clarified butter

units.sanskrit: एकैव मूर्तिर् बिभिदे त्रिधा सा सामान्यम् एषां प्रथमावरत्वम् । विष्णोर् हरस् तस्य हरिः कदाचिद् वेधास् तयोस् ताव् अपि धातुर् आद्यौ ॥
units.english: That was but one form divided in the three waystheir seniority or juniority is common interchangeable sometime Hara is prior to Vishnu or Hari to the former; sometimes the Creator to them both; at others the two to the Creator

units.sanskrit: तं लोकपालाः पुरुहूतमुख्याः श्रीलक्षणोत्सर्गविनीतवेषाः । दृष्टिप्रदाने कृतनन्दिसंज्ञास् तद्दर्शिताः प्राञ्जलयः प्रणेमुः ॥
units.english: The protectors of worlds, with Indra, chief among them, appearing in modest humble dresses, the signs of royalty being cast off, and betokening Nandi to allow them an interview, bowed with joined palms when ushered in

units.sanskrit: कम्पेन मूर्ध्नः शतपत्रयोनिं वाचा हरिं वृत्रहणं स्मितेन । आलोकमात्रेण सुरान् अशेषान् संभावयाम् आस यथाप्रधानम् ॥
units.english: He honoured Brahman with a nod of the head, Hari with words spoken, Indra with a smile, and the other gods with a mere look, according to seniority

units.sanskrit: तस्मै जयाशीः ससृजे पुरस्तात् सप्तर्षिभिस् तान् स्मितपूर्वम् आह । विवाहयज्ञे वितते ऽत्र यूयम् अध्वर्यवः पूर्ववृता मयेति ॥
units.english: The seven sages first pronounced a benediction saying, May you prosper, and he said to them with a smileIn this nuptial sacrifice that is commenced, you have already been chosen by me as the officiating priests

units.sanskrit: विश्वावसुप्राग्रहरैः प्रवीणैः संगीयमानत्रिपुरावदानः । अध्वानम् अध्वान्तविकारलङ्घ्यस् ततार ताराधिपखण्डधारी ॥
units.english: Siva the wearer of a portion of the lord of stars who is not to be overpowered by dark passions and whose glory regarding his destruction of the three cities was sung by celestial lutebearers, or, skilled choristers with Vis wâvasu as their leader, crossed the way

units.sanskrit: खे खेलगामी तम् उवाह वाहः सशब्दचामीकरकिङ्किणीकः । तटाभिघाताद् इव लग्नपङ्के धुन्वन् मुहुः प्रोतघने विषाणे ॥
units.english: The bull, moving charmingly through the sky with his golden little bells resounding and repeatedly shaking his horns, which piercing through the clouds appeared as if covered with mud by being struck against a bank or skirt of a mountain bore him onl

units.sanskrit: स प्रापद् अप्राप्तपराभियोगं नगेन्द्रगुप्तं नगरं मुहूर्तात् । पुरो विलग्नैर् हरदृष्टिपातैः सुवर्णसूत्रैर् इव कृष्यमाणः ॥
units.english: He the bull arrived in a moment at the city protected by the lord of mountains, which had never experienced an attack from an enemy, drawn as if by the glances of Hara extending forward like golden strings

units.sanskrit: तस्योपकण्ठे घननीलकण्ट्ःअः कुतूहलाद् उन्मुखपौरदृष्टः । स्वबाणचिह्नाद् अवतीर्य मार्गाद् आसन्नभूपृष्ठम् इयाय देवः ॥
units.english: The god, with his neck dark like a cloud or whose neck was of a deep dark alighting in its vicinity from the path marked by his own arrow the sky, being looked at by the townsmen with faces raised up through curiosity, went to the surface of an adjacent ground

units.sanskrit: तम् ऋद्धिमद्बन्धुजनाधिरूढैर् वृन्दैर् गजानां गिरिचक्रवर्ती । प्रत्युज्जगामागमनप्रतीतः प्रफुल्लवृक्षैः कटकैर् इव स्वैः ॥
units.english: The lord of mountains, delighted at his arrival, went forth to receive him, with arrays of elephants mounied by his rich kinsfolk as with his own ridges full of trees smiling with fullblown flowers

units.sanskrit: वर्गाव् उभौ देवमहीधराणां द्वारे पुरस्योद्घटितापिधाने । समीयतुर् दूरविसर्पिघोषौ भिन्नैकसेतू पयसाम् इवौघौ ॥
units.english: The two parties of the gods and the mountains with their bustle reaching far, met at the gate of the city with its doors thrown open, like two streams of water breaking through the same bridge with their commotion spreading to a distance

units.sanskrit: ह्रीमान् अभूद् भूमिधरो हरेण त्रैलोक्यवन्द्येन कृतप्रणामः । पूर्वं महिम्ना स हि तस्य दूरम् आवर्जितं नात्मशिरो विवेद ॥
units.english: The mountain felt ashamed being saluted by Hara, adorable to the three worlds For he did not know that his own head was already far bent low by his the gods glory

units.sanskrit: स प्रीतियोगाद् विकसन्मुखश्रीर् जामातुर् अग्रेसरताम् उपेत्य । प्रावेशयन् मन्दिरम् ऋद्धम् एनम् आगुल्फकीर्णापणमार्गपुष्पम् ॥
units.english: He with his beautiful face brightening through joy, led the way getting to the state of a leader of his soninlaw and conducted him to his wealthy city, in the marketstreets of which flowers were scattered kneedeep

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् मुहूर्ते पुरसुन्दरीणाम् ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानाम् । प्रासादमालासु बभूवुर् इत्थं त्यक्तान्यकार्याणि विचेष्टितानि ॥
