units.english: At that time, the beauteous ladies of the city, eager to obtain a good sight of sa, spontaneously acted in the following way, all other occupations being set aside, in the rows of palaces

units.sanskrit: आलोकमार्गं सहसा व्रजन्त्या कयाचिद् उद्वेष्टनवान्तमाल्यः । बन्धुं न संभावित एव तावत् करेण रुद्धो ऽपि न केशपाशः ॥ प्रसाधिकालम्बितम् अग्रपादम् आक्षिप्य काचिद् द्रवरागम् एव । उत्सृष्टलीलागतिर् आगवाक्षाद् अलक्तकाङ्कां पदवीं ततान ॥
units.english: A certain lady going in haste to the window did not at all think of tying up her mass of hair, which was loosened from its tie with its wreath of flowers dropped down, though holding it in the hand Some lady snatching her forefoot held by her dressing maid, while the red dye on it was yet wet, and having given up her graceful galt stretched a line of footprints marked with redlace to the latticed window

units.sanskrit: विलोचनं दक्षिणम् अञ्जनेन संभाव्य तद्वञ्चितवामनेत्रा । तथैव वातायनसंनिकर्षं ययौ शलाकाम् अपरा वहन्ती ॥
units.english: Another lady having adorned her right eye with collyrium, while her left eye was without it, went in that very state, to the vicinity of the window, holding in her hand the painting pencil or stick

units.sanskrit: जालान्तरप्रेषितदृष्तिर् अन्या प्रस्थानभिन्नां न बबन्ध नीवीम् । नाभिप्रविष्टाभरणप्रभेण हस्तेन तस्थाव् अवलम्ब्य वासः ॥
units.english: Another of the fair sex who was looking directed her eye through the lattices of the window did not fasten the knot of her under garment loosened by her hasty movement, but stood holding up her garment with her hand with the brilliance of its ornaments penetrating her navel

units.sanskrit: अर्धाचिता सत्वरम् उत्थितायाः पदे पदे दुर्निमिते गलन्ती । कस्याश्चिद् आसीद् रशना तदानीम् अङ्गुष्ठमूलार्पितसूत्रशेषा ॥
units.english: The waistband, halfstrung, of another lady who rose in haste, the gems of which dropped at every illplaced step, had only its string left at the time, fastened to the root of her big toe

units.sanskrit: तासां मुखैर् आसवगन्धगर्भैर् व्याप्तान्तराः सान्द्रकुतूहलानाम् । विलोलनेत्रभ्रमरैर् गवाक्षाः सहस्रपत्राभरणा इवासन् ॥ तावत् पताकाकुलम् इन्दुमौलिर् उत्तोरणं राजपथं प्रपेदे । प्रासादशृङ्गाणि दिवापि कुर्वञ् ज्योत्स्नाभिषेकद्विगुणद्युतीनि ॥
units.english: The windows, having their holes filled up with the faces of those ladies, stirred up with intense curiosity, with the scent of wine remaining within and the rolling eyes like black bees hovering about, looked as if they were decorated with lotuses In the meantime Hara the moon, crested God came to the royal road with numerous flags flying and adorned with ornamental arches raised, doubling, even in the day time, the splendour of the tops of palaces by shedding on them moonlight

units.sanskrit: तम् एकदृश्यं नयनैः पिबन्त्यो नार्यो न जग्मुर् विषयान्तराणि । तथा हि शेषेन्द्रियवृत्तिर् आसां सर्वात्मना चक्षुर् इव प्रविष्टा ॥
units.english: The women, ardently looking at him, the one object of sight, with their eyes, did nºt think of any other object of sense thus the functions of all their other senses bad entered as it were their eyes in their entirety

units.sanskrit: स्थाने तपो दुश्चरम् एतदर्थम् अपर्णया पेलवयापि तप्तम् । या दास्यम् अप्य् अस्य लभेत नारी सा स्यात् कृतार्था किम् उताङ्कशय्याम् ॥
units.english: Blessed will be the woman she will have the mission of life fulfilled who obtains the privilege of even serving him; what to say then of her who can repose on his lap

units.sanskrit: परस्परेण स्पृहणीयशोभं न चेद् इदं द्वन्द्वम् अयोजयिष्यत् । अस्मिन् द्वये रूपविधानयत्नः पत्युः प्रजानां विफलो ऽभविश्यत् ॥
units.english: Had not the Creator united with each other this pair, of covetable beauty, then the effort of the lord of creation to endow the two with beauty would have been fruitless

units.sanskrit: न नूनम् आरूढरुषा शरीरम् अनेन दग्धं कुसुमायुधस्य । व्रीडाद् अमुं देवम् उदीक्ष्य मन्ये संन्यस्तदेहः स्वयम् एव कामः ॥
units.english: Surely the body of Kama the flowerarrowed god was not burnt by him, his anger being roused on seeing the god; it was from shame, think, that Kama relinquished his boby of his own accord

units.sanskrit: अनेन संबन्धम् उपेत्य दिष्ट्या मनोरथप्रार्थितम् ईश्वरेण । मूर्धानम् आलि क्षितिधारणोच्चम् उच्चैस्तरां वक्ष्यति शैलराजः ॥
units.english: Having through goodluck, entered into relationship, ardently desired by the mind, with this lord, O friend, the lord of mountains will hold higher his head already lofty by his sustaining the earth

units.sanskrit: इत्य् ओषधिप्रस्थविलासिनीनां शृण्वन् कथाः श्रोत्रसुखास् त्रिनेत्रः । केयूरचूर्णीकृतलाजमुष्टिं हिमालयस्यालयम् आससाद ॥
units.english: The threeeyed god, thus hearing the talks gratifying to the ear, of thy gay ladies of Oshadhiprastha, came to the abode of Himálaya, where the handfuls of fried rice were pulverised by armlets

units.sanskrit: तत्रावतीर्याच्युतदत्तहस्तः शरद्घनाद् दीधितिमान् इवोक्ष्णः । क्रान्तानि पूर्वं कमलासनेन कक्ष्यान्तराण्य् अद्रिपतेर् विवेश ॥
units.english: Then descending, assisted by Achyuta by offering his arm, from his bull, like the sun from an autumnal cloud, he entered the apartments of the lord of mountains previously entered into by Brahma

units.sanskrit: तम् अन्वग् इन्द्रप्रमुखाश् च देवाः सप्तर्षिपूर्वाः परमर्षयश् च । गणाश् च गिर्यालयम् अभ्यगच्छन् प्रशस्तम् आरम्भम् इवोत्तमार्थाः ॥ तत्रेश्वरो विष्टरभाग् यथावत् सरत्नम् अर्घ्यं मधुमच् च गव्यम् । नवे दुकूले च नगोपनीतं प्रत्यग्रहीत् सर्वम् अमन्त्रवर्जम् ॥
units.english: Just after him there arrived at the house of the mountain the gods headed by Indra, the great sages preceded by the seven sages, and the attendants of Siva, as great achievements follow an excellent beginning measure There the lord seated on a seat, duly accepted the offering of worship with jewels, honey, curds and clarified butter, and a pair of new silk garmentsall of them presented by the mountain, with the recitation of the holy mantras

units.sanskrit: दुकूलवासाः स वधूसमीपं निन्ये विनीतैर् अवरोधरक्षैः । वेलासमीपं स्फुटफेनराजिर् नवैर् उदन्वान् इव चन्द्रपादैः ॥
units.english: He, clad in silk garments, was conducted to the bride by the wellbehaved keepers of the inner apartment, as the water of the sea is carried on to the shore by the rays of the rising moon the new rays of the moon

units.sanskrit: तया प्रवृद्धाननचन्द्रकान्त्या प्रफुल्लचक्षुःकुमुदः कुमार्या । प्रसन्नचेतःसलिलः शिवो ऽभूत् संसृज्यमानः शरदेव लोकः ॥
units.english: Being united with her the beauty of whose moonlike face was heightened, like the world with the autumnal season, the beauty of whose face, the moon, is increased Siva had the lotuses of his eyes expanded like water rendered clear delighted

units.sanskrit: तयोः समापत्तिषु कातराणि किंचिद्व्यवस्थापितसंहृतानि । ह्रीयन्त्रणां तत्क्षणम् अन्वभूवन्न् अन्योन्यलोलानि विलोचनानि ॥
units.english: The eyes of the two, eagerly longing to see each other, which shiank back as they met and which were withdrawn after being steadied a little, experienced at that moment the restraint of bashfulness

units.sanskrit: तस्याः करं शैलगुरूपनीतं जग्राह ताम्राङ्गुलिम् अष्टमूर्त्तिः । उमातनौ गूढतनोः स्मरस्य तच्छङ्किनः पूर्वम् इव प्ररोहम् ॥ रोमोद्गमः प्रादुर् अभूद् उमायाः स्विन्नाङ्गुलिः पुङ्गवकेतुर् आसीत् । वृत्तिस् तयोः पाणिसमागमेन समं विभक्तेव मनोभवस्य ॥
units.english: Siva the god of eight forms received her band the fingets of which were red, offered by her father, the mountain or by the mountains priest, as if it were the first sprout of the god of love, whose form was concealed in the body of Umâ through the fear of the god The hair on Umàs body stood on end, while Siva lit, the bullmarked god had his fingers perspired by the joining of their hands the action of the mindborn Cupid was equally divided between the two

units.sanskrit: प्रयुक्तपाणिग्रहणं यद् अन्यद् वधूवरं पुष्यति कान्तिम् अग्र्याम् । सान्निध्ययोगाद् अनयोस् तदानीं किं कथ्यते श्रीर् उभयस्य तस्य ॥
units.english: Since an ordinary bride and bridegroom on being married, attain excellent splendour beauty from the presence of these two how can the beauty of the two be described when themselves brought in contact with each other?

units.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणप्रक्रमणात् कृशानोर् उदर्चिषस् तन् मिथुनं चकासे । मेरोर् उपान्तेष्व् इव वर्तमानम् अन्योन्यसंसक्तम् अहस्त्रियामम् ॥ तौ दम्पती त्रिः परिणीय वह्निम् कराग्रसंस्पर्शनिमीलिताक्षीम् । तां कारयाम् आस वधूं पुरोधास् तस्मिन् समिद्धार्चिषि लाजमोक्षम् ॥
units.english: By going round the blazing fire, keeping it to the right that couple, now united, shone like the day and night closely joined to each other and revolving round the sides of Meru The priest having conducted the bride and the bridegroom round the fire, with their eyes closed owing to mutual contact, made the bride offer fried rice into the kindled flre

units.sanskrit: सा लाजधूमाञ्जलिम् इष्टगन्धं गुरूपदेशाद् वदनं निनाय । कपोलसंसर्पिशिखः स तस्या मुहूर्तकर्णोत्पलतां प्रपेदे ॥ तद् ईषदार्द्रारुणगण्डलेखम् उच्छ्वासिकालाञ्जनरागम् अक्ष्णोः । वधूमुखं क्लान्तयवावतंसम् आचारधूमग्रहणाद् बभूव ॥
units.english: She, following the instructions of the priest, bent her face towards the smoke of agreeable smell, arising from the burning bandful of fried rice; the smoke, touching her cheek with its forepart, attained for a moment the state of the earlotus By receiving the smoke as required by the religious custom, the face of the bride had the orbs of its cheeks a little moistened and ruddy, with the tint of the black collyrium flushed and the barley sprout worn as earornament withered away

units.sanskrit: वधूं द्विजः प्राह तवैष वत्से वह्निर् विवाहं प्रति पूर्वसाक्षी । शिवेन भर्त्रा सह धर्मचर्या कार्या त्वया मुक्तविचारयेति ॥
units.english: The Brahmana priest said to the bride, Dear child, this fire is the witness to the conclusion of your marriagerite practise righteousness with Siva, your husband, giving up argumentation ie with implicit acquiescence

units.sanskrit: आलोचनान्तं श्रवणे वितत्य पीतं गुरोस् तद्वचनं भवान्या । निदाघकालोल्बणतापयेव माहेन्द्रम् अम्भः प्रथमं पृथिव्या ॥
units.english: Those words of the preceptor were drunk listened to attentively by Bhavànî, with ears stretched up to the borders of the eyes, like the first water of the rains come from Mahendra by the earth extremely parched by the sultry season

units.sanskrit: ध्रुवेण भर्त्रा ध्रुवदर्शनाय प्रयुज्यमाना प्रियदर्शनेन । सा दृष्ट इत्य् आननम् उन्नमय्य ह्रीसन्नकण्ठी कथम् अप्य् उवाच ॥
units.english: Directed by her eternal lord, charming to look at, to see the polar star, she raising her face, with her throat choked with bashfulness, said with difficulty seen

units.sanskrit: इत्थं विधिज्ञेन पुरोहितेन प्रयुक्तपाणिग्रहणोपचारौ । प्रणेमतुस् तौ पितरौ प्रजानां पद्मासनस्थाय पितामहाय ॥
units.english: With their marriageceremony thus performed by the family priest versed in the ceremonial, the two parents of creation, bowed to the Creator, seated on a lotus

units.sanskrit: वधूर् विधात्रा प्रतिनन्द्यते स्म कल्याणि वीरप्रसवा भवेति । वाचस्पतिः सन्न् अपि सो ऽष्टमूर्त्तव् आशास्य चिन्तास्तिमितो बभूव ॥
units.english: The bride was greeted by the Creator with the words Blessed one, be you the mother of a hero Though the master of speech, he became slow to think was at a loss to know as to what blessing to pronounce in the case of Siva

units.sanskrit: कॢप्तोपचारां चतुरस्रवेदीं ताव् एत्य पश्चाट् कनकासनस्थौ । जायापती लौकिकम् एषितव्यम् आर्द्राक्षतारोपणम् अन्वभूताम् ॥
units.english: Thereafter, the two, the bride and the bridegroom, coming to the fourcornered altar dais furnished with decorations and sitting on gold seats, experienced the application of wet wholerice to the forehead, customary with the world and to be coveted

units.sanskrit: पत्रान्तलग्नैर् जलबिन्दुजालैर् आकृष्टमुक्ताफलजालशोभम् । तयोर् उपर्य् आयतनालदण्डम् आधत्त लक्ष्मीः कमलातपत्रम् ॥
units.english: The goddess of wealth held over them the lotus umbrella which possessed the beauty of a network of pearls by means of the drops of water attached to its petals, and the long stalk of which served as its pole

units.sanskrit: द्विधा प्रयुक्तेन च वाङ्मयेन सरस्वती तन् मिथुनं नुनाव । संस्कारपूतेन वरं वरेण्यं वधूं सुखग्राह्यनिबन्धनेन ॥
units.english: The goddess of speech praised the couple with speech of a twofold composition the laudable bridegroom in a speech refined by grammatical purity, the bride in language easily comprehensible

units.sanskrit: तौ सन्धिषु व्यञ्जितवृत्तिभेदं रसान्तरेषु प्रतिबद्धरागम् । अपश्यताम् अप्सरसां मुहूर्तं प्रयोगम् आद्यं ललिताङ्गहारम् ॥
units.english: They saw, for a while, the first representation of a play in the combination of the different incidents of which the styles of description were properly brought out, in which the different sentiments were delineated by proper modes of music and in which there were graceful bodily movements or gesticulations

units.sanskrit: देवास् तदन्ते हरम् ऊढभार्यं किरीटबद्धाञ्जलयो निपत्य । शापावसाने प्रतिपन्नमूर्त्तेर् ययाचिरे पञ्चशरस्य सेवाम् ॥ तस्यानुमेने भगवान् विमन्युर् व्यापारम् आत्मन्य् अपि सायकानाम् । काले प्रयुक्ता खलु कार्यविद्भिर् विज्णापना भर्तृषु सिद्धिम् एति ॥
units.english: At its termination the gods with joined palms placed across their diadems prostrated themselves before Hara, who had married a wife and begged that the service of Káma, who had got back his body at the expiration of the curse pronounced on him, should now be accepted The Lord whose anger was gone permitted the operation of his arrows even on him
